items.name: Black Knife
items.desc: Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives. A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.
items.fx:
Black Knife is a Dagger found at the Sainted Hero's Grave and is a notable weapon for Godskin Celebrant.

Unique Skill: Blade of Death
Fires off a blade projectile dealing Destined Death, dealing damage and lowering an enemies health temporarily.
items.obtain: Dropped by the Black Knife Assassin in front of the Sainted Hero's Grave.

items.name: Blade of Calling
items.desc: The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Blade of Gold
Leap into the air, charging the armament with golden flames that are then shot at the enemy as a single, blade-like projectile.
Inflicts holy damage.
items.obtain: Divine Tower of Leyndell - On the table inside the hidden room found in the elevator shaft leading to Forbidden Lands.

items.name: Blades of the Prince
items.desc: A pair of long twin daggers imbued with the once golden lightning of Godwyn, now tainted with Deathblight. These weapons are capable of releasing corrupted shards of lightning as projectiles. This innovation may have been employed to mirror the spread of Godwyn's corruption across the Land Between.
items.fx:
Blades of the Prince are a Trick Weapon of Dagger and Throwing Dagger found near Stormcaller Church and is a notable weapon for Dragon Cultist.

Unique Skill: Spread Corruption
Throws out the daggers in a spread direction and imbues the daggers with lightning for 20 seconds. A follow up skill performs a forward lunge of spinning strikes.
- While the daggers are imbued, all attacks will throw projectiles similar to a Throwing Dagger moveset.
items.obtain: Found in a camp west of the Rampartside Path site of grace, in the second caravan after entering the camp, just after the balistas.

items.name: Bloodstained Dagger
items.desc: Dagger with bloodstained blade. Afflicts targets with blood loss. As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Sold by Twin Maiden Husks for 600 runes.

items.name: Celebrant's Sickle
items.desc: Crafted from human bone by the celebrants now devoted to the glory of the Godslayers.
items.fx:
This weapon increases the damage of Godslayer incantations by 10%.

Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Caelid - Found in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow on a corpse on the outer layer of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

items.name: Cinquedea
items.desc: Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula. The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.
items.fx:
This dagger increases the damage of Bestial incantations by 10%.

Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: Caelid - Found at the Bestial Sanctum in the lowest section of the undercroft, near the Grace.

items.name: Dagger
items.desc: A standard dagger with a straight blade. Though modest in reach and capacity for harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Bought from Twin Maiden Husks for 400 runes.

items.name: Deathrite Dagger
items.desc: A fragment of one of the branches of the rune of death, made manifest. This blade acts as a source of the terrible blight that now plagues the Lands Between.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Blighted Breath
Channel the power of death from the blade into your lungs and then release in a stream of blight in front of you.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - Dropped by Necromancer Domo found at the bottom of Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Erdsteel Dagger
items.desc: An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.
items.fx:
This dagger increases the damage of Golden Order incantations by 10%.

Unique Skill: Flash of Gold
Conjure a golden dagger into your hand and throw it at foes before you. This attack can be performed in rapid succession.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Quest reward from Kenneth Haight after clearing Fort Haight. Return to him and exhaust his dialogues to receive the dagger.

items.name: Fire Knight's Shortsword
items.desc: Shortsword used by the Fire Knights. A slender blade that undulates like fire.
items.fx:
Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: Scadu Altus - Found on a corpse in a tent west of the Moorth Ruins site of grace.

items.name: Glintstone Kris
items.desc: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace.
items.fx:
This dagger increases the damage of Glint sorceries by 10%.

Unique Skill: Glintstone Dart
Skill that builds from the Glintstone Pebble sorcery.
Charge the skill to upgrade it to Glintstone Dart.
Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.
items.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes - Found on top of Highway Lookout Tower.

items.name: Great Knife
items.desc: Large knife with a broad, curved blade. This weapon is designed to slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Volcano Manor - From the Prison Town Church site of grace, head outside and to the right. Keep following the main path. Before crossing a bridge, head to a tower in the right. The weapon can be found up the stairs.

items.name: Ivory Sickle
items.desc: Sickle fashioned from ivory, thought to once belong to Shabriri, the reviled.
items.fx:
This weapon increases the damage of Frenzied Flame incantations by 10%.

Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - Found inside the room reachable after defeating Godrick The Grafted or by the Lake-Facing Cliffs site of grace.

items.name: Main-gauche
items.desc: Dagger with a large hand guard. Intended to be used in the left hand, thereby complementing a piercing sword or identical blade held in the right to enable a distinctive style of fighting.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Shadow Keep - From the Main Gate Plaza site of grace, head left and up the two sets of stairs. Halfway up the second set of stairs, take the doorway to your right, and continue through the other door in the room. The Main-gauche is on a corpse on the left.

items.name: Midnight Dagger
items.desc: A dagger of the fallen Nox Empire, once used in the rituals of the assassin caste.
items.fx:
This weapon increases the damage of Night sorceries by 10%.

Can be powerstanced with Star Shadow. When powerstanced in this way, this weapon uses the katana powerstancing moveset.

Skill: Assassin's Gambit
Skill that masks the user's presence at the cost of a self-inflicted wound.
Grants near-invisibility and silences footsteps.
items.obtain: Nokron, the Eternal City - Found inside a chest guarded by a Nox Priestess.

items.name: Misericorde
items.desc: Dagger favored by military physicians in white. The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent. Medicine is mercy, and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothed as men of compassion.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - Found on a corpse on the ground in the armory room.

items.name: Parrying Dagger
items.desc: A knife with curved handguards. Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them. For masters of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Bought from Patches the Untethered after unlocking him as a merchant for 1,600 runes.

items.name: Quicksilver Fragment
items.desc: A shard of hardened quicksilver, broken away from a larger body, now wielded as a large knife. Galvanising quicksilver left the material dry and brittle, a process that Daergraf mercilessly performed on many living silver tears. The first to survive this process was once his close servant and trusted advisor.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Quicksilver Spray
Drag the blade along the ground and sweep it outward, sending splashes of deadly quicksilver in a cone in front of you. Follow-up with another skill attack to perform a back-facing stab with both hands, or follow-up with a heavy attack to leap into the air and plunge the blade into the ground, releasing a geyser of quicksilver around you.
items.obtain: Noxumbra, Forsaken City - Obtained by defeating the Quicksilver Husk.

items.name: Reduvia
items.desc: Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade. Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Reduvia Blood Blade
Slash with the wicked dagger, transforming its never-drying bloodstains into airborne blades that cause blood loss.
Can be fired in rapid succession.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus after defeating him. Nerijus will invade the player near Murkwater Cave.

items.name: Scorpion's Stinger
items.desc: Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot. A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.
items.fx:
Skill: Repeating Thrust
Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.
items.obtain: Lake of Rot - Found in front of a tree guarded by a scythe-wielding Cleanrot Knight, on top of the ruins.

items.name: Stormcaller Dirk
items.desc: A long dagger of simple design once held by the royal guard of ancient Stormveil. Saturated with the power of storms, this dagger was used to finish off-balance foes in the final days of the war with the Erdtree.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Storm Thrust
Call the power of the storms into the blade and lunge forward toward an enemy creating a burst of wind upon impact. This attack deals exceptional posture damage.
items.obtain: Cliffbottom Catacombs - Dropped by Stormcaller Taran upon defeat.

items.name: Surgeon's Catling
items.desc: Once a medical tool as part of a surgeon's field kit, now used in sacrifices to the great Mohgwyn Dynasty.
items.fx:
This weapon increases the damage of Bloodflame incantations by 10%.

Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau - Found on a corpse in the graveyard behind the Second Church of Marika.

items.name: Underworld Dagger
items.desc: Carved from crystal and saturated with freezing lightning.
items.fx:
This dagger increases the damage of Dragonkin sorcery by 10%.

Unique Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes - Dropped by the Crystalian in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Wakizashi
items.desc: Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Afflicts targets with blood loss. These swords are considered auxiliary weapons. Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.
items.fx:
Can only be powerstanced with katanas or another Wakizashi.

Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets. attacks.
items.obtain: Caelid - Found on a corpse in one of the cells inside Gaol Cave.

items.name: Smithscript Dagger
items.desc: Dagger engraved with a smithscript. Reduced mass enhances the effects of the smithing arts, allowing this weapon to function as a throwing dagger for all attacks. Once thrown, the dagger instantly reappears in the wielder's hand.
items.fx:
Skill: Piercing Throw
Throw armament with a powerful spin, causing it to bore through foes. When using this skill, the armament can be thrown further than normal and also pierce through enemies.
items.obtain: Gravesite Plains - Inside the Ruined Forge Lava Intake, run forwards around the side of the lava pit. Turn right and run down the stairs. Continue down the stairs and then turn left into the big room. Drop down onto the platform and then drop down onto the floor. Follow the pale path on the floor round to the right. The weapon is on a corpse by the golem in this room.

items.name: Blade of Valor
items.desc: A time-worn blade of a once great hero. The blade still displays perfect temper, a testament to the steadfast nature of its former owner.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Champion's Evasion
Duck into a low stance and hop forward, follow up with a heavy attack to perform an uppercut in front of you.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - South of the Secluded Cell, on a rooftop across from the ladder guarded by a Lion Guardian.

items.name: Broadsword
items.desc: A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks. Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level.
Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Bought from Twin Maiden Husks for 1800 runes.

items.name: Cane Sword
items.desc: Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn. Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level.
Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital - Found on a corpse down the stairs and around the corner near West Capital Rampart site of grace. Still available at the same location in Leyndell, Capital of Ash.

items.name: Carian Knight's Sword
items.desc: Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty. These knights' sword could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.
items.fx:
Skill: Carian Grandeur
Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill.
Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down.
Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels.
items.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes - Found inside the chest in the carriage being pulled by trolls near The Four Belfries site of grace.

items.name: Coded Sword
items.desc: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Unblockable Blade
Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital - Found in upstairs throne room of Fortified Manor.

items.name: Draconic Epitaph
items.desc: A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die. Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."
items.fx:
Skill: Lightning Slash
Call down a bolt of lightning into armament, then swing it down to create an explosive shock.
The armament retains the lightning enchantment for a while.
items.obtain: Weeping Peninsula - Found in the Fourth Church of Marika

items.name: Dragonkin Seeker Sword
items.desc: Carved from wood that was taken from the strange trees of the underworld that have never felt the touch of sunlight, this blade is infused with the frozen lightning of the Dragonkin.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ice Lightning Sword
Call down a bolt of ice lightning into the blade and bring it down upon a foe.
The ice lightning effect will persist for a while.
items.obtain: Upper Siofra River - Found on a corpse north of Aqueduct Facing Cliffs Site of Grace. You need to activate the bridge beforehand, by interacting with the Crystal next to the site of grace.

items.name: Fell Flame Sword
items.desc: Sword forged by the giant smiths of the ancient world, with a design modeled for use by their more diminutive neighbors; the astrologers. Instead of glintstone however, red coals from the fell forge are embedded in the blade.
items.fx:
Skill: Flaming Strike
Skill that emits flame in a wide frontward arc.
Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike.
This will also coat the armament in fire.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants - Found inside a chest in Guardian's Garrison.

items.name: Guardian's Spearblade
items.desc: A transformable weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees. It functions as either a straight sword or a spear. Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Erdtree Mastery
Tap the skill to swap between the two weapon forms.
Sword Form: Perform two slicing uppercut attacks and then follow up with a heavy attack to perform a leaping downward slam that causes a holy explosion on impact.
Spear Form: Perform two lateral slash attacks and then follow up with a heavy attack to perform an upward thrust that causes a holy explosion on the tip of the spear at its full extension.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau - Found on a corpse behind the Erdtree Sentry boss in Minor Erdtree Church.

items.name: Longsword
items.desc: A straight sword with a double-edged blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. A superbly balanced armament.
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level.
Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Bought from Twin Maiden Husks for 1000 runes.

items.name: Lordsworn Straight Sword
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: Weeping Peninsula - Obtained by defeating the Demi-Human Queen in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

items.name: Maddening Brand
items.desc: A blade melted and scorched by the Flame of Frenzy, laden with madness. The Frenzied Flame offers its gift to all, thus this weapon inflicts madness on all who touch it.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Frenzied Assault
Imbue the blade with Frenzied Flame and perform a series of deranged slash attacks; hold to perform a more powerful sequence of slashes. Builds Madness on self.
items.obtain: From the Castle Morne Town site of grace, in the west side of the town just after the frenzied knight on a pile of burning corpses at the foot of a tree.

items.name: Molten Sword
items.desc: A sword of molten crystal, made using the power of the cult of Eiglay, ancient sorcerers of Mt. Gelmir.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Magma Shower
Slash at foes in a twirling motion while scattering magma all around.
Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Caelid - Obtained by defeating the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.

items.name: Noble's Slender Sword
items.desc: Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level.
Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes - Found inside a chest in the upper layer of the Bols, Carian Knight arena in Academy of Raya Lucaria.

items.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
items.desc: Slender straight sword patterned after an unique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand. After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Golden Tempering
Cross the two swords to grant their attacks holy essence. While in effect, strong attack performs a dual-wielding combo attack.
items.obtain: Limgrave / Liurnia - Dropped by the Grafted Scion in Precipice of Anticipation, reachable through The Four Belfries in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Regalia of Eochaid
items.desc: Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone. Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Eochaid's Dancing Blade
Infuse the sword with energy, then fling it forwards in a corkscrew attack. The sword continuously deals damage while violently spinning. Charge the attack to increase reach and duration of the spin.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants - Found on a corpse near Giant's Mountaintop Catacombs site of grace.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Sword
items.desc: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.
items.fx:
Ash of War: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree - Found inside the chest guarded by 3 Rotten Crystalians near the Elphael Inner Wall.

items.name: Short Sword
items.desc: A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Sold by the Nomadic Merchant east from Saintsbridge site of Grace, for 600 runes.

items.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
items.desc: A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone. Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level.
Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: The Stone-Sheathed Sword can be obtained in three different locations, but can only be obtained once per New Game-cycle. If you pick up the item at one of the three altars, the other two can be used to convert the weapon into the Sword of Light or the Sword of Darkness respectively. * **Gravesite Plains**: Found in front of an altar in the deeper parts of the Fog Rift Catacombs. To access, descend into the catacombs, until you reach a room with three trapped ceilings. Make your way to the end of the room and jump unto the contraption and ride up. From this point you can walk across to reach the altar. * **Ruins of Unte**: Found in front of an altar in the blocked courtyard of the Ruins of Unte. You need to wake up the Furnace Golem blocking the way to the church access the item. To do this, throw a Hefty Fire Pot or Hefty Furnace pot at it's face from a higher point. * **Ancient Ruins of Rauh**: Found in front of an altar. To access this area travel Northwest from the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West site of grace and enter the temple. Travel through the scarlet rot area while keeping northwest. After exiting the ruins you can see the tower ahead which can be easily accessed by an invisible, straight bridge. The altar is on top of said tower.

items.name: Sword of Night and Flame
items.desc: Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Night-and-Flame Stance
Hold the sword level and prepare to cast a sorcery.
Follow up with a normal attack to cast the Night Comet sorcery, or a strong attack to sweep forward with a burst of flames.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants - Found in a chest at the top of Heretical Rise, can be entered by crossing the invisible bridge that's connected to the broken bridge northwest of the Rise

items.name: Sword of St. Trina
items.desc: Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes. St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Mists of Slumber
Releases a faint purple mist that spreads across a wide frontwards area. This mist inflicts the sleep ailment upon foes.
items.obtain: Caelid - Found inside a chest in Forsaken Ruins near Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.

items.name: Sword of Darkness
items.desc: Sword of darkness, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, wandering coils of darkness coalesce and release, their eddies and vortices giving form to the dark blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Darkness
Raise the sword aloft and cleave surroundings with darkness. Deals magic damage and temporarily reduces magic damage negation.
items.obtain: The Sword of Darkness has to be converted from the Stone-Sheathed Sword or the Sword of Light at a specific location depending on where the Stone-Sheathed Sword was picked up. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword has been picked up at either the Ruins of Unte or the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, the altar to convert it will be at: * **Gravesite Plains**: Found in front of an altar in the deeper parts of the Fog Rift Catacombs. To access, descend into the catacombs, until you reach a room with three trapped ceilings. Make your way to the end of the room and jump unto the contraption and ride up. From this point you can walk across to reach the altar. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword has been picked up at the Fog Rift Catacombs, the altar to convert it will be at: * **Ruins of Unte**: Found in front of an altar in the blocked courtyard of the Ruins of Unte. You need to wake up the Furnace Golem blocking the way to the church access the item. To do this, throw one of the large fire pots at it's face from a higher point. * **Ancient Ruins of Rauh**: Found in front of an altar. To access this area travel Northwest from the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West site of grace and enter the temple. Travel through the scarlet rot area while keeping northwest. After exiting the ruins you can see the tower ahead which can be easily accessed by an invisible, straight bridge. The altar is on top of said tower.

items.name: Sword of Light
items.desc: Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar. From the quick of the root, unswerving rays of light intersect and reflect to give the silver blade form.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Light
Unleashes the light carved in the armament's blade. Send the sword aloft to let loose a blinding light whose many rays sweep through the surrounding area. Also temporarily boosts one's own holy attacks.
items.obtain: The Sword of Light has to be converted from the Stone-Sheathed Sword or the Sword of Darkness at a specific location depending on where the Stone-Sheathed Sword was picked up. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword has been picked up at either the Fog Rift Catacombs or the Ruins of Unte, the altar to convert it will be at: * **Ancient Ruins of Rauh**: Found in front of an altar. To access this area travel Northwest from the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West site of grace and enter the temple. Travel through the scarlet rot area while keeping northwest. After exiting the ruins you can see the tower ahead which can be easily accessed by an invisible, straight bridge. The altar is on top of said tower. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword has been picked up at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, the altar to convert it will be at: * **Ruins of Unte, Castle Watering Hole**: Found in front of an altar in the blocked courtyard of the Ruins of Unte. You need to wake up the Furnace Golem blocking the way to the church access the item. To do this, throw one of the large fire pots at it's face from a higher point. * **Gravesite Plains**: Found in front of an altar in the deeper parts of the Fog Rift Catacombs. To access, descend into the catacombs, until you reach a room with three trapped ceilings. Make your way to the end of the room and jump unto the contraption and ride up. From this point you can walk across to reach the altar.

items.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
items.desc: Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep. When St. Trina was abandoned, the faint, light-purple mists coalesced into an intoxicating deep-purple cloud.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Mists of Eternal Sleep
Releases a velvety purple mist that spreads across a wide frontal area. Afflicts foes with eternal sleep.
items.obtain: Cerulean Coast - Found inside a small cave. Walk northwest from the Fissure Cross site of grace and drop down two platforms.

items.name: Warhawk's Talon
items.desc: Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use. The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - Found on a corpse inside the tower reachable through the staircase next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

items.name: Weathered Straight Sword
items.desc: Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people. Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.
items.fx:
Skill: Square Off
This skill starts with the sword held level.
Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Found in a basin northwest of the Stormhill Shack site of grace.

items.name: Yura's Kanabo
items.desc: A common weapon among ronins from the Land of Reeds, such implements are a rarity in the Lands Between. Yura has abandoned such methods in his task to purge the incursion of the vile cessbloods.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ronin's Technique
Perform an elbow strike attack and then follow up with another skill attack to perform a strike with your left palm and then follow up with another skill attack to perform a shoulder tackle. Charge to perform a shoulder tackle instead.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Found on a corpse near the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace.

items.name: Konrad’s Bloodletter
items.desc: The light greatsword of Konrad, Pureblood Knight. Wrapped in a blood-soaked cloth, the blade is styled as the signature helix of the Mohgwyn Dynasty.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Konrad's Bloodletter
Stomp the ground to release a circular wave of bloodflame around you. Follow-up with another skill attack to perform an uppercut with the sword that sends out a trail of fire in front of you.
items.obtain: Pureblood Knight Konrad

items.name: Idus Sword
items.desc: A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while only possessing a very light weight due to its remarkable manufacture. A signature weapon of the land of Idus. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: Found on a corpse in the cellar of Summonwater Village.

items.name: Leda's Sword
items.desc: Light greatsword with gold inlaid. Weapon of Leda, the Needle Knight. Deals holy damage. Though polished to a mirror sheen, this blade still reeks with the stench of crusted blood that lingers from the cull of her knightly comrades.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Needle Piercer
Skill of Needle Knight Leda. Generates ten gold needles which pierce their target all at once. Those pierced are purged of all ailments and special effects alike.
items.obtain: Enir-Ilim - Obtained from defeating Needle Knight Leda and the remaining followers of Miquella.

items.name: Milady
items.desc: A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while being constrained to a minimal weight. Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a long thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: Castle Ensis - Obtained from a chest atop a watchtower near the start of the dungeon.

items.name: Nia’s Passot
items.desc: A narrow light greatsword, wrapped in a single leather strap. Nia, one-time companion of Sulien and his company, was inspired by the nobility of the children of Marika. Malenia, for her grace and skill, and Messmer for his loyalty and determination. It was this that led her to follow him into the Land of Shadow.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Malenian Homage
Grip the blade above the hilt and perform a sequence of sweeping slashes. Follow-up with another skill attack to repeat this. Follow-up with a heavy attack to leap upward and then rush forward with a powerful impaling thrust.
items.obtain: Fog Rift Catacombs. Progress through the dungeon until the part with the falling spike ceiling trap. Get on top of it and run across to the far side and take the hallway to the left. Proceed through the next room, across the walkway, and up the stairs. In the room behind the Godskin Knight there is a chest at the foot of a Headless Marika statue containing the weapon.

items.name: Primeval Splinter
items.desc: A narrow shard of glintstone crystal, fashioned into a light greatsword. Heavy attacks will fire a glintstone projectile from the blade. Made using a method unachievable by humans, the denziens of Raya Crystalia have brought a greater nuance to Crystalian crafting.
items.fx:
Skill: Wing Stance
Calmly assume a right-sided stance. Normal attack triggers a rapid three-slash combination. Strong attack triggers a leaping thrust.
items.obtain: Raya Crystalia. Before crossing the third magic bridge, on the floor around a little corner to the right as you approach the bridge.

items.name: Regal Splitblade
items.desc: A balanced Greatsword crafted for a forgotten king, capable of splitting into two lighter swords. Carried to the ruined lands on a royal pilgrimage, this weapon was made using techniques only known by the once great house of ancient Stormveil.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Splitblade Sundering
Tap the skill to split the sword into two lighter swords, or to rejoin them. This action can also be taken immediately after a light attack to perform a transitional attack which deals high damage. Hold the skill to perform a sweeping series of attacks which can be followed up with another skill attack to continue the combination.
items.obtain: Crumbling Farum Azula. From the Dragonlord's Annex site of grace, head straight west to the building at the top of the stairs where a chest containing the weapon with be in the mouth of a dragon skull.

items.name: Rellana's Twin Blades
items.desc: Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Two swords as a single armament. When two-handing, a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Moon-and-Fire Stance
Assume ready stance, swords imbued with magic. Follow up with normal attack to cast glintstone light waves, or strong attack to perform a spinning attack that bathes the area with flame. Light waves can have up to two follow-up casts with additional inputs.
items.obtain: Rellana's Twin Blades can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2000 runes after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, who is located at the end of Castle Ensis.

items.name: Sword of the Cosmos
items.desc: The ancient astrologers had a keen interest in the stars and so they were naturally among the first to investigate the falling star that brought the first Onyx lords to the world. This sword is result of their fateful discovery.
items.fx:
Deals 20% extra damage against gravity enemies.

Unique Skill: Cosmic Stance
Hold the sword level and prepare to unleash gravitational energy.
Follow up with a normal attack to call a large gravity wave around you, or a strong attack to sweep forward with a bursting gravity nebula.
items.obtain: Caria Manor - found in a chest at the top of the rise after defeating Rhys and going up the elevator.

items.name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
items.desc: Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Alabaster Lord's Pull
Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in.
Has a greater area of effect than Gravitas.
items.obtain: Redmane Castle - Dropped by the Alabaster Lord near the Redmane Storehouse site of grace.

items.name: Banished Knight's Greatsword
items.desc: A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - Found inside a chest above the room with the kitchen, with the Grafted Scion.

items.name: Bastard Sword
items.desc: A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle - Found on the leftmost corpse just after the Stormveil Main Gate site of grace, beyond the portcullis to the northwest.

items.name: Blasphemous Blade
items.desc: Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade. Now they share the same blood, bound together as family.
items.fx:
Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

Unique Skill: Taker's Flames
Raise the sacred sword aloft to set it ablaze with blasphemous flames, then bring it down to fire off a forward blast.
The flames steal HP from those they touch.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Sold by Finger Reader Enia after killing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy for 2000 runes. Volcano Manor - Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy can be found at the end of Volcano Manor, or by completed the Volcano Manor Questline and behind teleported there by Lady Tanith.

items.name: Celestial Blade
items.desc: A weapon of the ancient astrologers, precursors to the sorcerers of today. A carefully kept secret of the academy, this blade acts as a direct conduit for the power of the primeval current.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Celestial Ascension
Invoke the power of the stars imbuing the weapon with power, while active, your heavy attacks will use different techniques.
A single skill attack will cause you to teleport forward and cleave your foes with a release of celestial energy.
Charging the skill attack will cause you the release a massive lateral arc of energy towards foes.
items.obtain: Academy of Raya Lucaria - Found inside the chest after taking the elevator behind Crystalian Duo in Academy Crystal Cave.

items.name: Claymore
items.desc: A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient. In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust, making this a versatile weapon.
items.fx:
Skill: Lion's Claw
Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn.
Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament.
items.obtain: Castle Morne - Obtained in a chest guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head, near the Morne Armory.

items.name: Dark Moon Greatsword
items.desc: A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition. One of the legendary armaments. Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Moonlight Greatsword
Raise the sword aloft, bathing it in the light of the dark moon.
Temporarily increases magic attack power and imbues blade with frost.
Charged attacks release blasts of moonlight.
items.obtain: Moonlight Altar - Appears on the ground after the player exhausted Ranni the Witch's dialogue and completed her questline in Cathedral of Manus Celes reachable through the elevator found behind Astel, Naturalborn of the Void's arena.

items.name: Death's Poker
items.desc: Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds. The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ghostflame Ignition
Thrust out the barbed rod and set its tip alight with ghostflame.
Follow up with a normal attack to set the ground ablaze with ghostflame, or a strong attack to trigger a massive explosion.
items.obtain: Caelid - Dropped by the Deathrite Bird that is found by going east from Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace at night.

items.name: Dyru's Greatsword
items.desc: A weighty executioner's sword, wrought by the king of the Misbegotten, Dyru. Despite its obvious age and wear, the blade remains perfectly honed.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Dyru's Savagery
Infuse the blade with the power of storms and perform a mighty leap forward and slam the blade down upon foes. Follow up with another skill attack to perform a wide swipe.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Bought from Enia at Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Dyru, Scavenger King. Castle Morne - Dyru, Scavenger King can be found at the end of the dungeon, near the Morne Moangrave site of grace. To access the fight, you need to pull a lever at the top of the tower west of the grace.

items.name: Flamberge
items.desc: Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation. Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss. Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Redmane Castle - Found in the upper ramparts of the castle, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head.

items.name: Forked Greatsword
items.desc: Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: From the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace, proceed forward into the start of the next area, drop from the first wooden beam on to the second, then down on to the third and follow it upward to a corpse with the weapon.

items.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
items.desc: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Corpse Wax Cutter
Lost skill of ancient heroes.
Lift the sword up high to release the power of corpse wax and launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.
items.obtain: Caelid - Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab near the Farum Greatbridge site of grace.

items.name: Gargoyle's Greatsword
items.desc: Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
items.fx:
Skill: Vacuum Slice
Lost skill of ancient heroes.
Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital - Drops from a Valiant Gargoyle near the Fortified Manor.

items.name: Golden Order Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by the King Consort Radagon to proudly symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order. One of the legendary armaments. Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Establish Order
Raise the armament in salute, releasing a golden explosion. Repeated inputs send out waves of golden light.
items.obtain: Consecrated Snowfields - Obtained by defeating the Misbegotten Crusader in Cave of the Forlorn.

items.name: Greatsword of Damnation
items.desc: Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. The barbs are now tained with the Flame of Frenzy, the last legacy of Midra. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.
items.fx:
The grab attack only functions against enemies that use the player model.

Unique Skill: Golden Crux
Leap up and skewer foe from overhead. If successful, the weapon's barbs unfold to excruciate from within; else, additional input releases barbs in the area. There is something of the Golden Order in the sight of those fixed upon this crux.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame in Midra's Manse.

items.name: Greatsword of Midra
items.desc: Golden greatsword that once pierced the body of Midra, master of the manse. The barbs are now tainted with the Flame of Frenzy, the last legacy of Midra. The barbs that pierce the victim from within wind gently around the blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Waves of Madness
Use the skill attack to perform two lateral slashes that emit waves of frenzied flame in front of you, follow up with another skill attack to continue the slashes another two times and then follow up with a final skill attack to deliver a powerful slash.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Purchased from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame in Midra's Manse.

items.name: Greatsword of Solitude
items.desc: Steel greatsword wielded by the Knights of the Solitary Gaol. Through a secret rite, they relinquished their hearts for heightened battle prowess. Next, they engraved their blades with two crests: one depicting the light of birth, and the other, solitude.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Solitary Moon Slash
Sharply slash downward using the greatsword, shooting forward an arc of light. Strong attack allows for an advancing follow-up.
items.obtain: Gravesite Plains - Dropped from the Blackgaol Knight in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

items.name: Helphen's Steeple
items.desc: Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world. The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ruinous Ghostflame
Swing the sword to bathe its blade in ghostflame and then perform a piercing thrust in front of you.
Follow up with a light attack to perform an overhead chop or with a heavy attack to perform a lateral sweep.
The ghostflame adds holy damage to attacks, and also causes frostbite buildup.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants - Obtained by defeating the Tibia Mariner that is west of Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace.

items.name: Inseparable Sword
items.desc: Sword forged by compounding silver and gold. A sacred weapon to hunt Those Who Live in Death. Deals holy damage. The inseparable twins found solace in the Golden Order, the only institution not to revile them as accursed beings.
items.fx:
Skill: Sacred Blade
Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for a while.
items.obtain: * Obtained by killing D at Summonwater Village and giving his armor to D's Twin Brother in Nokron and reloading the area to kill him * Killing/talking to D's Twin Brother after he kills Fia

items.name: Iron Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel. A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept. Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants - Found in a stone basin guarded by Hand Creepers. The stone basin is reachable from the Foot of the Forge site of grace by going north of it and hugging the stone wall on the left side of the snowy descent where a giant Hand Creeper and the magic pot throwing Giant are.

items.name: Knight's Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title. Featuring a long grip enabling a dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Redmane Castle - Found in the room behind the Troll wielding a flaming sword, near the front gate of the castle.

items.name: Leontiel's Greatsword
items.desc: The knight Leontiel's favored weapon—a greatsword whose blade is wrapped in leather at the base. Said to have been wielded by a proud order of orthodox knights long ago, weapons of this ilk demand high dexterity.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Mutela
Hold out a red cloth in front, inviting enemies to attack. Use normal or strong attack to gracefully dodge incoming strikes then pivot to offense. Can be charged to increase power of strong attack. Also, additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Dropped by Knight Leontiel in Radahn's arena after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Lizard Greatsword
items.desc: A peculiar weapon carried by imps. Greatsword smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued lizard. Strong attacks allow the wielder to fire the forked tongue from the blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Ruah Ruins - From the first lift in the Scorpion River Catacombs, turn right and run through the hallway. Go under the arch and wait for the Basilisk Eyes to go pass. Run through and turn right before the basilisk statue. Continue through the room and go behind the big imp. The next room will have a Putrescence Sorcerer and two imps. Pass through this room and turn right through an archway. Go up the stairs and onto the bridge. Look down to see a second bridge below. Drop down onto this bridge to the left and go up the ladder. The chest is in the room directly in front of the ladder.

items.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
items.desc: Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army. Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Limgrave - Found inside a carriage at Gatefront Ruins.

items.name: Marais Executioner's Sword
items.desc: Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle. One of the legendary armaments. Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Eochaid's Stance
Hold to enter a readied stance and follow up with a light attack to perform two sweeping telekinetic slashes and a final cleave downward in front of you, follow up with a heavy attack to infuse the sword with energy and then fling it forwards in a corkscrew attack, the sword continuously deals damage while violently spinning.
items.obtain: The Shaded Castle - Obtained by defeating Elemer of the Briar at the end of the castle, in the Castellans Hall.

items.name: Ordovis's Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence. Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be close in nature to life itself.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ordovis's Vortex
Channel the power of the crucible to spin the entire sword in midair, building momentum before slamming the blade down onto the ground.
This skill can be charged to increase its power.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau - Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Odorvis in Auriza Hero's Grave.

items.name: Prime Maliketh’s Black Blade
items.desc: Maliketh's black blade restored to its prime glory, reflecting the strength and techniques of its master. Jumping attacks of the sword mirror the mastery of Maliketh himself.
items.fx:
Inflicts Lesser Soul Burn

Unique Skill: Death Rune's Invocation
Plunge the sword into the ground to call a flurry of strikes in front of you and imbue the blade with Destined Death for 1 minute. Once imbued, additional skill attacks will be changed. While moving forward or standing still you will perform a forward cleave. While moving laterally or backwards, you will perform a twisting somersault that fires a wave of death. The follow up for any of these attacks is an evasive dodge.
items.obtain: Restore Maliketh's Black Blade at the Restoration Altar in the room adjacent to Godrick's throne room in Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Sacred Relic Sword
items.desc: Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal. Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Wave of Gold
Imbue the sword with bygone golden glory, then fire it at foes.
A wide, golden wave fans out forwards, sweeping through all enemies caught in its path.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Sold by Finger Reader Enia after defeating the Elden Beast for 2000 runes. Fractured Marika - Defeating the Elden Beast up the stairs from the Elden Throne site of grace will unlock the Sacred Relic Sword for purchase.

items.name: Sword of the Cyclops
items.desc: A heretical weapon, one of the last vestiges of the kingdom of giants before their great defeat. Clearly made for use by humans, this weapon freely channels the power of the flame of ruin, hinting at a sinful alliance.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Cyclopean Conflagration
Pull the sword back as a vortex of giantsflame ignites around the blade.
Then thrust it forward sending out a stream of raging fire towards enemies.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants - Found after defeating the Fire Giant, near a frozen giant in his arena.

items.name: Sword of Hadea
items.desc: The sword of Hadea, first of the crucible. Adorned with ancient runes and worn from use in countless battles, this weapon channels the ancient power of creation. "I shall never again don the armor of my kin, I shall never again hide behind my birthright."
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Crucible's Fury
Leap into the air and bring the sword into a downward thrust amidst a vortex of energy.

Follow up with a strong attack to perform a double slash that sends out a wave of energy toward foes.
items.obtain: Roundtable Hold - Sold by Finger Reader Enia after killing Skarde, Crucible's Betrayer for 2,000 runes. Leyndell, Ashen Capital - Skarde, Crucible's Betrayer can be found in the Erdtree Sanctuary.

items.name: Sword of Milos
items.desc: Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone. Metes out wounds like a lopsided saw-blade. Milos was undersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly grotesque.
items.fx:
Restores some FP upon defeating an enemy.

Unique Skill: Shriek of Milos
Lets out a horrific cursed scream that reduces all damage negation and status resistances for nearby foes.
While active, strong attacks will change to a combo attack.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital - Dropped by the Dung Eater invader in the Leyndell Moat.

items.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
items.desc: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. Greatsword of ancient meteoric ore, ending in a sharp point. Fashioned from an excavated shard of an arrowhead that once was a part of the old gods' arsenal. A capable piercing weapon that excels at thrusting attacks.
items.fx:
Deals 20% extra damage against gravity enemies.

Unique Skill: Cosmic Burst
Summons a gravitational void from the crevice in the weapon's ancient meteoric ore, using its power for a charging attack which pierces foes. Additional input causes the void to explode.
items.obtain: The Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword is dropped by the Fallingstar Beast in the crater northeast from the Hinterland Bridge site of grace.

items.name: Fingerprint Hexmark
items.desc: A long slender stake once used as a mount for a martyred nomad, now wielded as a colossal sword. Fragments of the victim's tattered clothing still cling to the weapon, refusing to be burned away by the Frenzy that inhabits it.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Martyr's Vengeance
Call upon the Frenzied Flames within the steel and perform a sweeping lateral attack. Follow-up with another skill attack to perform a downward chop that sends flames forward along the ground or follow-up with a heavy attack to leap into the air and bring the weapon down with a large explosion of flames. Builds madness on self.
items.obtain: From the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace, proceed forward into the start of the next area, drop from the first wooden beam on to the second and follow it downward into the room with the weapon.

items.name: Fire Knight's Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword of the Fire Knights. A long, slender blade that undulates like fire.
items.fx:
Blessed with a flame incantation. Further flame imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: The Fire Knight's Greatsword is found in front of the statue of Marika at the Church of the Crusade in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Godslayer's Greatsword
items.desc: Sacred sword of the Dusk-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh. The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: The Queen's Black Flame
Set the blade ablaze with the god-slaying black flame before delivering a sweeping slash. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack. The black flames will continue to wear down HP for a while.
items.obtain: The Godslayer's Greatsword can be obtained in a chest after defeating the Godskin Apostle at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

items.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
items.desc: The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret. One of the legendary armaments. A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Oath of Vengeance
Swear an oath upon the greatsword to avenge the clan, temporarily raising all attributes for a certain duration. While the oath's effects are active, poise will also be increased.
items.obtain: The Grafted Blade Greatsword is obtained after defeating the Leonine Misbegotten in Castle Morne.

items.name: Gravelstone Arcblades
items.desc: A pair of gold-hued blades, wrought from a stony conglomerate of ancient dragon scales. The origin of these blades was unknown even to Godwyn, who, fearing the consequences of them falling into the wrong hands, sealed them away in the tomb of one of his most trusted knights.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Wrath of the Ancients
Slam the blades into the ground and then sweep them forward releasing a wide arc of ancient lightning, follow up with another skill attack to perform a forward somersault and slam both blades down into the ground releasing a large shockwave of ancient lightning around you.
items.obtain: The Gravelstone Arcblades are obtained after defeating the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in the Wyndham Catacombs, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Greatsword
items.desc: A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword. Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight. Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: Caelid - Obtained in a wagon on the Road of East Caelid.

items.name: Greatswords of Radahn
items.desc: Greatswords of black steel wielded by Radahn in his youth. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. These were in his possession immediately before his triumph over the stars—the swords of a lord who does not rely on physical strength and gravity alone.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Lord of Light Stance
Hold the swords close to your body to assume a prepared stance and then perform a light attack deliver a slashing attack accompanied by columns of light. Additional input allows for up to two follow-up attacks. Or follow up with a heavy attack to leap forward to deliver a downward slash at the speed of light.
items.obtain: The Greatsword of Radahn can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold after defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The boss is found at the arena in front of the Divine Gate Front Staircase site of grace in Enir-Ilim.

items.name: Maliketh's Black Blade
items.desc: Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory. After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Destined Death
Set free the remnants of Destined Death, plunging the greatsword into the ground to summon a myriad of blades. In addition to dealing immediate damage, this attack reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a short time.
items.obtain: Maliketh's Black Blade can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
items.desc: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. The favored weapon of the steadfast Carian knight, Moonrithyll. Moonrithyll was the Twin Moon Knight's chamberlain. She was also a friend to the trolls, who served the royal family, and proudly wielded their weapons as she fought arm in arm with her gargantuan comrades.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Tremendous Phalanx
Skill of the enchanted troll knights. Creates a defensive arch of enormous magic glintblades overhead, which automatically attack nearby foes. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.
items.obtain: Moonrithyll's Knight Sword is obtained by defeating Moonrithyl, Carian Knight beyond the Castle Ensis Checkpoint in Castle Ensis.

items.name: Osian's Greatsword
items.desc: Osian, sellsword and right hand of Sulien, was known for his stoicism and effortless technique in the use of this sword. Despite its very large size, the weapon is perfectly balanced and holds its edge against the passage of time.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Osian's Fury
Perform a leaping downward slam attack and then follow up with a another skill attack to perform a powerful spinning swipe.
items.obtain: Osian's Greatsword is obtained from defeating the Godrick Knight in an encampment north of the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave.

items.name: Royal Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword decorated in royal Carian style. Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf. In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof, the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment the oath was sworn.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Wolf's Assault
Infuse the greatsword with frost, then perform a forward somersault to plunge it into the ground. Then, pull it out to release a cold blast.
items.obtain: The Royal Greatsword is obtained after killing Blaidd, either out in the world or at the end of Ranni's quest.

items.name: Ruins Greatsword
items.desc: Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon. One of the legendary armaments. The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbors its destructive power.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Wave of Destruction
Raise the sword up high, then strike it against the ground to fire off a wave of gravitational force.
items.obtain: The Ruins Greatsword is obtained after defeating Dakk, Starcaller Lord in Redmane Castle.

items.name: Starscourge Greatsword
items.desc: Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn. A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif. Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in his youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest upon these blades.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Starcaller Cry
Bring the two swords together and roar into the skies, pulling in enemies with a gravitational wave.
Follow up with an additional input to slam down with gravity-infused swords.
items.obtain: The Starscourge Greatsword can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn. The boss is fought in his arena in the desert behind Redmane Castle.

items.name: Troll Knight's Sword
items.desc: Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.
items.fx:
Skill: Troll's Roar
Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.
items.obtain: The Troll Knight's Sword is obtained in a chest within a tower at the Academy of Raya Lucaria, which can be reached by jumping from the room where you climb up to deactivate the ball.

items.name: Troll's Golden Sword
items.desc: Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago. Though the giants have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape —  such that the gold plating had flaked away.
items.fx:
Skill: Troll's Roar
Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.
items.obtain: The Troll's Golden Sword can be obtained in a carriage west of the Lux Ruins in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
items.desc: Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: The Watchdog's Greatsword can be obtained in a chest behind a seal in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, located in Caelid.

items.name: Zweihander
items.desc: Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging. True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so. The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.
items.fx:
Skill: Stamp
Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks.
Follow up with a light attack for a sweeping strike or follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.
items.obtain: The Zweihander is obtained in a chest guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head, located near the Morne Armory in Castle Morne.

items.name: Antspur Rapier
items.desc: Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot. Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Antspur Rapier is found on a corpse in one of the Giant Ant nests in the Ainsel River.

items.name: Carian Sorcery Sword
items.fx:
Carian Sorcery Sword
One of the Carian royal family's glintstone swords... functions as a catalyst for glintstone sorcery when executing strong attacks.

Stats
- Base Damage: 81 Magic
- Crit Damage: 130%

Skill
Carian Grandeur: Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase power.
items.obtain: Castle Ensis – Found in a chest on the roof. Access by jumping off the cliffs behind the Ensis Belfry in Scadu Altus onto the rooftops.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight's Sword
items.desc: Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long-handled armament.
items.fx:
The Cleanrot Knight's Sword can be powerstanced with the Cleanrot Spear or the Halo Scythe. When powerstanced with the spear, it uses the powerstanced spear moveset, and when powerstanced with the scythe, it uses the powerstanced reaper moveset.

Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Cleanrot Knight's Sword can be obtained from a cellar in the Street of Sages Ruins, located in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid.

items.name: Estoc
items.desc: Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks. For its large size, it can be wielded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Estoc can be purchased from Patches after he moves to the Scenic Isle site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes, or it is always sold by the Nomadic Merchant in South Liurnia.

items.name: Foil of Caddock
items.desc: The sidesword of Big Boggart's companion, who suffered a horrific fate while incarcerated. Its serrated blade rends terrible wounds, causing excessive bleeding.
items.fx:
Skill: Repeating Thrust
Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.
items.obtain: The Foil of Caddock is sold by Boggart in the Leyndell Outer Moat, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Frozen Needle
items.desc: A razor-thin piercing blade of ice. Forged by Iji, the Carian Royal Blacksmith. Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack. The blade immediately regenerates.
items.fx:
Skill: Chilling Mist
Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards.
The armament retains its frost for a while.
items.obtain: The Frozen Needle is obtained from a chest after defeating the Royal Revenant in the Kingsrealm Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Huntress's Estoc
items.desc: A sturdy branch of the forest from the Siofra River, treated into a fine blade by the followers of the Ancestral Spirit. Flowing waters propogate sentience throughout the inhabitants of the underground, imbuing them with spiritual energy.
items.fx:
Can be powerstanced with Spear of the Dreaming

Vapor-fly Ignition
Skill that emits volatile vapor-flies in a wide frontward arc.
Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike that detonates the vapor-flies early
items.obtain: Dropped from Mystic Huntress in Liurnia.

items.name: Noble's Estoc
items.desc: Estoc carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield. Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Noble's Estoc is sold by the Nomadic Merchant of Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Quicksilver Rapier
items.desc: A flowing weapon of the Nox. This rapier's touch strikes with a subtle curse that increases the magic damage that affected enemies receive by 5% for a short duration.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Flowing Piercer
Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form.
Swing the armament like a whip to perform a piercing thrust in front of you.
items.obtain: Noxumbra, Forsaken City

items.name: Rapier
items.desc: A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade. In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield. As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrusts are easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Rapier is sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Rogier's Rapier
items.desc: Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation. Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier. High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Carian Grandeur
Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill.
Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down.
Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels.
items.obtain: Rogier's Rapier is obtained at the Roundtable Hold; it is either given by Rogier after defeating Godrick the Grafted or can be collected from his corpse after he dies.

items.name: Thorn of the Guilty
items.desc: An oversized briar thorn, grown from the bloody acts of the guilty. A mysterious actuation of the Blood Star.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Telekinetic Vortex
Channel the profaned power of telekinesis to spin the sword in midair, building momentum before slamming the blade down onto the ground.
This skill can be charged to increase its power.
items.obtain: The Thorn of the Guilty can be found behind a tree next to several Jellyfish near Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Bloody Helice
items.desc: Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade. Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood. Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Dynast's Finesse
Nimbly avoid an attack, securing some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a sudden lunge, and press strong attack again to perform a sweeping slice.
items.obtain: The Bloody Helice is found in a chest behind the boss room of the Writheblood Ruins, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Carwyn’s Épée
items.desc: Carwyn, accomplished duelist and left hand of Sulien, was known for his speed and precision. This large thrusting sword exemplifies his mastery with both piercing and edged combat styles.
items.fx:
Carwyn's Épée is a Heavy Thrusting Sword found in Castle Morne and is a notable weapon for Rogue and Sellsword.

Unique Skill: Carwyn's Bladestorm
