Deals a three piece slashing attack (left, right, left). A follow up skill performs a lunging forward thrust similar to Piercing Fang.
items.obtain: Seaworn Key: From the Western Lookout Tower grace, head northeast, jump down towards the rocks in the ocean. Complete the parkour of the rocks to an island with a tree, where the key is in the bushes. Carwyn's Épée: From the Western Lookout Tower grace, head southwest over the bridge and up the mountain to open the chest which can be unlocked with the Seaworn Key.

items.name: Dragon King's Cragblade
items.desc: Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning. A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance. This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Thundercloud Form
Temporarily transform into a red thundercloud and fly through the air, then plunge down with a lightning-infused blade. Hold to increase the reach of the thundercloud form.
items.obtain: The Dragon King's Cragblade can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Dragonlord Placidusax. The boss, Dragonlord Placidusax, is located at the bottom of Farum Azula, past Ancient Dragon Lansseax.

items.name: Godskin Stitcher
items.desc: Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles. The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Godskin Stitcher is obtained by defeating the Godskin Noble in the Temple of Eiglay at Volcano Manor.

items.name: Great Épée
items.desc: Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade. Commonly used in life or death duels. Like its smaller counterparts, it is made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Great Epee is found in a chest in Limgrave. It is located in a camp guarded by Kaiden Raiders, Nobles, and Soldiers of Godrick, positioned east of the Agheel Lake South site of grace and northeast of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

items.name: Queelign's Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword of the Fire Knight Queelign. A weighty piercing sword with a blade that undulates like fire. Queelign devoted his all to the crusade, and remade his greatsword in the shape of the lance wielded by his liege—aspiring to become a second Impaler.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: Queelign's Greatsword is obtained by using the Iris of Occulation on Fire Knight Queelign in a locked prayer room within the Sunken Chapel of the Shadow Keep. Queelign moves to this location after invading the player twice, at which point he will drop the key required to access the room.

items.name: Sword Lance
items.desc: Weapon once wielded by Commander Gaius. A combination of greatsword and lance. Weighty and capable of being brought to bear with great force, this armament shows its true potential when used astride a mount. Gaius himself was never without his boar.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Sword Lance can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia in the Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Gaius. Defeating Commander Gaius in the arena in front of the Shadow Keep, Back Gate site of grace will unlock the weapon for purchase.

items.name: Bandit's Curved Sword
items.desc: Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade. Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering. Most of the blade is now darkened and covered in rust, but with enough dexterity this weapon may still stand up to some use.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Found in Earthbore Cave.

items.name: Beastman's Curved Sword
items.desc: Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Beastman's Curved Sword can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant located southwest of the Southern Aeonian Swamp Bank in Caelid for 2,000 runes.

items.name: Blade of Scarlet Bloom
items.desc: The training sword of young Malenia while under the tutelage of the sword master in blue, now housing the rotten presence of the Sealed God.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Aeonian Rush
Assume the stance of the dancing warrior in blue and then rush forward and perform two sweeping slashes.
The last strike produces an upwelling of aeonian rot.
items.obtain: The Blade of Scarlet Bloom is located up a ladder on a platform south-east of the Lake of Rot Overlook site of grace in the Lake of Rot.

items.name: Dancing Blade of Ranah
items.desc: Decorative swords ablaze with impassioned red. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Used by the dancers of Ranah. Strikes enemies with a dancing assault when executing a strong attack.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Unending Dance
A furious dance formed by a succession of slashing attacks. Hold the button down to sustain the dance for as long as stamina allows.
items.obtain: The Dancing Blade of Ranah is obtained by defeating the Dancer of Ranah in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum, located in the Cerulean Coast.

items.name: Eclipse Shotel
items.desc: Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments. In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.
items.fx:
Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and ignores 5% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Unique Skill: Death Flare
Set the lusterless sun ablaze with the Prince of Death's flames, inflicting the death ailment upon foes.
Follow up with an additional input to bring down the armament, triggering an explosion.
items.obtain: The Eclipse Shotel is found near an altar in Castle Sol, located in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Falchion
items.desc: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Falchion can be purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave for 800 runes.

items.name: Flowing Curved Sword
items.desc: Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water. Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Flowing Curved Sword is found on a stone pillar at the base level of the Lake of Rot, located south of the "Lake of Rot Shoreside" site of grace.

items.name: Falx
items.desc: Curved swords with long, sickle-like blades. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Forged by a hornsent in the name of revenge. "In vengeance for the flames, my blade I wield..."
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Revenger's Blade
Dash up to an enemy and slash them open with the blades held in each hand. By holding down the button, the initial dash will be extended. Follow up with strong attack to hack the enemy to pieces.
items.obtain: The Falx can be obtained through several scenarios involving the Hornsent: * Invading and defeating the Hornsent in the Main Gate Plaza as part of Leda's Quest. * Defeating the Hornsent in the Leda and allies boss fight in Enir-Ilim. * Defeating the Hornsent during an invasion near the Church of the Bud in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, which only occurs if you summoned him for the Messmer the Impaler boss fight.

items.name: Fingerslayer Blade
items.desc: This blood-drenched fetish can be used as a curved sword or a backhand blade. It is proof of the high treason committed by the Eternal City and symbolizes its downfall.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Finger Severer
Lunge forward through the shadows to slice foes leaving behind a fine quicksilver mist. This attack can be repeatedly performed. Charge to augment the attack and hold to detonate all quicksilver mists in the area, causing damage to enemies.
items.obtain: Given after returning the Fingerslayer Blade quest item to Ranni.

items.name: Godskin Flayer
items.desc: Wielded by a matriarch of the current age, this weapon is ideal for carving and removing skin from both humans and gods alike. Having been infused with a fraction of the rune of death, the blade now emits the red flames of the Godslayers of antiquity.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Godslayer Ascension
Tap the skill attack to conjure an ethereal blade in your left hand and perform a series of slashing attacks with two additional skill follow ups. Charge to fire an arc of holy energy causing damage over time.
items.obtain: The Godskin Flayer is sold by Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 5,000 runes after defeating the Godskin Matriarch. The Godskin Matriarch is located at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia, which is accessible after inverting the Carian Study Hall.

items.name: Grossmesser
items.desc: Curved sword boasting a large blade. This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge. A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Grossmesser is found on a corpse in the Deeproot Depths, located just after the room filled with ant queens.

items.name: Horned Warrior's Sword
items.desc: Curved sword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Horn Calling
Invokes tangled horns to cover the weapon's blade. Drive the weapon into the ground, calling up a cluster of piercing horns.
items.obtain: The Horned Warrior's Sword is obtained by defeating the Horned Warrior who guards the north section of the poison swamp area in Belurat, Tower Settlement.

items.name: Magma Blade
items.desc: Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir. An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made. Deals fire damage.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Magma Shower
Slash at foes in a twirling motion while scattering magma all around.
Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Magma Blade is found after completing the "Flightless Bird" painting puzzle. The painting itself can be found in the lower Fortified Manor in Leyndell, and the painter's spirit can be found near the top of Dominula, Windmill Village in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Mantis Blade
items.desc: A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers. The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Mantis Blade is obtained after defeating the Cemetery Shade in the Gelmir Hero's Grave, located in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Nomad's Kilij
items.desc: The weapon of choice for those formerly of the Great Caravan, this curved sword houses the maddened spirits of those that suffered beneath the earth and the flames they turned to for vengeance.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Succumb to Madness
Plunge the blade into your body, unlocking the maddening flames within and causing tendrils of frenzy fly out in all directions.
When you pull it out, it causes a large explosion. Increases all fire damage you deal by 5% for 1 minute.
items.obtain: The Nomad's Kilij is obtained after defeating Shabriri's Chosen in the frenzy flame containment zone evergaol on the west coast of Castle Morne Town.

items.name: Nox Flowing Sword
items.desc: A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle. Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Flowing Form
Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form.
Swing the armament like a whip to perform a sweeping slice over a wide area.
items.obtain: The Nox Flowing Sword is found in a chest after defeating the Twin Nox bosses in Sellia, Town of Sorcery. To unlock the seal to the boss room, you must light the brazier located in the northwest of Sellia.

items.name: Scavengers Curved Sword
items.desc: Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth. Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles. The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Scavenger's Curved Sword is obtained from a corpse under a broken wagon near the Grafted Scion ambush found north of the Gelmir Hero's Grave in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Scimitar
items.desc: A curved sword with a single-sided blade. Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales. Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Scimitar can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes.

items.name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
items.desc: Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir. Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Serpent-God's Curved Sword is found on a corpse located behind the giant land octopus on an roof opposite the two Winged Dames guarding the lift near the top of the Ruin-Strewn Precipice in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Shamshir
items.desc: Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length. Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession. A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Shamshir can be found on the central platform in the main cavern of the Highroad Cave in Limgrave.

items.name: Shotel
items.desc: Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield effectively.
items.fx:
Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and ignores 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Shotel is sold by the Abandoned Merchant in the Lower Siofra River for 2,500 runes.

items.name: Spirit Sword
items.desc: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A sword that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rancor Slash
Spin around, slashing foes while summoning vengeful spirits which chase down foes. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Spirit Sword is found on a deceased Demi-Human in the ravine northwest of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace, located in the Cerulean Coast.

items.name: Wing Of Astel
items.desc: Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars. Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light. Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.
items.fx:
Skill: Nebula
Imbue the Naturalborn's wings with magic to send forth a dark cloud of stars that lingers briefly before exploding.
items.obtain: The Wing of Astel is found in a chest behind the Malformed Star, which can be reached from the Ainsel River Main site of grace in the Ainsel River.

items.name: Zephyr Blades
items.desc: A pair of twin curved swords enchanted with the power of storms. An ancient relic of Stormveil, crafted an age before the Shattering.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Wind Dance
Disperse your body into the air just above you and then rematerialize to perform a double slash attack from above, follow up with a strong attack to perform another airborne slash and then follow up with another skill attack to perform a final overhead attack.
items.obtain: The Zephyr Blades can be found in front of a statue in a room adjacent to the Grafted Scion in Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Beastman's Cleaver
items.desc: Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula. The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.
items.fx:
Skill: Lion's Claw
Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn.
Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament.
items.obtain: The Beastman's Cleaver is obtained after defeating the Beastman of Farum Azula boss in the Dragonbarrow Cave, located in Caelid.

items.name: Bloodhound's Fang
items.desc: Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights. A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Bloodhound's Finesse
Slash upwards with the Bloodhound's Fang, using the momentum of the strike to perform a backwards somersault and gain some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform the Bloodhound's Step attack.
items.obtain: The Bloodhound's Fang is obtained by defeating Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Bloodhounds Evergaol, located in Limgrave.

items.name: Demi-Dragon Cleaver
items.desc: Curved greatsword of the dragonoid test subjects of Noxumbra. Serrated and brutish, the tooth-like blade causes excessive bleeding.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.

Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Noxumbra, Forsaken City

items.name: Dismounter
items.desc: This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blade of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet. A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Found in the Kaiden Warrior camp north of Lake Agheel.

items.name: Freyja's Greatsword
items.desc: Weapon of Freyja, a Redmane. Greatsword decorated with a mane, much like the weapons used by her liege. The spirit of Freyja's training lingers in this sword, enhancing the power of Redmane battle skills.
items.fx:
Skill: Savage Lion's Claw
Skill of the particularly brave, even among the Redmanes. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament. An additional strike may be performed with an additional input.
items.obtain: Freyja's Greatsword can be obtained in the following ways: * It is found on Redmane Freyja's corpse in Enir-Ilim after completing her questline and defeating her in the Leda and Co. fight. * It can be found in the Shadow Keep where Redmane Freyja stands near the fireplace reading a stone tablet, provided her quest is not advanced enough by the time the sealing tree is burnt.

items.name: Galvanic Culling Blade
items.desc: A small-handled twinblade, capable of splitting into a duel-wielded backhand dagger and a greatsword. Originally made as a scientific instrument for the extraction of quicksilver from living hosts, the weapon now contains tremendous galvanic energy.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Galvanic Extraction
Twinblade Form: Lunge forward and perform a piercing thrust then follow-up with another skill attack to leap upwards and bring the blade down on the target.

Greatsword and Dagger Form: Perform a cross-bladed slash that propels you backwards then follow-up with another skill attack to perform a leaping somersault, slashing with both blades imbued with frozen lightning
items.obtain: Noxumbra, Eternal City

items.name: Hefty Scimitar
items.desc: A curved blade of considerable size whose keen edge is only made more deadly by its imposing weight. This curved greatsword demands both strength and dexterity of its wielder, rewarding those capable of mastering it with great, sweeping slashes that mow through multiple foes at once.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.

Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Found in a chest in Highroad Cave.

items.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
items.desc: Curved greatsword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. A heavy weapon made to bring the deft strength of the warriors to bear. The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Tempest Cleave
Call a small tempest in front of you that will strike enemies, follow up with another input to invoke tangled horns to cover the weapon's blade and strike downward. Tarnished enemies will be gripped by the tempest and thrown into the air before being struck by a downward attack sending them back to the earth.
items.obtain: The Horned Warrior's Greatsword is dropped by the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior who patrols the rampart just before the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace in Enir-Ilim.

items.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
items.desc: Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales. It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Magma Guillotine
Grab the scalesword with both hands, as a wyrm would hold it in its mouth, and leap forwards, smashing it into the ground and triggering a blast of magma. Follow up with an additional input to perform a chopping attack.
items.obtain: The Magma Wyrm's Scalesword is obtained after defeating Magma Wyrm Makar in the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Monk's Flameblade
items.desc: Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Giantsflame Arc
Raise the blade above you to infuse it with destructive giantsflame. While active, the blade deals additional fire damage and heavy attacks will release a powerful arc of flames in front of you.
items.obtain: The Monk's Flameblade is found on a corpse in the armory of Fort Laeidd in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
items.desc: Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King. The accursed blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Cursed-Blood Slice
Brace, then charge forward to deliver a downward diagonal slice.
The bloody trail of the blade is followed by a burst of flame.
Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Morgott's Cursed Sword is sold by Finger Reader Enia in the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Morgott, the Omen King. Morgott is found at the end of Leyndell, Royal Capital, at the Elden Throne.

items.name: Omen Cleaver
items.desc: Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength. The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: East Altus - Outer Wall Graveyard. Dropped by the Blighted Omen minor erdtree waygate boss.

items.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
items.desc: Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic. A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Onyx Lord's Repulsion
Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack sends enemies flying away.
items.obtain: The Onyx Lord's Greatsword can be found in the basement of the Woodfolk Ruins in the Blighted Forest, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Three Finger Blade
items.desc: A melted blade adorned with marks left by massive fingerprints, glowing with perpetual heat. Many untold champions have fallen to the whispers of Shabriri– Perhaps this blade belonged to one of them.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Shabriri's Revenge
Charge forward with the blade dragging behind you covered in frenzy flame, then sweep upwards sending tendrils of frenzy in front of you.
Follow up with a strong attack to leap into the air and plunge the blade down into the ground and then pull it out, causing a large maddening explosion.
items.obtain: From the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace, head north to the edge of the cliffs and look down into the nearby ruins for a room with a giant rat and a chest. Jump down carefully into the ruins and proceed to that chest for the weapon.

items.name: Zamor Curved Sword
items.desc: Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants. In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Zamor Ice Storm
Plunge the curved sword into the ground, building power before unleashing a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.
items.obtain: The Zamor Curved Sword is obtained by defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Backhand Blade
items.desc: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations. The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Blind Spot
Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.
items.obtain: The Backhand Blade is found in the Gravesite Plains, located northwest of the Scorched Ruins near a small shrine guarded by Hornsent.

items.name: Crescent Moons
items.desc: Circular backhand blades in the shape of crescent moons, imbued with the power of frost. Crafted in the frozen void between worlds, this weapon was a gift made in loyal devotion to an otherworldly sovereign by a knight-retainer. This perhaps speak to the genesis of all frost sorcery.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Moon's Orbit
Infuse the blades with frost for 45 seconds, increasing magic damage and frost buildup.

While active, use the skill to throw both blades forward whichw ill then return to your hands.

Holding the skill will increase range.
items.obtain: Progress through the Fort of Reprimand until you get to the locked gate that prevents you from fighting the boss. Go up the nearest wooden staircase and the ladder on the wall to the left. Go into the nearby tower and continue up two more ladders to the top. Cross the short bridge and head to the right. In the building guarded by a Black Knight, the weapon will be near a painting at the back of the room.

items.name: Curseblade's Cirque
items.desc: Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss. Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Deadly Dance
An aggressive spinning skill that tears into foes using the circular blades held in each hand. Additional input allows for a sharp axe-kick follow-up.
items.obtain: The Curseblade's Cirque is found in a chest within the second cellar of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.

items.name: Reverse-Bladed Sword
items.desc: Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip, said to have originated from the hidden realm of shadow. The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Blind Spot
Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.
items.obtain: Found on a corpse in the poison muck of Stillwater Cave.

items.name: Smithscript Cirque
items.desc: Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory.
items.fx:
Skill: Blind Spot
Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.
items.obtain: The Smithscript Cirque is found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall in Scadu Altus. To obtain it, progress through the dungeon up to the second lever and activate it to reach a circular room where the weapon is located between two Golem Smiths.

items.name: Blade of Distant Light
items.desc: Once an heirloom of a forgotten warrior from the east, fallen first to madness and then lost. The blade is suffused with the unifying flames of frenzy and inflicts madness on those who are touched by its edge.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Dance of Unification
Tap the skill to perform a quick slash or hold to perform a powerful slash that sends out trails of frenzied flame in front of you. Either attack can be followed up with another skill attack to perform a low slash that erupts in a circle of flames. This attack or any initial attack can be followed up with a heavy attack that will perform two vertical slashes that shoot out a pair of flame arc projectiles.
items.obtain: The Blade of Distant Light is obtained in Sarulat, Basin Town. Progress through the town until you unlock the tower shortcut back to the grace, then climb to the top of the tower instead of going down to find the weapon on a headless corpse at the top.

items.name: Dragonscale Blade
items.desc: A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Underworld Conduit
Sheath the weapon causing frozen lightning to imbue it and then perform a double slash attack and then follow up with another skill attack to perform a forward stab that explodes with frozen lightning. While imbued, the weapon has increased lightning damage.
items.obtain: The Dragonscale Blade is dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss found in the Lake of Rot. To reach the boss, head down the hill from the Lake of Rot Shoreside site of grace, then head right upon reaching the lake until you encounter large statues and an archway on your right.

items.name: Hand of Malenia
items.desc: Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot. Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories. Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Waterfowl Dance
Perform a series of one-footed leaps in the manner of a waterfowl to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo.
Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
items.obtain: The Hand of Malenia is sold by Finger Reader Enia in the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella. You can unlock this item for purchase by defeating Malenia, Goddess of Rot, in the arena located in front of the Haligtree Roots site of grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

items.name: Meteoric Ore Blade
items.desc: Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.
items.fx:
Skill: Cleave of Devastation
Infuse the blade with gravitational power and then slice downward, splitting the earth apart in front of you. Charge to augment this ability.
items.obtain: The Meteoric Ore Blade is found in the Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid. To obtain it, proceed through the tunnel and defeat the Fallingstar Beast boss. After exiting the boss room, continue along the path until you reach a room containing cages, where the weapon is located inside a chest.

items.name: Moonveil
items.desc: Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith. Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight
Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance.
Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.
items.obtain: Academy Crystal Cave, defeat the Crystalian Duo (Staff and Spear).

items.name: Nagakiba
items.desc: Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers. Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Unsheathe
Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds.
Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance.
Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.
items.obtain: The Nagakiba can be obtained after Yura's death at his first four locations: northeast of the Seaside Ruins site of grace in some ruins, directly north of Murkwater Cave, east of the Main Academy Gate site of grace, or in the Second Church of Marika. Additionally, if killed after being possessed by Shabriri, the Nagakiba will appear where Yura was standing at the last location you spoke to him.

items.name: Rivers of Blood
items.desc: Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men. When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Corpse Piler
Forms a blade of cursed blood for repeated, interweaving successive attacks. Follow up with an additional input for further successive attacks.
items.obtain: The Rivers of Blood is obtained by defeating Okina outside the Church of Repose in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Serpentbone Blade
items.desc: Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone. The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Virulent Slice
Slash with a poison-infused blade in a wide arc, follow up with another skill attack to perform a second slash.
If either strike lands on a poisoned foe, it will deal significant damage.
items.obtain: The Serpentbone Blade is obtained by defeating Rileigh the Idle, whose invasion sign can be found on the path leading to the Shaded Castle in Mt. Gelmir. The fastest ways to reach this location are via the Erdtree-Gazing Hill or the Old Altus Tunnel.

items.name: Star-Lined Sword
items.desc: Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen. When bestowed with this weapon by their queen, the swordsmen swear to find the truth that lies at the end of the procession of stars.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Onze's Line of Stars
This skill, named after a demi-human swordmaster, imbues sorcerous energy into lined glintstones and executes a slash attack. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks, each dealing greater damage than the last.
items.obtain: Noxumbra, Forsaken City

items.name: Star Shadow
items.desc: A weapon created at the height of the Nox Empire by unknown artisans. Made in the service of a long-forgotten war, the blade still exemplifies a tendency for clandestine acts.
items.fx:
Can be powerstanced with Midnight Dagger. Both weapons will use the katana powerstance moveset when powerstanced in this way.

Unique Skill: Umbral Stance
Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance.
Release the stance to perform a parry. Or follow up with a normal attack to perform an invisible forward slash, or follow up a strong attack to temporarily disappear and strike forward and then release a series of circular slashes around you.
items.obtain: The Star Shadow is obtained by defeating Nox Oracle Sadia in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, located in Caelid.

items.name: Sword of Night
items.desc: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Witching Hour Slash
Hold the sword level and infuse it with the dark of Night before unleashing a series of incorporeal attacks. This attack cannot be blocked. Can be charged to increase its power.
items.obtain: The Sword of Night is obtained by using the Iris of Occultation on Jolán in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, located in Scadu Altus. This interaction requires finishing Ymir's questline and defeating Jolán.

items.name: Uchigatana
items.desc: A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds. The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.
items.fx:
Skill: Unsheathe
Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds.
Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance.
Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.
items.obtain: The Uchigatana is found on a corpse in the Deathtouched Catacombs, located in Limgrave.

items.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
items.desc: Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect. Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.
items.fx:
Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is a Great Katana dropped by Ancient Dragon-Man.

Unique Skill: Dragonwound Slash
Designed to hunt colossal dragons, this skill cloaks the armament with a jagged gravel-stone aura before performing a high leaping slash. Charge the attack to also fire off the aura.
items.obtain: Dropped by the Ancient Dragon-Man in the Dragon Pit.

items.name: Eagle's Edge
items.desc: A great katana of unique design, once wrought by the Tempestcallers exiled by the Erdtree. A weapon considered heretical to the Golden Order, it was once a great boon to the forces of Stormveil.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Storm's Reckoning
Perform a nimble dance backwards while imbuing the blade with swirling winds before slashing forward in front of you, follow up with another skill attack to perform a sweeping attack and then unleashing a burst of wind from your hand.
items.obtain: The Eagle's Edge is found inside a chest beside the chapel in the Chapel of Anticipation, where it is guarded by a Warhawk. You can access the Chapel of Anticipation via the Four Belfries.

items.name: Great Katana
items.desc: Large katana with a long, heavy blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.
items.fx:
Skill: Overhead Stance
A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.
items.obtain: The Great Katana is obtained from a corpse next to a slumbering Ghostflame Dragon near the Abandoned Ailing Village in the Gravesite Plains.

items.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana
items.desc: A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours. A berserker's weapon used to endure enemy attacks and reply with one's full fury.
items.fx:
When attacking, the wielder is less likely to stagger from counterattacks, but will also take increased damage.

Unique Skill: Weed Cutter
Performs scythe-like horizontal swings with the sword, cutting men down as if they were weeds. Additional inputs allow for the continuation of the attack for as long as stamina remains.
items.obtain: Rakshasa's Great Katana is obtained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum, located in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Reaver's Odachi
items.desc: Led by Okina, a group of bandits arrived in the Lands Between drawn by the allure of blood. This weapon’s length makes it ideal for engaging with enemies from a distance.
items.fx:
Reaver's Odachi is a Great Katana found in Fort Faroth and is a notable weapon for Vanguard and Retainer.

Unique Skill: Heart Piercer
Performs a lunging forward thrust. A follow up heavy attack performs a low sweeping slash.
items.obtain: Found on a corpse on a wooden platform on a watchtower in Fort Faroth.

items.name: Reed Great Katana
items.desc: A curved blade of considerable size whose keen edge is only made more deadly by its imposing weight. This curved greatsword demands both strength and dexterity of its wielder, rewarding those capable of mastering it with great, sweeping slashes that mow through multiple foes at once.
items.fx:
Skill: Overhead Stance
A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.
items.obtain: Found on a corpse atop the ruins above Yura near the Seaside Ruins grace, south of Agheel Lake.

items.name: Black Steel Twinblade
items.desc: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Black Steel Twinblade is dropped by a twinblade-wielding Black Knight located northeast of the Church of the Crusade in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Caimar's Battlestaff
items.desc: Battlestaff of Caimar the Spiritshaper, high mystic of Siofra. Wielded as a twinblade, this oaken staff carries the energies of enumerable spirits transposed as vapor.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Spiritshaper's Resplendence
Perform an acrobatic forward assault that can be followed up with another skill attack to perform a leaping downward strike, this attack and the inital attack can be followed up with a heavy attack to perform a forward lunging slide. The initial skill input can be charged.
items.obtain: Caimar's Battlestaff is sold by Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Spiritshaper Caimar.

items.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
items.desc: Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger. Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Bloodblade Dance
Leap at foe to perform a flurry of tornado-like attacks.
Follow up with an additional input to perform an attack that ends in an evasive maneuver.
items.obtain: Eleonora's Poleblade is obtained after defeating the Violet Bloody Finger, Eleonora, in the Altus Plateau. For Eleonora to appear, Yura must be dead, which can occur by any means.

items.name: Euphoria
items.desc: Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower. Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Euporia Vortex
Using the power of the vortex, violently twirl the armament, dealing multiple slashes directly ahead. The greater the restored luster of the blades, the greater the power of this skill. However, use of this skill will fully consume the blades' luster.
items.obtain: To obtain Euporia, begin at the Spiral Rise site of grace in Enir-Ilim and head down the stairs. Locate the staircase on your left, turn down it, and then turn right. Proceed through the archways onto a platform, drop down onto the next staircase, and head up. Continue straight to drop onto a platform, then follow the ledges southeast before dropping to a lower set. Jump to the tower's exterior, travel around to the left, drop down to the staircase, and head down. Turn right and jump through the window to enter Belurat. From there, continue through the hallway to the open area, turn right, and take the lift down. Proceed through the room with the Inquisitors, head down the stairs past the Divine Beast Warrior, continue down the following set of stairs, and take the next lift. The weapon is located on a corpse in the room directly ahead.

items.name: Frozen Twinshards
items.desc: A twinblade of ancient origin, crafted by powerful frost magic. While the snow witches did not wield such vulgar weaponry themselves, they were known to arm those that they deemed as worthy protectors.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Whirling Iceblades
Channel frost magic to suspend the twinblade in mid air and cause it to spin horizontally.
Those it touches will suffer successive magic attacks that build frostbite.
items.obtain: The Frozen Twinshards are found in a chest located on a cliff you can jump to from the upper part of the rise near the Albinauric Rise in the Consecrated Snowfields.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
items.desc: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Death Cyclone
Spin the weapon while rotating your body to generate a whirling cyclone of destined death and then perform a lateral sweep that bursts as a crimson shockwave around you. This skill afflicts enemies with destined death. You are less likely to stagger while performing this skill.
items.obtain: The Gargoyle's Black Blades are obtained by defeating the Black Blade Kindred near the Grand Lift of Rold in the Forbidden Lands.

items.name: Gargoyle's Twinblades
items.desc: Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Valiant Cyclone
Spin the weapon while rotating your body to generate a whirling cyclone and then perform a lateral sweep that bursts as a wind shockwave around you. You are less likely to stagger while performing this skill.
items.obtain: The Gargoyle's Twinblade is obtained by defeating a Valiant Gargoyle on the stairs past the Tree Sentinel Duo outside of Leyndell in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Gilded Quarterstaff
items.desc: A strong wooden staff with gold-shod tips. This weapon strikes with powerful concussive force and its light weight allows for nuanced acrobatic techniques.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Vaulting Strike
Perform a backflip kick that can guard break enemies. Charge the skill to unleash a mighty staff slam, and then use a heavy attack after the backflip or the slam to propel forwards in a low sweep.
items.obtain: The Gilded Quarterstaff is found on a corpse in the graveyard north of the Church of Vows, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Godskin Peeler
items.desc: Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh. Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Whirling Black Flames
Perform a wide double spinning slash of black flame, follow up with another skill attack to perform a downward aerial triple somersault slash on foes.
items.obtain: The Godskin Peeler is obtained by defeating the Godskin Apostle in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Godwyn's Cragblades
items.desc: The weapon that Godwyn the Golden took into battle. This abnormally long twinblade is crafted of golden gravelstone, showing the unification of the Dragon Cult. A fearsome symbol of the supremacy of the golden lineage.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Call to Thunder
Lift the twinblade into the air to imbue with lightning, increasing lightning affinity damage for a short time.
While affected, perform a heavy attack to call thunderbolts down upon foe and follow up to fire a lightning spear toward foes.
items.obtain: Godwyn's Cragblades are dropped by Dragon Cultist Seki in the storage room beneath the "Avenue Balcony" Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Palm-Ax Twinblades
items.desc: A double-headed polearm with large fan-shaped blades. Thought to be from a distant kingdom, this weapon slices through flesh with ease but requires great finesse to wield effectively..
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Whirling Slice
Perform a sequence of three spinning slash attacks while moving forward.
items.obtain: The Palm-Ax Twinblade is obtained by defeating the Grave Warden Duelist located in the Auriza Side Tomb in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Sulien's Razors
items.desc: Sulien, a sellsword of great renown, was said to have kissed the hand of Queen Marika after he and his company defeated a rebellious host from the east during the early wars of the Erdtree.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Sulien's Mastery
Perform a whirling lateral attack, striking enemies multiple times. Follow up to perform a vertical spinning attack.
items.obtain: Sulien's Razors are obtained by defeating the Twisted Abductor in the Fortified Manor courtyard, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Twinblade
items.desc: A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Twinblade is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes. An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks. The Twinned Knight Swords are found on a burning corpse among the dancing Celebrants in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Twinned Knight Swords
items.desc: An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way. Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Twinned Knight Swords are found on a burning corpse among dancing Celebrants in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Axe of Epiphany
items.desc: A stout double-bladed axe, forged of gold. A weapon crafted for the now defunct Tree Sentinel Infantry. Named in reverence to the epiphany of Queen Marika that brought about the first Golden Order orthodoxy.
items.fx:
Skill: Golden Vow
Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense.
items.obtain: The Axe of Epiphany is found on a corpse on the Divine Bridge of Leyndell, situated on the path leading towards the Mountaintops in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Axe of Fell Prophecy
items.desc: A weapon crafted by the fire prelates using heretical techniques. As guardians of the flame, it was inevitable that they, like all others that dare meddle in the fell prophecy, would succumb to its allure.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Scorched Earth
Lift the axe aloft as it becomes wrapped in giantsflame.
Then bring it crashing down, sending out a wave of flame pillars erupting from the ground before you.
items.obtain: The Axe of Fell Prophecy can be found near the beginning of the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Battle Axe
items.desc: A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Battle Axe can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 800 runes.

items.name: Bloodflame Kamas
items.desc: A pair of sickle-like light axes tainted with the power of tainted blood. Once held by a nameless warrior from the Land of Reeds, this weapon speaks to the extent of the blood corruption that has overtaken that distant land.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Cull the Sacrifice
Throw one of the kamas at a foe in front of you and then follow up with another skill attack to perform a sweeping lunge. The bloody trail of the blade is followed by a burst of flame.
items.obtain: The Bloodflame Kamas are obtained after defeating the invader Sanguine Noble in the Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Bloodhound Hookblade
items.desc: A steel hand-axe tainted with blood with a distinctive shape. Part of the original kit of the order of Bloodhound Knights. This weapon has mostly fallen out of use among them, now replaced in favor of hooked claws.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Bloodhound Assault
Perform an invisible leaping slam attack. Charge to perform a slicing combo that can be followed up with a strong attack to perform a double uppercut slice, that can then be followed up with a skill attack to perform an invisible downward slam.
items.obtain: The Bloodhound Hookblade is found at the end of the path east of the sigil from the Main Academy Gate in the Academy of Raya Lucaria, where it is guarded by a Bloodhound Knight.

items.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
items.desc: Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Celebrant's Cleaver is found on a corpse guarded by a few Dominula Dancers, located by heading southeast down the path from the Windmill Village site of grace in the Altus Plateau until you reach more windmills.

items.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
items.desc: Golden war axes of the Death Knight. A pair of weapons made to be wielded in both hands. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Twinaxe
From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed. Strong attack performs a lightning-charged spinning slash.
items.obtain: Dropped by Aled, Knight of Godwyn in Deeproot Depths.

items.name: Forked Hatchet
items.desc: Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Forked Hatchet is found on the floor of the ruins closest to the Central Altus Minor Erdtree site of grace, which is part of the Woodfolk Ruins in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet
items.desc: A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon. The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Forked-Tongue Hatchet is found on a corpse inside the Fog Rift Catacombs in the Rauh Ruins, located in the chamber to the right of the first encounter with a Big-Mouthed Imp as you progress through the catacomb.

items.name: Glintstone Cleaver
items.desc: Made at the same time as the Glintstone Kris, this axe was not gifted to Leyndell but retained by the Carians, fearful that if their newfound truce were to break, that this weapon might be used against them with terrible results.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Primeval Cascade
Lift into the air as the axe charges with energy and then cleave three times, each sending out an arc of glint energy.
Follow up with a strong attack to send another glint arc and finally plant the axe head into the ground causing an upheaval of power.
items.obtain: The Glintstone Cleaver is found in the Altus Tunnel in the Altus Plateau. To obtain it, proceed through the first few doorways until you reach the first large crystal tunnel; then, ascend the stairs on the left side, take a left, and the weapon will be located in a small tunnel.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.desc: Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool. Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Hand Axe can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes.

items.name: Highland Axe
items.desc: Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands. Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.
items.fx:
Skill: War Cry
Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
items.obtain: The Highland Axe can be found in front of a painting in a room containing a Grafted Scion within Stormveil Castle. The easiest way to access it is from the Eastern Parapet site of grace; jump down onto the courtyard, then head southeast through the small room to find the weapon in front of you.

items.name: Icerind Hatchet
items.desc: A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north. Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.
items.fx:
Skill: Hoarfrost Stomp
Stomp hard to unleash a freezing burst around you, follow up with another skill attack to perform a low sweep kick that spreads a trail of freezing spikes on the ground. This attack applies a frost status effect.
items.obtain: The Icerind Hatchet is found in a chest within a sunken-in tower, located by heading southeast from the Temple Quarter site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Iron Cleaver
items.desc: Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten. Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Iron Cleaver can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 1,500 runes.

items.name: Jawbone Axe
items.desc: Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal. This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Jawbone Axe is obtained by heading south from the Worshippers' Woods site of grace in the Lower Siofra River, using the spirit spring to ascend, and proceeding to the end of the bridge where the weapon is located.

items.name: Messmer Soldier's Axe
items.desc: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use. A favorite of those who lost themselves utterly in their lord's war. Capable of performing powerful charge attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: War Cry
Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
items.obtain: The Messmer Soldier's Axe is found inside a tent southwest of the Castle Front site of grace in the Gravesite Plain.

items.name: Rimeheart
items.desc: An axe and shield considered sacred to the elusive coven of snow witches, the blade coated in frost. Once wielded by barbaric men of the north, sworn to the service of the witches, it was often wondered if their implacable loyalty was freely given or the result of some meddling sorcery
items.fx:
Skill: Ice Fling
Imbue the axe with frozen power and throw it forward toward foes, the axe then is reconjured into your hand.
items.obtain: Rimeheart is obtained after defeating Borealis the Freezing Fog in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Ripple Blade
items.desc: Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species. Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Ripple Blade is sold by Pidia, Carian Servant for 3,500 runes. He is encountered via normal progression through Caria Manor.

items.name: Rosus' Axe
items.desc: Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe. The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need of a guiding hand.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rosus's Summons
Raise the axe aloft to summon those lost in death. Three skeletons will appear at a distance and attack in tandem before vanishing.
items.obtain: Rosus' Axe is found inside the Black Knife Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes. From the site of grace, proceed down the first flight of stairs, turn left, and head down another flight of stairs; the weapon is located in a room to your left, guarded by two skeletons.

items.name: Sacrificial Axe
items.desc: Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity. The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Sacrificial Axe is dropped by the Deathbird located near the small cliffs shortly before reaching Castle Morne in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Smithscript Axe
items.desc: Axe engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or jumping strong attack to throw the axe.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Smithscript Axe is found inside Taylew's Ruined Forge in Scadu Altus. It is located on a corpse in a chamber accessed by jumping over a section of ruined flooring after descending the first ladder.

items.name: Stormhawk Axe
items.desc: Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth. Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Thunderstorm
Imbue the armament's wing-blade with lightning and swing it around to create a tempestuous lightning storm. Follow up with an additional input to perform up to two spinning attacks.
The lightning will stay on the blade for a while.
items.obtain: The Stormhawk Axe can be obtained in the following ways: *   **Castle Sol:** From the Castle Sol Main Gate site of grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants, head left into the castle and climb the ladder on the left side of the path. Follow the path, pass the second ballista, and hop over the eastern railing to find the weapon guarded by a Warhawk. *   **Stormveil Castle:** Killing Nepheli Loux northeast of the Liftside Chamber site of grace will grant you two of the weapon. *   **Village of the Albinaurics:** Killing Nepheli Loux east of the Village of the Albinaurics site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes will grant you two of the weapon. *   **Roundtable Hold:** Progressing far enough into the game that you've burned the Erdtree without talking to Nepheli will result in two of the weapon being on the floor at her location outside Gideon's Study.

items.name: Warped Axe
items.desc: Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance. Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.
items.fx:
Skill: War Cry
Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
items.obtain: The Warped Axe is obtained in Leyndell, Royal Capital. From the Leyndell Catacombs site of grace, head southeast to take an elevator. In the room with three spirit crossbowmen, proceed to the two illusory walls located next to the stairs; the first is in the archway closest to the stairs, and the second is forward and left from the first. The weapon is found past the second wall, next to a Spiritcaller Snail.

items.name: Axe of Godrick
items.desc: Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage. "I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Twister Shot
Conjure a small tornado on the axe and launch it forward along the ground toward foes.
Can be fired in rapid succession.
items.obtain: The Axe of Godrick is sold by Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating Godrick the Grafted. Godrick the Grafted is found at the end of Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Axe of Rust
items.desc: An axe of a long forgotten hero from a far away land, left underground to rust. Despite its poor maintenance, this weapon remains well-weighted and sharply edged.
items.fx:
As of version 2.1.1, this is the only weapon that originated from the *Dark Souls 3* Convergence mod that has been brought over to the *Elden Ring* Convergence mod.

Unique Skill: Titanic Cleave
Slowly lift the axe above your head and gain additional poise, then bring the axe crashing down with incredible force, sending out a shockwave in all directions.
items.obtain: The Axe of Rust is found on a corpse behind a gate in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, guarded by two omens.

items.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
items.desc: Weapon of the greater potentates of Bonny Village. An outsize butcher's cleaver used to dismember human bodies in the making of the great jars stored in the gaols. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Hone Blade
Perform a stroking action to sharpen blade, honing its cutting edge and increasing amount of HP recovered. The greater potentates treasure the tools of their practice.
items.obtain: The Bonny Butchering Knife is found on a corpse lying in the corner of a hut in Bonny Village, located in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Butchering Knife
items.desc: Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden. Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Butchering Knife is obtained by defeating Anastasia, Tarnished Eater at the Corpse-Stench Shack in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Crescent Moon Axe
items.desc: Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.
items.fx:
Skill: War Cry
Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
items.obtain: The Crescent Moon Axe is sold by the Nomadic Merchant located near the Bellum Church in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Crystalline Claw
items.desc: The claw of a giant crab coated in a crystal shell, now used as a greataxe. Crabs of this kind are believed to have developed their hardend crystaline exterior from devouring the glintstone crystal fragments strewn across Liurnia.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Crystal Pincer
Retract the claw and snap it shut on a foe in front of you. Deals exceptional poise damage.
items.obtain: South Liurnia - Liurnia Highway Minor Erdtree waygate, dropped by the Giant Crystal Crab.

items.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
items.desc: A long-hafted golden axe wielded by the Death Knight. Bears a representation of a decayed golden ring. Crackles with lightning, the power of the capital's ancient dragon cult. The knight, once the personal guard of Godwyn, was also the protector of the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Long-hafted Axe
From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed. Strong attack performs a lightning-charged leaping slash.
items.obtain: The Death Knight's Longhaft Axe is obtained by defeating the Death Knight at the end of the Scorpion River Catacombs in Rauh Base.

items.name: Executioner's Greataxe
items.desc: Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber. Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.
items.fx:
Skill: War Cry
Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
items.obtain: The Executioner's Greataxe is found behind Fort Gael in Caelid on a corpse located between two Flame Chariots.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
items.desc: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Kindred's Upheaval
Slam the axe down into the ground creating cracks in the earth infusing with the rune of death and then violently rip upward sending chunks of deadly stone flying around you. This attack causes enemy's HP to rapidly drain away.
items.obtain: The Gargoyle's Black Axe is obtained by defeating the Black Blade Kindred south of the Grand Lift of Rold site of grace in the Forbidden Lands.

items.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
items.desc: Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Valiant Upheaval
Slam the axe down into the ground creating cracks in the earth and then violently rip upward sending chunks of stone flying around you.
items.obtain: The Gargoyle's Great Axe is obtained by defeating the Valiant Gargoyle located northeast of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace, in the Leyndell Outskirts of the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
items.desc: The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omenkillers. The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Great Omenkiller Cleaver is obtained by defeating an Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom at the end of the Perfumer's Grotto in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Greataxe
items.desc: Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains. Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Greataxe is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes.

items.name: Longhaft Axe
items.desc: Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten. Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.
items.fx:
Skill: War Cry
Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.
items.obtain: The Longhaft Axe is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,500 runes.

items.name: Putrescence Cleaver
items.desc: Weapon wielded by the Putrescent Knight. A great cleaver of hardened putrescence affixed to an arch fashioned from human bones.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Spinning Guillotine
Hold the putrid blade at both ends and arch body backwards to deliver a powerful overhead chop. Repeated inputs deliver follow-up attacks for as long as stamina allows. Strong attack performs a leap followed by a spinning attack.
items.obtain: The Putrescence Cleaver is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold after defeating the Putrescent Knight. The Putrescent Knight is located in the Garden of Deep Purple at the end of the Stone Coffin Fissure.

items.name: Rusted Anchor
items.desc: A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks. When the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Lord, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Rusted Anchor is obtained by defeating the Scaly Misbegotten in the Morne Tunnel, located in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Winged Greathorn
items.desc: Distinctive horn suffused with the power of ancestral spirits. This large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship. In the ancestral spirit-worshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Soul Stifler
Raise the greathorn's wings to summon a soul-sapping miasma.
Enemies in the affected area will temporarily suffer from reduced defense.
items.obtain: The Winged Greathorn is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes after defeating the Regal Ancestor Spirit. To fight the Regal Ancestor Spirit, you must locate and douse eight fires in the Lower Siofra River, then interact with the Horned Remains at the Hollowhorn Grounds.

items.name: Club
items.desc: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Club can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 600 Runes.

items.name: Curved Club
items.desc: Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Curved Club is found on a corpse lying next to a pile of embalmed corpses in the Rampart Tower of Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Envoy's Horn
items.desc: Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Oracular Bubble
Blow on the horn to release a magic bubble.
The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.
items.obtain: The Envoy's Horn is found in the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in place of Hewg's station.

items.name: Flowerstone Gavel
