items.desc: Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower. The four petals and the flower's core are all sharp, ending in points, and are capable of dealing heavy damage to dragons.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Flower Dragonbolt
Calls down the red lightning of the ancient dragons to strike a target. Deals lightning damage and also temporarily reduces the target's lightning damage negation. Can be charged to increase its power.
items.obtain: The Flowerstone Gavel is obtained by advancing the Dragon Priestess Florissax's questline. After defeating Bayle the Dread, the weapon can be found at Florissax's location at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak.

items.name: Hammer of Virtue
items.desc: Made in tribute to the divine implement of Radagon, this hammer is adorned with a prominent spike protruding from its head.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Virtuous Consecration
Perform a sweeping strike that enchants the ground in front of you with holy power that then bursts upwards, follow up with a heavy attack to lunge forward with a piercing attack of the hammer's spike.
items.obtain: The Hammer of Virtue is obtained by defeating Fundamentalist Gino on the tower in Morne Moangrave, located at Castle Morne.

items.name: Hammer
items.desc: Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool. The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick.
Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.
Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Hammer is found next to Hewg's station in the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Leaden Maul
items.desc: A simple hammer, unusually heavy for its size. Perfection is often wrought from simplicity.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Concussive Smash
Swing the hammer upward and deliver a staggering strike.
This attack deals a large amount of posture damage.
items.obtain: The Leaden Maul is obtained by defeating the Guardian Golem in the Highroad Cave, located in Limgrave.

items.name: Mace
items.desc: An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions. Striking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances. Most suited to head on slugging matches.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick.
Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.
Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Mace is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold for 800 Runes.

items.name: Marika's Hammer
items.desc: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Gold Breaker
Leap up high and, while suspended in midair, imbue the rune shard with light before smashing it down hard onto the ground.
The heroic Radagon's signature attack.
items.obtain: Marika's Hammer is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 Runes. This item becomes available after defeating the Elden Beast at the Fractured Marika location, accessible by heading up the stairs from the Elden Throne site of grace.

items.name: Monk's Flamemace
items.desc: Battle hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants. The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Fire Monk's Fury
Raise the blade above you to infuse it with destructive giantsflame. While active, the blade deals additional fire damage and charged heavy attacks will release a geyser of flames under the feet of your target.
items.obtain: The Monk's Flamemace is found on a corpse sitting on a wooden platform inside the courtyard of the Guardian's Garrison in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Morning Star
items.desc: Great hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss. Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick.
Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.
Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Morning Star is found in a carriage along the path following the Bridge of Sacrifice in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
items.desc: Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City. Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Flowing Form
Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form. Swing the armament like a whip to strike surroundings before slamming its teardrop-shaped head down.
items.obtain: The Nox Flowing Hammer is found on a corpse accessible through parkour in the cathedral from the 'Night's Sacred Grounds' site of grace in Nokron, Siofra River.

items.name: Prime Marika’s Hammer
items.desc: Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it. Now restored, the Hammer retains all its previously latent control over runic power.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Runic Stance
Hold to enter into the stance of heroic Radagon.

Follow up with three light attacks to repeatedly slam the ground to cause upheavals of gold in front of you.

Alternatively, follow up with a heavy attack to launch into the air and fly forward to deliver a powerful blow to an enemy.
items.obtain: Restore Marika's Hammer at the Restoration Altar in the room adjacent to Godrick's throne room in Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Ringed Finger
items.desc: Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper. Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Claw Flick
Cause the finger to swell, then flex to build up strength before giving enemies an almighty flick.
items.obtain: The Ringed Finger is obtained from a chest located to the left of a pit of magma, following the first Chariot in the Gelmir Hero's Grave, Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
items.fx:
Scepter of the All-Knowing
Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Stats
- Base Damage: 125 Physical
- Crit Damage: 120%

Skill
Knowledge Above All: Manifest the realm of the All-Knowing. Enemy magic and holy damage negation reduced for all within the area.

Notes
- Spellcasting: Acts as a staff for sorceries/incantations using the heavy attack input only while the wielder is Rune Level 1.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital – Found on a seated corpse in Gideon's Study within the Fortified Manor.

items.name: Spiked Club
items.desc: A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss. Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Spiked Club is found on a corpse hanging off a ledge, guarded by three Miranda Sprouts in the Tombsward Cave, located in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Stone Club
items.desc: Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power. So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick.
Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.
Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Stone Club is sold by the Nomadic Merchant east of the 'Saintsbridge' Site of Grace in Limgrave for 1,000 Runes.

items.name: Tricia's Pomander
items.desc: A fearsome weapon carried and perfected by Tricia the Perfumer. The censer's various perfumes can be altered to suit the needs of the wielder. An ornament to the ingenuity of Tricia, before she abandoned her martial pursuits to assist the downtrodden and persecuted.
items.fx:
Skill: Aromatic Chain-Whip
Tap the skill to swap the elemental core of the Pomander. Charge the attack to engage the chain of the mace and perform a combination of aromatic spinning attacks that leave a bursting trail of perfume.

Obtaining & Components
Tricia's Pomander is a unique weapon that requires assembly. All five pieces of Tricia’s Pomander must be collected; Smithmaster Hewg can construct this weapon once all components have been found.

Base Core
- Location: Castle Morne - Found in a gazebo on the east coast of Castle Morne Town.

Fire Affinity
- Base Damage: 171 Fire Damage
- Scaling: -5 to Arcane Scaling
- Status Buildup: Inflicts Immolation
- Location: Caelid - West of Redmane Castle on a pedestal guarded by an Omenkiller north of the Impassable Greatbridge.

Lightning Affinity
- Base Damage: 171 Lightning Damage
- Scaling: Base Attribute Scaling
- Location: Limgrave - Northeast of Saintsbridge on a pedestal surrounded by lightning bound Fulgurbloom.

Frost Affinity
- Base Damage: 171 Magic Damage
- Scaling: -10 to Arcane Scaling
- Status Buildup: 60 Frost
- Location: Liurnia - West of Main Caria Manor Gate on a pedestal guarded by a Depraved Perfumer near the cliffs.

Frenzied Affinity
- Base Damage: 171 Fire Damage
- Scaling: -10 to Arcane Scaling
- Status Buildup: 60 Madness
- Location: Liurnia - South of the Church of Inhibition on the cliff's edge guarded by many Frenzied Miranda Blossoms.

items.name: Varré's Bouquet
items.desc: A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood. This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: Varré's Bouquet is obtained by invading White-Faced Varré at the final stage of his quest, near the "Konrad, Pureblood Knight" site of grace in Mohgwyn Palace. Note that the invasion is only accessible after defeating Konrad, Pureblood Knight, and requires an area reset to appear.

items.name: Warpick
items.desc: Great hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence. A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick.
Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance.
Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Warpick is found on a corpse sitting on a ledge in the deeper parts of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel, Caelid. To access this area, the player must defeat the Fallingstar Beast.

items.name: Zamor Star Mace
items.desc: A weapon made during the brief time in which the fleeting alliance between the snow witches and the Zamor warriors still held. Conjured icicles form the spikes upon its steel ball and handle.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ice Spikes
Skill used by the warriors of Zamor.
Raise armament aloft to fire ice shards from the head of the mace that then seek out foes, dealing damage and building frostbite.
Can be fired in rapid succession.
items.obtain: The Zamor Star Mace is obtained by defeating Frost Witch Dino in Caria Manor.

items.name: Bastard's Stars
items.desc: Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel. Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Nebula
Imbue the Naturalborn's stars with magic to perform a sweeping strike.
This attack leaves a dark cloud of stars in its wake that lingers briefly before exploding.
items.obtain: The Bastard's Stars can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 Runes after defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the Void. Astel is located at the end of the Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

items.name: Chainlink Flail
items.desc: A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads. Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Chain
Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack.
Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.
items.obtain: The Chainlink Flail is found in a chest in the Mistwood Ruins, Limgrave.

items.name: Family Heads
items.desc: Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage. The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Familial Rancor
Gently rattle the copper heads to summon vengeful spirits that chase down foes.
The anguish of a spouse and children invites accursed wrath.
items.obtain: The Family Heads is obtained by defeating Necromancer Garris in the Sage's Cave, Altus Plateau.

items.name: Flail
items.desc: Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by a chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss. Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Spinning Chain
Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack.
Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.
items.obtain: The Flail is obtained in a carriage chest in the Gatefront Ruins, Limgrave.

items.name: Golden Order Flail
items.desc: A flail with three golden rings for striking heads, the sacred signature weapon of the esteemed Broken Mask. The golden bands are modelled upon the Elden Ring itself, half-corporeal and half formed of light, all in the process of shattering.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Causality's Wrath
A skill which houses the wheel of causality within the user's frame. Once activated, perform an additional input to unleash an attack. The potency of the attack increases with damage taken.
items.obtain: Obtained from defeating Broken Gold Mask in Leyndell near the statue of Radagon once you have discovered Radagon's secret as part of Corhyn's questline. Note, you don't actually need to do the questline to trigger the npc invasion, you just need to use Law of Regression in front of the statue.

items.name: Mohgwyn Censer
items.desc: Part of the newly minted religious iconography of the Mohgwyn Dynasty, the blood-smoke this flail produces serves as both a source of corruption and of purification.
items.fx:
Skill: Wild Strikes
Swing armament with wild abandon.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.
items.obtain: The Mohgwyn Censer is obtained by defeating Esgar, Priest of Blood in the Leyndell Catacombs, located in the Subterranean Shunning Grounds.

items.name: Nightrider Flail
items.desc: A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Chain
Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack.
Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.
items.obtain: The Nightrider Flail is obtained by defeating the Night's Cavalry near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Seething Flail
items.desc: Crafted before the days of Rykard's ascendancy by the ancient cult of Eiglay, this flail exudes the primordial power of the magma of Mt. Gelmir.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Magma Splash
Swing armament with wild abandon sending magma spraying in all directions.
Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack. When followed up with a strong attack, the head of the flail will detonate with a great explosion of magma.
items.obtain: The Seething Flail is found in a chest in the Manor Passage of Volcano Manor, hidden behind an illusory wall.

items.name: Serpent Flail
items.desc: A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns. Some of Messmer's army used these flails to burn hornsent—to brand them with agony and fear.
items.fx:
Skill: Flare, O Serpent
Ignites a flame inside the snakes, temporarily empowering flame attacks. Once ignited, strong attacks and other moves that strike the ground will cause an explosion.
items.obtain: The Serpent Flail is found in a chest in the lower level of the Fog Rift Fort, Castle Ensis.

items.name: Battle Hammer
items.desc: Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
items.fx:
Skill: Braggarts Roar
Declare your presence with a boastful roar.
Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.
items.obtain: The Battle Hammer is obtained by defeating the Grave Warden Duelist in the Murkwater Catacombs, Limgrave.

items.name: Beastclaw Greathammer
items.desc: Great hammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws. The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went on to become King Godfrey's Regent.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Regal Beastclaw
Slam the hammer into the ground, rending the land asunder with the armament's five bestial claws.
items.obtain: The Beastclaw Greathammer is found on a corpse near wolves after descending a pit in the Dragonbarrow Cave, Caelid.

items.name: Black Steel Greathammer
items.desc: Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Greathammer of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power. Guard Counters cause a burst of power.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Black Steel Greathammer is a guaranteed drop from the Black Knight guarding the Church of Consolation, east of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace in the Gravesite Plain.

items.name: Brick Hammer
items.desc: Weapon made from an ordinary stone brick. Wielded by a laborer who lead a rebellion, and later become a champion himself. Even among other bludgeons of its size, this weapon is especially weighty. The strength of a giant is required to wield it.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Brick Hammer is found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, reachable by performing parkour in the room filled with explosive barrels.

items.name: Celebrant's Skull
items.desc: Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Celebrant's Skull is obtained from a corpse hanging from a ledge northeast of the 'Windmill Village' Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
items.desc: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Surge of Faith
Set the flames of Birac's faith ablaze in the cranial vessel, then raise it aloft to rain down fireballs in all directions.
Repeated inputs will continue to raise the armament aloft, continuing the attack.
items.obtain: The Cranial Vessel Candlestand is obtained from a corpse in a room near Imp shades in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Crimson Briar-Bough
items.desc: A weapon of the lost kingdom of Eochaid, bloody and writhing. Said to once be wielded by Eochaid’s grand justicars, the briars still contain hidden aberrant powers.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Briar Assault
Animate the hammer with writhing briars and launch into a series of wild attacks.
Each strike recovers HP and the final strike sends briars of punishment outwards in front of you.
items.obtain: The Crimson Briar-Bough is found by defeating Bloodhound Knight Gethin in the Cave of Knowledge, Limgrave.

items.name: Curved Great Club
items.desc: Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon. Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Curved Great Club is purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 2,500 Runes.

items.name: Devourer's Scepter
items.desc: Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy. One of the legendary armaments. A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Devourer of Worlds
Charge the scepter with magic and strike it against the ground to steal the HP of all nearby enemies and follow up with another skill attack to wrench magma from the earth.
items.obtain: The Devourer's Scepter is obtained by killing Bernahl in any location where he can be damaged, such as the Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave or in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Einar's Greathammer
items.desc: A frigid spiked hammer made of freezing iron. Einar was gifted this weapon in service to the snow witches of the north. A fringe of Renna's cape still adorns the handle.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Einar's Icestorm
Spin the hammer around yourself generating a whirling icestorm and then slide forward with an upward strike leaving bursting ice shards behind you. Then follow up with another skill attack to perform a downward smash that bursts with frost on impact.
items.obtain: Einar's Hammer is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 Runes after defeating Einar, Ice Guardian. Einar is located at the end of the route through Caria Manor.

items.name: Envoy's Long Horn
items.desc: Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Bubble Shower
Blow on the horn to release a spume of magic bubbles.
The bubbles float gently before raining down on the target.
items.obtain: The Envoy's Long Horn can be obtained from Gideon Ofnir after defeating Malenia, or purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 5,000 Runes once Gideon leaves.

items.name: Great Mace
items.desc: Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin. Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Great Mace is obtained from a chest in the camp west of the Grand Lift of Dectus, Liurnia.

items.name: Great Stars
items.desc: Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss. A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Great Stars can be obtained from a chest within a caravan near the 'Road of Iniquity Side Path' Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau. Alternatively, it is dropped after invading and defeating Magnus the Beast Claw at the Writheblood Ruins in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Greathorn Hammer
items.desc: Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors. The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Greathorn Hammer is obtained from a corpse up the cliff near the "Siofra River Bank" Site of Grace, Siofra River.

items.name: Large Club
items.desc: A thick, solid lump of wood. Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill. A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Large Club is obtained from a corpse south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in Limgrave.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.desc: Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners. Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"
items.fx:
Can only be powerstanced with Greataxes. Uses the greataxe powerstancing moveset when powerstanced with a greataxe.

Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Pickaxe is found on a corpse on the floor of the Morne Tunnel, Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
items.desc: Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.
items.fx:
Skill: Braggart's Roar
Declare your presence with a boastful roar.
Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.
items.obtain: The Rotten Battle Hammer is obtained by defeating the Grave Warden Duelist northwest of the 'Consecrated Snowfield' Site of Grace in the Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Sigur's Greatmace
items.desc: A large mace of blackened iron wrapped in chains and wielded by Sigur, captain of the Night’s Cavalry. Serving under Morgott, Sigur has become his royal guard since his ascendancy.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Omen's Roar
Perform a roar that causes a combustion of omen flame and sends several projectiles out around you and enchants the weapon with omen flame increasing the damage of physical attacks . While this enchantment is active, your charged heavy attacks will detonate with omen flames.
items.obtain: The Sigur's Greatmace is obtained by defeating Sigur, Night's Captain in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Smithscript Greathammer
items.desc: Greathammer engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack or dashing strong attack to spin and fling the greathammer.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Smithscript Greathammer is found in Taylew's Ruined Forge. Progress through the area until you are required to jump onto the lava intake, then immediately jump off the other side; the greathammer is on a corpse to your left, hidden by rubble.

items.name: Underworld Greatmace
items.desc: An ornate battle-hammer forged from the blue silver of the underworld Albinaurics. This weapon is infused with the signature power of the Dragonkin.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Cragbolt Slam
Perform a forward aerial somersault bringing the hammer down to the ground. Then release a storm of frozen lightning in front of you.
items.obtain: The Underworld Greatmace is obtained near the end of the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave.

items.name: Anvil Hammer
items.desc: One of the treasures of the ruined forges. A tremendous hammer that incorporates as its head the red-hot anvil of the forge. It is said that the anvil's shape is inspired by that of an altar, and that long ago, it was indeed used as such in rite and ritual.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Smithing Art Spears
Slam the red-hot anvil into the ground, sending up countless spears as it is pulled out. The spears disappear instantly.
items.obtain: The Anvil Hammer is found at the end of the Ruined Forge Lava Intake in the Gravesite Plains by interacting with the furnace at the end of the dungeon.

items.name: Axe of Godfrey
items.desc: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Regal Roar
Let loose a mighty war cry, raising attack power, while sending out a shockwave that cannot be guarded against by stomping the ground.
While active, strong attack becomes a lunging slash.
items.obtain: The Axe of Godfrey is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 Runes after defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior in the arena beyond the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Arm
items.desc: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon. Having been sanctified by a blood ritual, this armament is capable of spraying blood stored within when executing a strong attack.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Bloodfiend's Arm is dropped by one of the Bloodfiend enemies in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plains.

items.name: Devonia's Hammer
items.desc: Great hammer wielded by Devonia, longest-serving of the Crucible Knights. Weapon forged of primordial gold, marked by its reddish hue and inhabited by ancient holiness. A torrent of life is engraved upon the striking face.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Devonia's Vortex
Using the power of the Crucible vortex, violently spin the hammer around and slam the ground, causing a shockwave. This skill can be charged to increase its power.
items.obtain: Devonia's Hammer is dropped by Crucible Knight Devonia, who is found northwest of the 'Rauh Ancient Ruins, East' Site of Grace in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

items.name: Dragon Greatclaw
items.desc: Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. The claw is enwreathed with lightning, and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Storm of the Ancients
Raise the weapon aloft and call down a storm of ancient lightning bolts.
items.obtain: The Dragon Greatclaw is obtained after defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel, located north of the Capital Rampart Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Duelist Greataxe
items.desc: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Duelist Greataxe is found in the Leyndell Outskirts, south of the East Altus Minor Erdtree in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Envoy's Greathorn
items.desc: Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt. Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Great Oracular Bubble
Blow on the horn to release a massive magic bubble.
The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.
items.obtain: The Envoy's Greathorn is found in the bell tower above the elevator shortcut to Haligtree Roots in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. It is accessed by taking a branching path to the left after leaving the "Prayer Room" Site of Grace and passing through the shortcut gate.

items.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
items.desc: Part of a Fallingstar Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon. With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Gravity Bolt
Imbue the jaw of the fallingstar beast with gravitational lightning, sending a bolt crashing down a short distance away.
Can be fired in rapid succession.
items.obtain: The Fallingstar Beast Jaw is acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast in the crater at Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Gazing Finger
items.desc: The head of Metyr, the finger-mother, wielded as a weapon without modification. From within the center of the fingerprint that wrinkles the creature's foremost protrusion, a tiny wart-like eye gazes vacantly into the beyond.
items.fx:
Deals 20% extra damage against gravity enemies.

Unique Skill: Kowtower's Resentment
Skill performed as a violent bow using a finger's foremost protrusion. Resentment builds as it is forced to bow, making it explode with anger. Hold button down to further increase resentment.
items.obtain: The Gazing Finger is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold after defeating Metyr, Mother of Fingers. Metyr is found in the Ruins of Miyr underneath the Cathedral of Manus Metyr in Scadu Altus, accessible after completing the Finger Ruins questline for Count Ymir.

items.name: Ghiza's Wheel
items.desc: Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss. The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Spinning Wheel
Strike the wheel against the ground to set it spinning at top speed. Hold to keep the wheel spinning. Can be used while walking to push the armament into enemies.
items.obtain: Ghiza's Wheel is obtained after defeating Inquisitor Ghiza in the dining room above Tanith in Volcano Manor.

items.name: Giant-Crusher
items.desc: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau - Obtained from a Caravan chest South of the 'Outer Wall Phantom Tree' Site of Grace.

items.name: Golem's Halberd
items.desc: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Golem's Halberd is found on a body next to the entrance of the Divine Tower of East Altus in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Great Club
items.desc: An enormous club of hard wood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Golden Land
Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash a blast of sacred energy that coalesces into golden darts. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.
items.obtain: The Great Club is obtained by defeating the Stonedigger Troll in the Old Altus Tunnel, Altus Plateau.

items.name: Greatstaff of Decay
items.desc: A large two-pronged branch permeated with rot. Once held in purity by Meredith, first of the Demi-human queens, the state of this weapon mirrors her own descent into decay. A mouldering ornament to the power of rebirth.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Break the Seal
Slam the head of the staff into the ground and cause a large rotten explosion, follow up with a heavy attack to perform a lateral sweep that unleashes a stream of rot.
items.obtain: The Greatstaff of Decay is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 Runes after defeating the Scion of the Sealed God. This boss is found in the arena in front of the Grand Cloister Site of Grace in the Lake of Rot.

items.name: Lodestone of Gelmir
items.desc: A sharpened rock perilously taken from the depths of Mt. Gelmir, infused with the fiery spirit of the mountain. The stone draws the molten flames to itself when wielded in battle.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Magma Crush
Perform a wide spinning attack that sends magma flying out around you, follow up with another skill attack to perform a leaping downward slam that explodes with a magma eruption on impact sending magma flying out in all directions.
items.obtain: The Lodestone of Gelmir is obtained after defeating Volcanist Dist in Volcano Manor.

items.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
items.desc: Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship. The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks will fling foes into the air.
items.fx:
Skill: Prelate's Charge
Slam armament into the ground to create a surge of flames, then charge in.
Hold to continue the charge.
items.obtain: The Prelate's Inferno Crozier is obtained by defeating a Fire Prelate in a Fire Monk encampment located east of the Moonlight Altar in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Rotten Greataxe
items.desc: Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.
Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Rotten Greataxe is obtained by defeating the Rotten Duelist found northwest of the 'Consecrated Snowfield' Site of Grace in the Consecrated Snowfield.

items.name: Rotten Staff
items.desc: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rotten Slam
Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends rotten waves in all directions.
This is the most powerful of all the Ground Slam skills.
items.obtain: The Rotten Staff is obtained by defeating the Putrid Avatar guarding the East Caelid Minor Erdtree in Caelid.

items.name: Staff of the Avatar
items.desc: Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees. The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Erdtree Slam
Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions.
This is the most powerful of all the Ground Slam skills.
items.obtain: The Staff of the Avatar is obtained after defeating the Erdtree Avatar guarding the Minor Erdtree teleporter in the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Shadow Sunflower Blossom
items.desc: The head of a monstrous shadow sunflower manifestation of the Scadutree. Then again, it might be just a flower, wielded as a weapon. Much like the Scadutree itself in appearance, a second stalk winds tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Shadow Sunflower Headbutt
Slam down the blossom of a large shadow sunflower, sending out a shockwave that flattens foes. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
items.obtain: The Shadow Sunflower Blossom is purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold after defeating the Scadutree Avatar. The Scadutree Avatar is found at the base of the Scadutree in the Shadow Keep.

items.name: Troll's Hammer
items.desc: Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock. Trolls are descended from the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distant past, smithing was considered divine.
items.fx:
Skill: Troll's Roar
Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes.
Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.
items.obtain: The Troll's Hammer is obtained from a corpse resting inside a shack on the floor below the starting area in the Old Altus Tunnel, Altus Plateau.

items.name: Watchdog's Staff
items.desc: Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs. The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Sorcery of the Crozier
Channel magic into the glintstone to activate an ancient sorcery, producing floating magic projectiles that chase enemies automatically.
items.obtain: The Watchdog's Staff is obtained from a corpse located to the left of a chest hidden behind an illusory wall in the Road's End Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Fork
items.desc: Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss. A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.
items.fx:
Skill: Barbaric Roar
Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power.
While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.
items.obtain: The Bloodfiend's Fork is found inside a chest at the top of Prospect Town, located southwest of the 'Cliffroad Terminus' Site of Grace in the Gravesite Plains.

items.name: Bolt of Gransax
items.desc: Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax. One of the legendary armaments. A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital—the only time in historical record that Leyndell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against the ancient dragons.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ancient Lightning Spear
Imbue the armament with the ancient dragons' red lightning, then throw it as a spear.
Can be charged to increase its power.
items.obtain: The Bolt of Gransax is found on the giant spear of Gransax, accessible by heading northwest from the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Celebrant's Rib-Rake
items.desc: Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village. Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks. Inflicts Souls Burn.
items.fx:
Skill: Piercing Fang
Skill used by Yura, the Bloody Finger Hunter.
Starting with the blade held horizontally, make a powerful thrust that cannot be blocked.
items.obtain: The Celebrant's Rib-Rake is obtained in a chest after defeating the Black Knife Assassin in the Deathtouched Catacombs in Limgrave.

items.name: Clayman's Harpoon
items.desc: Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains. The blade emits a faint light and deals frozen lightning damage.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Clayman's Harpoon is found on a corpse near the Uhl Palace Ruins Erdtree portal in the Ainsel River.

items.name: Cleanrot Spear
items.desc: Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shield is blessed with an incantation that wards off rot.
items.fx:
Can be powerstanced with Cleanrot Knight's Sword as well as spears. Both weapons will use the spear powerstancing moveset.

Unique Skill: Sacred Phalanx
Release the power of a hidden incantation to erect a palisade of golden spears frontwards.
items.obtain: The Cleanrot Spear is found inside a chest in the War-Dead Catacombs in Caelid. From the Site of Grace, head down the stairs. Once you reach the room with the fighting knights, go left and down the stairs; the chest is located at the back in the middle of the rot-filled room.

items.name: Cross-Naginata
items.desc: Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana. A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Cross-Naginata is found in Gael Tunnel in Caelid. From the entrance, head down the first set of stairs and take a left into a side tunnel filled with Land Octopuses. The weapon is located on the floor, guarded by a Giant Land Octopus.

items.name: Crucifix of Eochaid
items.desc: A razor-sharp short spear with collapsable tines on either side of the blade. Heavy attacks will cause the tines to extend, causing excessive bleeding. These relics of Eochaid were once used in macabre rites involving impalements to drain the blood from citizens. This was perhaps why the victims of such atrocity eventually found their way to Mohgwyn after the rune of death was hidden.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Telekinetic Butchery
Tap the skill to fling the spear forwards in a corkscrew attack, continuously dealing damage while violently spinning.

Or hold the skill, causing the spear to weave through the air in a pattern in front of you, piercing foes multiple times.
items.obtain: Mohgwyn Palace, near a burning crow corpse surrounded by headless enemies on the way to the Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance site of grace.

items.name: Crystal Spear
items.desc: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Crystal Spear is found in the Academy Crystal Cave in Liurnia of the Lakes. Proceed through the cave until reaching a large room containing giant crystals, then take the path to the right through the opening. The chest is located next to some Graven Mass corpses.

items.name: Death Ritual Spear
items.desc: Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds. The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Spearcall Ritual
Thrust the spear high, bearing prayers into the sky to summon a downpour of spectral spears.
items.obtain: The Death Ritual Spear is awarded for defeating the Deathrite Bird in the Mountaintops of the Giants. To find it, head west from the Castle Sol Main Gate Site of Grace, proceed to the cliff, then head up the hill to your left and turn right.

items.name: Gaoler's Mancatcher
items.desc: A polearm mounted with a spiked steel ring at the end, carried as a spear. The gaolers of Noxumbra tirelessly hunted the streets to fuel Daergraf's grizzly expierments. The silver tears were hounded to almost complete extinction.
items.fx:
Skill: Charge Forth
Quickly charge forward with the armament at the hip, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance.
items.obtain: Noxumbra, Forsaken City

items.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
items.desc: Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir. Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conceived by a thorough mind.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Inquisitor's Girandole is dropped by the Abductor Virgin boss in the lower section Volcano Manor accessed from the portal at the bottom of the Raya Lucaria waterwheel elevator. To reach it, start from the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber, head south to the tunnel, fall down, and proceed southeast to the boss arena.

items.name: Iron Spear
items.desc: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Iron Spear is found in Nokron, Eternal City. After descending the Starfall Crater in Mistwood and reaching the first rooftop jumping section, make a jump to the right to reach a corpse holding the weapon.

items.name: Partisan
items.desc: Spear with a wide tip. In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swung to sweep through foes.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Partisan is sold by Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave for 1,000 runes.

items.name: Phalanx Pike
items.desc: A long hunting spear adapted for war, ideal for use in a singular capacity or paired with a shield. The head of the spear was forged before the shattering in a tradition lost to present day but was fitted on a shaft frequently used by the woodsman of Limgrave.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Pikeman's Flourish
Twirl the spear to ready yourself for battle, causing an effect that increases stamina recovery for 20 seconds, while active, your heavy attacks will use different techniques. Follow up with a heavy attack to perform a charging rush that finishes with a spinning slash.
items.obtain: The Phalanx Pike is found in Castle Morne. From the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, head east through the open doors and fight through the area until you reach the sea cliff. Climb the ladder on your left, then continue to the top of the tower after a second ladder to find the weapon.

items.name: Pike
items.desc: A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle. Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incredibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Pike is found in the courtyard with flame-spewing turrets in Stormveil Castle, located between the turrets themselves. The courtyard can be reached from the 'Eastern Parapet' Site of Grace, or from the 'Rampart Tower' Site of Grace by taking the elevator down and passing the Grafted Scion to the left.

items.name: Rotten Crystal Spear
items.desc: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with faith and arcane.
items.fx:
Skill: Repeating Thrust
Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.
items.obtain: The Rotten Crystal Spear is obtained by defeating the Rotten Crystalian Trio in the Sellia Hideaway in Caelid.

items.name: Short Spear
items.desc: An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight. Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, its strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Short Spear is sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes.

items.name: Smithscript Spear
items.desc: Spear engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts. Execute a strong attack, a dashing strong attack, or a mounted strong attack to throw the spear.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Smithscript Spear is found on a corpse in the first chamber of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past, located across a stone bridge in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Spear
items.desc: Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft. A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Spear can be obtained by defeating Patches in Murkwater Cave (Limgrave), even after he begs for his life. Additionally, Patches can be encountered at the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in Liurnia and just before the Elemer of the Briar boss fight at the Shaded Castle.

items.name: Spear of Tranquility
items.desc: A silver spear gifted to the clan of ancestral followers at the time of the codification of a secret alliance. A symbol of peace and fellowship.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Soporific Assault
Lunge forward with a thrusting attack that enchants the spear with mystical sleep energy and then follow up with another skill attack to perform a wide swipe that releases a purple mist that causes sleep build-up.
items.obtain: The Spear of Tranquility is found in the Lake of Rot. From the Lake of Rot Shoreside Site of Grace, head down the hill toward the lake, then turn right and follow the path until you see large statues and an archway. Head inside; the chest containing the weapon is located behind a small pillar at the back of the arena. Defeating the Dragonkin Soldier is not required.

items.name: Spiked Spear
items.desc: Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss. Weapon of the Marionette Soldiers employed by sorcerers.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Spiked Spear is sold by the Nomadic Merchant located next to the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in Altus Plateau for 1,500 runes.

items.name: Swift Spear
items.desc: A metal-bodied spear of extremely lightweight make, being the result of a sophisticated molding technique. Capable of swift consecutive attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Swift Spear is found on a corpse southeast of the Castle Front Site of Grace in Gravesite Plains, located just off the path.

items.name: Torchpole
items.desc: Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead. Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Torchpole is sold by the Nomadic Merchant next to the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants for 2,500 runes. To reach the merchant, use the spiritspring located to the southwest of the Site of Grace.

items.name: Barbed Staff-Spear
items.desc: Greatstaff of Jori, elder inquisitor. The tip bristles with golden barbs symbolic of the inquisition's torture, allowing one to wield the staff as a greatspear. Attacks deal holy damage, and potency increases with faith.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Jori's Inquisition
Thrust the greatstaff into the air, firing off a succession of golden barb-like arcs. Holding the button down extends the barrage for a short duration.
items.obtain: The Barbed Staff-Spear is dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor, upon defeating them at the end of the Darklight Catacombs in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
items.desc: Greatspear of the bloodfiend hexers. One of the most significant implements used in their blood rituals. Sacred spears of blood are the instruments of communion with an outer god. The mother of truth desires a wound.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Bloodfiends' Bloodboon
Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the mother of truth, creating an explosion of bloodflame in the area surrounding the target. Additional input allows for up to three follow-up attacks.
items.obtain: The Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear is found in front of the bloodstained statue of Mohg in Mohgwyn Palace. From the Palace-Approach Ledge Road Site of Grace, turn left, head down into the blood swamp, go around the wall to the left past the headless enemies, and continue straight ahead; the statue is located on the right.

items.name: Cragsplitter
items.desc: A large greatspear of mysterious origin, embellished with mace-like flanges. Crafted from a rock-breaking tool, this weapon is exceptionally heavy for its size, making it suited to only the mightiest of warriors.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Pulverizing Thrust
Tap to hop backwards and then launch forward to perform a heavy thrust in front of you. Charge to hop back and then move forward while plowing the ground with the spear tip and then heave it upward at the end of the thrust.
items.obtain: Fort Faroth

items.name: Lance
items.desc: Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce. Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Lance is found in Limgrave, located atop some ruins in a camp southwest of the Warmaster's Shack. You can reach it by dropping down from the higher ledge nearby.

items.name: Messmer Soldier's Spear
items.desc: Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use. Being made for overwhelming onslaughts, attacks with this weapon can be charged to unleash consecutive strikes.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Messmer Soldier's Spear is found in a chest located directly underneath the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace.

items.name: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear
items.desc: Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty. As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Bloodboon Ritual
Raise the sacred spear and pierce the body of the Formless Mother. Stab up to three times, creating explosions of blood with each thrust. This skill will coat the armament with bloodflame for a while.
items.obtain: Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear is obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Lord of Blood with Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 runes. This Remembrance is acquired by defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood, at Mohgwyn Palace above the Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace.

items.name: Serpent-Hunter
items.desc: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Great-Serpent Hunt
Perform a powerful forward lunge and follow up with an upward thrust via additional input. When fighting a great serpent, a long blade of light will appear, revealing the armament's true power.
items.obtain: The Serpent-Hunter is found at the exit of the lower section of Volcano Manor accessed from the portal at the bottom of the Raya Lucaria waterwheel elevator. It is located on a corpse after defeating the Abductor Virgin boss fight.

items.name: Siluria's Tree
items.desc: Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights. The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Siluria's Woe
Thrust the treespear in a spiraling motion, surrounding it in a vortex of wind. Charged attacks have the power to blow away enemies and can fire the tornado forwards.
items.obtain: Siluria's Tree is found in a chest after defeating Crucible Knight Siluria in the Deeproot Depths.

items.name: Spear of the Dreaming
items.desc: A greatspear crafted by the mighty Spiritshaper. Its head coalesces with the vaporous spirits of the honored dead.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Vapors
Leap into the air and thrust downward with an enchanted burst. Follow up with another skill attack to cast a trail of spirit vapor on the ground in front of you and then thrust forward.
items.obtain: Obtained after defeating the Mystic Huntress of the Lost Tribe in Farum Azula.

items.name: Spear of the Impaler
items.desc: Weapon of Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a warped blade in the shape of undulating flame. Remade by the forging arts of the realm of shadow, this weapon can be thrown by executing a strong attack, dashing strong attack, or mounted strong attack. Charge the attack to produce flame on impact.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Messmer's Assault
A fierce succession of attacks using a flame-coated spear tip. Repeated inputs allow up to two follow-up attacks. The final move thrusts the spear into the ground, causing countless spears to form in the surrounding area.
items.obtain: The Spear of the Impaler is obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold. This Remembrance is acquired by defeating Messmer the Impaler at the top of the Shadow Keep.

items.name: Treespear
items.desc: Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Deals holy damage. Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.
items.fx:
Skill: Sacred Order
Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Perform a salute and grant the armament holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death.
items.obtain: The Treespear is found in a carriage guarded by a troll near the bridge connecting Limgrave and Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Vyke's War Spear
items.desc: War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold. Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Spear of Frenzy
Imbue the spear with the flame of frenzy and leap forwards, plunging it into the ground and setting off a maddening explosion. Follow up with a sweeping attack that coats the weapon in maddening flames, increasing damage for 30 seconds. The skill inflicts the enemy with madness.
items.obtain: Vyke's War Spear is dropped by the Festering Fingerprint Vyke invader near the Church of Inhibition in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Banished Knight's Halberd
items.desc: A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Storm Stance
Hold to assume a ready stance. Follow up with a light attack to perform an overhead slam that generates a whirlwind that pushes you back a few steps or follow up with a strong attack to twirl the halberd over your head and then leap forward and slam downward generating a whirlwind on impact.
items.obtain: The Banished Knight’s Halberd can be obtained by defeating Edgar at either Castle Morne or the Bridge of Sacrifice, or by defeating the Edgar the Revenger invader at the Revenger's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Blightpole
items.desc: A foul totem of those that live in death, crafted in reverence to their prince and imbued with the power of deathblight.
items.fx:
When deathblight occurs nearby, blighted branches will sprout from the tip and the weaponw ill become capable of casting sorceries. Otherwise the un-activated skill is Spinning Slash.

Unique Skill: Cast Sorcery
Cast your selected spell through this weapon. Has the same scaling as the Prince of Death's Staff
items.obtain: Farum Azula, from the Forum Ruins site of grace, head north and go down the hill. Head passed the sleeping dragon to the right and up a small hill to large tree with the weapon sitting at the foot of it.

items.name: Commander's Standard
items.desc: A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd. Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rallying Standard
Hoist the war banner aloft and give a rallying command.
Raises attack power and defense for self and nearby allies.
items.obtain: The Commander’s Standard is obtained after defeating Commander O'Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia, Caelid.

items.name: Dragonkin Halberd
items.desc: Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning. Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Cragbolt Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Dragon Halberd is obtained by defeating the Dragonkin Soldier in the Lower Siofra River. From the Worshipper's Woods Site of Grace, head south and go around the ruined structure. Climb the fallen pillar, use the teleporter, then head west and north to locate the boss.

items.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
items.desc: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage. Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Gargoyle’s Black Halberd is obtained by defeating the Black Blade Kindred in Caelid. To find the boss, head behind the Bestial Sanctum and proceed down to the arena located near the site of grace.

items.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
items.desc: Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles. Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors.
Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital - From the West Capital Rampart site of grace, head south and defeat the Gargoyle enemy to get the weapon.

items.name: Glaive of the Ancients
items.desc: Brother to Serosh, Seera turned away from the power of the Erdtree and took up a timeless seat as guardian of the eternal. His mounted blade carries a lingering lightning enchantment, a gift from the Dragonlord himself.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Ancient Thunderclap
Leap into the air and charge the blade with ancient lightning and slam down releasing the lightning in all directions. Follow up with a skill attack to recharge the blade and dive into the ground creating a large thunderclap around you. The follow-up can be continuously chained.
items.obtain: The Glaive of Ancients is obtained by defeating Seera, Blade of the Ancients, in Crumbling Farum Azula.

items.name: Glaive of the Crusade
items.desc: A ceremonial hilt emblazoned with the crest of the crusade, later fitted with a long sword blade, now wielded as a glaive. Once used in the rituals carried out by Messmer's lieutenants, the scorched haft of the polearm was not made to resist the heat generated by the flame produced by the flame.
items.fx:
Inflicts Immolation

Unique Skill: Crusader's Ignition
Leap into the air and plunge the blade downward into the ground with a burst of Messmerflame. Follow-up with another skill attack to perform a flaming sweeping attack around your body.
items.obtain: Found in a chest at the top of the Scorched Ruins in the Gravesite Plains.

items.name: Glaive
items.desc: Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war. This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Glaive is found in Stormveil Castle. From the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, head southeast to the elevator. Turn left twice; the weapon is located in front of the fireplace, guarded by a Banished Knight and two Exiled Knights.

items.name: Golden Halberd
items.desc: Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Deals holy damage. A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one of mere human strength to wield.
items.fx:
Skill: Golden Vow
Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense.
items.obtain: The Golden Halberd is obtained by defeating the Tree Sentinel located directly north of The First Step Site of Grace in Limgrave.

items.name: Halberd of Archea
items.desc: A double-bladed halberd of the eternal crucible, once carried by Archea, sister of Devonia. Lighter than the weapons favored by her siblings, this halberd suited Archea's more nimble approach to combat. Archea was slain by Skarde, an act that was meant to prove his new loyalty to Godfrey and the Erdtree.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Archea's Dance
Perform two skill attacks in a row to lash out with a series of lateral slashes in front of you. Follow-up with another skill attack to somersault backwards and release a wave of crucible energy toward your target
items.obtain: Farum Azula, from the Garden Courtyard site of grace, drop down to the area below to the northeast and progress through the section until you reach the window above the Large Hornsent Inquisitor. Drop down and run passed him to the right follow the bridge downhill back towards the shortcut to the grace. The weapon is on the ground next to the shortcut door.

items.name: Halberd of the Deceiver
items.desc: The immaculate polearm of Idris, Godskin Deceiver. A symbol he coveted though ruthlessly wielded against his challengers. Oft did Idris find his loyalties questioned in spite of his inexorable service and self-afflicted atonement. A stranger to the practice of god flaying, his devotion was ever in doubt.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Deceiver's Sacrilege
A powerful series of golden blackflame imbued attacks. Use the skill input for a leaping strike, then follow-up with another input for a golden blackflame wave sweep. Use the heavy attack input after the skill input for a final ground thrust explosion.
items.obtain: Dropped from Idris, Godskin Deceiver in the Fog Rift Catacombs.

items.name: Halberd
items.desc: A long-handled polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear. Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks, or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Halberd is sold by the Nomadic Merchant located east of the Saintsbridge Site of Grace in Limgrave for 1,200 runes.

items.name: Loretta's War Sickle
items.desc: Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.
items.fx:
Skill: Loretta's Slash
Skill of Loretta the Royal Knight. Leap forward, imbuing the blade with glintstone, then descend, accelerating into a sweeping slash.
items.obtain: Loretta's War Sickle is obtained by defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree, at the Haligtree Promenade in Miquella's Haligtree.

items.name: Lucerne
items.desc: This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor. Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Lucerne is found in Liurnia of the Lakes. Using an Erdtree portal, warp to the South Liurnia/Liurnia Highway area. After defeating the boss there, head northwest toward the battlefield; the weapon can be found next to a cart on your right.

items.name: Nightrider Glaive
items.desc: A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds. This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horseback.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Nightrider Glaive is dropped by the Night's Cavalry boss located in Liurnia of the Lakes. From the East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace, wait until nightfall and head northeast along the road to find and defeat the enemy.

items.name: Pest's Glaive
items.desc: Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation. Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Pest’s Glaive is found in Caelid. From the Southern Aeonian Swamp Bank Site of Grace, head directly south and drop down from the cliff; the weapon is located inside a Physic Tear Basin.

items.name: Poleblade of the Bud
items.desc: Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Romina's Purification
Imbues bud-blade with scarlet rot butterflies before unleashing two large sweeping slashes. This was once considered a sacred act of purification.
items.obtain: The Poleblade of the Bud can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia in the Roundtable Hold after defeating defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud, at the Church of the Bud in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

items.name: Rhys’ Swordspear
items.desc: An elegant polearm inlayed with gold and glintstone, wielded as a halberd. It was wrought under the eye of Rhys himself, preferring a longer blade for channeling glint energies. Rhys showed incredible promise in his early career as a Carian Knight, surpassing even Loretta's exacting standards. It was this very ambition that ultimately brought his downfall.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Carian Gallantry
Twirl the weapon to conjure a glintblade phalanx above your head and sweep the blade upward to release a magic wave toward foes. Follow up to leap into the air and bring the weapon down with a magic explosion upon landing.
items.obtain: Obtain after defeating Rhys, Carian Paragon, in Caria Manor.

items.name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
items.desc: Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics. The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Ripple Crescent Halberd is found in Liurnia of the Lakes on an island northwest of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace, guarded by three Albinaurics.

items.name: Spirit Glaive
items.desc: Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite. Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rancor Flurry
Leap into the air and perform a series of spinning slashes while summoning vengeful spirits which chase down foes. Additional input allows for a thrust of explosive ghostflame.
items.obtain: The Spirit Glaive is found on a corpse in a field of spider lilies north of the Site of Grace in Charo's Hidden Grave, Cerulean Coast.

items.name: Starcaller's Mattock
items.desc: A long-handled pickaxe commonly carried by starcallers. The stylized pick acts as a hook for extracting stone from the earth.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Stone Excavation
