Strike the ground and extract a stone attached to the tip of the pole which crumbles after a short time. Follow-up with a light attack to fling the stone toward an enemy or follow-up with a heavy attack to smash the stone downward in front of you.
items.obtain: Near the end of Redmane Castle, on a corpse at the foot of a large tree just east of the Redmane Staging Area site of grace.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Saw
items.desc: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Vulgar Militia Saw is found on a corpse just outside the Hidden Path to the Haligtree in the Consecrated Snowfield, guarded by crystal snails.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
items.desc: A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard. The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world.
items.fx:
Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Vulgar Militia Shotel is found on a corpse in an archway on the lower floor in Crumbling Farum Azula. From the "Beside the Great Bridge" Site of Grace, head west across the floating platforms to reach the location.

items.name: Grave Scythe
items.desc: Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between. This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Grave Scythe is obtained from a loot corpse in the graveyard located within the ruined section of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

items.name: Halo Scythe
items.desc: War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella. This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks. Can be powerstanced with the Cleanrot Knight's Sword; both weapons will use the reaper powerstancing moveset.

Unique Skill: Sacred Ring of Light
Skill used by the commanders of the Cleanrot Knights. Gather a sacred ring of light in the armament, then fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.
items.obtain: The Halo Scythe is obtained by defeating the Cleanrot Knight boss located in Stillwater Cave in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Obsidian Lamina
items.desc: Signature weapon of the Pureblood Knight Ansbach. A viciously keen and slender scythe made for combat. The obsidian edge relies not upon trickery to fulfil its violent purpose—through skill alone the wielder can rip and rend through foes, sowing blossoms of red upon the battlefield.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Unique Skill: Dynastic Sickleplay
A finessed evasive skill that creates space to maneuver. Inputs dictate direction of the backstep. Follow up with a strong attack to perform an advancing upward slash. Press strong attack again to bring the weapon back down.
items.obtain: The Obsidian Lamina is found on Sir Ansbach's corpse in the Promised Consort Radahn arena in Enir-Ilim. This requires completing Sir Ansbach's questline by handing him the Secret Rite Scroll while he is located in the Shadow Keep.

items.name: Rosus' Harvester
items.desc: Legend tells that this scythe was wielded by Rosus himself. As sometime guide for the dead, he also called upon them in times of need. The blade now carries the sinister taint of deathblight, a portent for what awaits all who hope for peaceful repose.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Unique Skill: Blighted Summoning
Infuse the weapon with deathblight and perform a sweeping slash, follow up with a heavy attack to perform an overhead slam that causes an explosion on impact and calls three ghostly skeletons to strike your foe.
items.obtain: Rosus’ Harvester is obtained by defeating the Tibia Mariner located at the Wyndham Ruins in the Altus Plateau, north of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill Site of Grace.

items.name: Scarlet Triscythe
items.desc: A triple-bladed scythe infused with Scarlet Rot. Once used by a fallen combatant of the festival, the blades have become a part of the now rotten landscape of Caelid.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rotten Assault
Invoke the essence of rot upon the blades and perform a double spinning lateral slash. Follow up with a heavy attack to bring the scythe down from above, which bursts on impact with an aeonian vortex.
items.obtain: The Scarlet Triscythe is found in the Radahn boss arena in Caelid, located near the area where the Site of Grace appears after the battle.

items.name: Scythe
items.desc: Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard. In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Skill: Spinning Slash
Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.
items.obtain: The Scythe is purchased from the Nomadic Merchant located east of Saintsbridge in Limgrave for 1,000 runes.

items.name: War Scythe
items.desc: A bulky scythe forged exclusively for battle. The blade is blunted from repeated use in combat and is exceptionally heavy, allowing for greater impact while striking foes.
items.fx:
War Scythe is a Scythe found near the Church of Irith and is a notable weapon for Dreadnought and Berserker.

Unique Skill: Lunging Harvest
Stomp your back foot and launch forward with a sweeping uppercut attack; follow up with another skill attack to perform a spinning swipe attack.
items.obtain: Found in a graveyard west of the Lake-Facing cliffs grace next to the Church of Irith.

items.name: Winged Scythe
items.desc: Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage. According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Unique Skill: Angel's Wings
Jump and imbue the wing-blade of the armament with light, then deliver a slashing attack on the enemy. This attack increases the holy damage the enemy receives by 10% for 20 seconds.
items.obtain: The Winged Scythe is found in a cellar room at the Tombsward Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula, guarded by two Pages.

items.name: Giant's Red Braid
items.desc: Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant. Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Flame Dance
Imbue the red braid with the Giants' Flame and lash out in a wide range with a series of agile swings.
items.obtain: The Giant’s Red Braid is obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Fire Giant with Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold. This Remembrance is acquired by defeating the Fire Giant in the arena south of the Foot of the Forge Site of Grace in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
items.desc: Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow. High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss. "The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood."
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: Hoslow’s Petal Whip can be obtained through a few methods: * Dropped by Juno Hoslow when defeated as part of the Volcano Manor assassination questline. * Dropped by Diallos Hoslow if killed outside of a truce zone. * Obtained by progressing through the Jarburg questline.

items.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
items.desc: This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir. When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Sea of Magma
Swing a molten whip overhead to temporarily cover the surrounding area in a sea of magma. Hold to continue swinging the lava whip.
items.obtain: The Magma Whip Candlestick is given to the player by Patches after completing the assassination request for Great Horned Tragoth. Tragoth's invasion sign appears in the Magma Wyrm Makar arena, but you must first defeat the boss for the sign to appear.

items.name: Thorned Whip
items.desc: Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin. Very effective at inflicting blood loss.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Thorned Whip is found in the Minor Erdtree Catacombs in Caelid. After descending the first elevator, head east; the weapon is located in a pool of rot near a Fire Prelate.

items.name: Tooth Whip
items.desc: Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike. As the wounds ripen they grow inflamed and ooze pus. The flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Painful Strike
A chastening whip strike, honed to maximize pain. Temporarily reduces the rate at which stamina recovers. Thus does the pain encourage obedience.
items.obtain: The Tooth Whip is found on a corpse inside the Whipping Hut, located near Bonney Village in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Urumi
items.desc: This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors. Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Urumi is found in Caria Manor. From the Manor Upper Level Site of Grace, head south and take the elevator down. Proceed down the stairs, jump across the gap in the railing to the left, and head right. The weapon is located behind a cluster of crystals that transforms into a Carian Troll Knight when attacked.

items.name: Whip
items.desc: A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain. Though its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Whip is found in Castle Morne. From the Western Lookout Tower Site of Grace, progress through the level until you've reached the tower you must drop down through after the coastal cliffs section. The whip is at the bottom of this tower on a corpse surrounded by rats.

items.name: Caestus
items.desc: A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Caestus is purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 800 runes. He can be found at the Gates of Stormveil or, after the boss is defeated, in Godrick the Grafted's arena.

items.name: Cipher Pata
items.desc: One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage. The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Unblockable Blade
Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.
items.obtain: The Cipher Pata is found in the Roundtable Hold. It is located downstairs, in the stables in the large water bowl in the Erdtree-themed corner.

items.name: Clinging Bone
items.desc: Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains. Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in. "O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand."
items.fx:
Skill: Lifesteal Fist
Skill that demonstrates mastery of the art of controlling vital energies. A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconscious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build.
items.obtain: The Clinging Bone is obtained by defeating the invader Ensha at the Roundtable Hold. To trigger this invasion, you must first obtain a piece of the Haligtree Secret Medallion—either by exhausting Albus' dialogue in the Village of the Albinaurics or by defeating the Cemetery Shade in the Black Knife Catacombs.

items.name: Daergraf's Opus
items.desc: A relic of Daergraf, former high priest of the fallen empire and champion of the underworld. These fists, made in the shape of his chief inspiration, were among the first artifacts that successfully channeled the power of the mighty Dragonkin.
items.fx:
Daergraf's Opus is a Fist found in Deeproot Depths and is a notable weapon for Underworld Mage.

Unique Skill: Frozen Lightning Orb
Charges to fire a frozen lightning orb forward, exploding on impact.
items.obtain: Found in Deeproot Depths on a corpse in a gated alley west of the gateway to the Nox complex.

items.name: Furnace Fists
items.desc: A pair of fist weapons created by the artificer responsible for the creation of Messmer's towering Furnace Golems. The fists act as everburning caldrons that call spirals of flames on command.
items.fx:
Furnace Fists are a Fist found in the Ruins of Unte and are a notable weapon for Flame Prophet.

Unique Skill: Fell Furnace
- Tapping slams into the ground and creates a massive explosion.
- Holding sends a beam of flame forward.
items.obtain: Found in the Ruins of Unte next to the deactivated Furnace Golem.

items.name: Golem Fist
items.desc: A giant fist of fractured rock. Taken from the body of a golem of the ruined forges. Carved with a smithscript enabling strong attacks to launch the entire fist straight ahead.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Golem Fist is found in Taylew's Ruined Forge, located in the Rauh Base region. You can acquire it at the end of the forge by interacting with the furnace.

items.name: Grafted Dragon
items.desc: The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm. The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.
items.fx:
> **Note:** This weapon is not a dual weapon but it can be power-stanced with other fist weapons. It cannot be two-handed.

Unique Skill: Bear Witness!
Grant the small dragon a fleeting glimpse of life and thrust it skyward, spewing flames over a wide frontward area.
items.obtain: The Grafted Dragon is obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Grafted with Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold. This Remembrance is acquired by defeating Godrick the Grafted in the arena past the Secluded Cell in Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.desc: Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice. Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Iron Ball is dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart upon his defeat. He can be found initially at the Boilprawn Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes, or later in the Leyndell moat. To move him to the moat, you must purchase a Boiled Prawn from him and unlock a Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Katar
items.desc: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Katar is found inside a chest in the lower room of Fort Gael in Caelid. To reach it, you must drop down from the higher ledge to access the room.

items.name: Madding Hand
items.desc: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with madness. Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Madding Spear-Hand Strike
Makes hand into the shape of a spear before unleashing a plunging stab that penetrates the body of the enemy. Afflicts foe with a large dose of madness.
items.obtain: Head Northwest from the Sarrulat, Basin Town Site of Grace. You will see the Madding Hand on a body, hanging from a hole in the wall. Hop up the cliff face to the left and go up the stairs to the right. Turn left and before the bridge there is a broken railing, drop down onto the wooden boat and turn around. The Madding Hand will be in the room ahead.

items.name: Pata
items.desc: A weapon comprised of a linear, double-sided blade attached to a substantial guard. Wielded by the Oathseeker Knights. This versatile armament can be swung about like a fist or used in the manner of a straight sword.
items.fx:
Skill: Impaling Thrust
Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Pata is found in the Gravesite Plains. It is located on a corpse hanging on a cliff near the Church of Benediction.

items.name: Poisoned Hand
items.desc: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with deadly poison. Raises attack power when poisoning occurs in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who have had everything burned or stolen from them, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Poison Spear-Hand Strike
Makes hand into the shape of a spear before unleashing a plunging stab that penetrates the body of the enemy. Afflicts foe with a large dose of deadly poison.
items.obtain: The Poisoned Hand is found on a corpse sitting in the northern section of the poison lake within Belurat, Tower Settlement.

items.name: Spiked Caestus
items.desc: A caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes. Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Spiked Caestus is purchased from the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Dragonbarrow, Caelid, for 4,000 runes.

items.name: Star Fist
items.desc: Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss. Used in brutal games of pugilism.
items.fx:
Skill: Endure
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.
items.obtain: The Star Fist is found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. It is located to the left of the entrance to the Leyndell Colosseum.

items.name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
items.desc: Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes. Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Sleep Evermore
Pierces the enemy deeply with a poison-coated needle that delivers eternal sleep. If the follow-up strike lands upon a foe who is already in a state of slumber or eternal sleep, it will deal significant damage.
items.obtain: Thiollier’s Hidden Needle can be obtained in two ways: * By exhausting Thiollier's questline, specifically choosing the "I am weary of life" dialogue option after delivering Black Syrup to him. * By looting his corpse in Enir-Ilim near the Gate of Divinity after the final boss fight.

items.name: Veteran's Prosthesis
items.desc: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Storm Kick
Thrust the prosthetic leg blade into the ground, creating a storm. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lightning-infused jumping attack.
items.obtain: The Veteran’s Prosthesis is obtained by defeating Commander Niall at Castle Sol in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

items.name: Bracelet of Gold
items.desc: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks. A golden ring worn around the arm of certain berserker clans to symbolize a connection with their animalistic nature.
items.fx:
Bracelet of Gold is a Hand-to-Hand Art dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the Capital Outskirts, and is a notable weapon for Retainer, Vanguard, Dreadnought, Berserker.

Unique Skill: Berserker's Leap
Leaps forward through the air and creates a massive shockwave when landing.
items.obtain: Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the Capital Outskirts near the Minor Erdtree Church.

items.name: Bracelet of Shadow
items.desc: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques. An ornament of the oathsworn Nox assassins, assisting them greatly to travel unseen.
items.fx:
Bracelet of Shadow is a Hand-to-Hand Art found in Mirage Rise and is a notable weapon for Retainer, Vanguard, Sellsword, and Rogue.

Unique Skill: Shadow Dash
Teleports forward and creates a massive shockwave on exit.
items.obtain: Found atop Mirage Rise after completing the puzzle.

items.name: Dane's Footwork
items.desc: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art focuses on kicking techniques. This kick-based martial art is unique to Dane, a Dryleaf and sworn ally of Leda. He acquired these skills by training with the aid of a waterfall; letting the water beat his body, and throwing himself into its basin.
items.fx:
Skill: Palm Blast
Skill of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Imbues hand with energy before using a palm strike to unleash an explosive blast. The already formidable power and impact can be bolstered by charging the attack.
items.obtain: Dane’s Footwork is found on the corpse of Dryleaf Dane in Enir-Ilim after defeating him alongside the followers of Miquella.

items.name: Dryleaf Arts
items.desc: A technique for hand-to-hand combat without the aid of a weapon. This martial art combines fist strikes and kicks. The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.
items.fx:
Skill: Palm Blast
Skill of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Imbues hand with energy before using a palm strike to unleash an explosive blast. The already formidable power and impact can be bolstered by charging the attack.
items.obtain: The Dryleaf Arts are obtained by defeating Dryleaf Dane in a duel at the Moorth Ruins in Scadu Altus. You must use the "May the Best Win" gesture in front of Dane to initiate the duel.

items.name: Rancor Touch
items.desc: A technique in the style of the Dryleaf Arts but mouldering with undeath and the rancorous spirits of necromancy. Perhaps a result of the meddling of putrescent sorcerers, many such oddities are hidden in the dark places of the Land of Shadows.
items.fx:
Rancor Touch is a Hand-to-Hand Art found in the Caelid Catacombs and is a notable weapon for Necromancer.

Unique Skill: Rancorous Summoning
Summons many rancor skulls from the group which home in on enemies. Enchants the weapon with ghostflame, causing charged attacks to create a small explosion.
items.obtain: Found in the Caelid Catacombs on top of an altar guarded by a Mausoleum Knight.

items.name: Bloodhound Claws
items.desc: Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights. The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.
items.fx:
> **Note:** Ignores 40% of damage negation from blocks on light attacks and 50% of damage negation from blocks on heavy attacks.

Skill: Bloodhound's Step
Skill that allows the user to become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. Moves faster and travels farther than a regular quickstep. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Bloodhound Claws are dropped by a Bloodhound Knight found in the hidden section of Volcano Manor, located before the Prison Town Church site of grace.

items.name: Claws of Night
items.desc: Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night. Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Scattershot Throw
Employ smithing arts to conjure multiple copies of the armament in both hands and throw them all at once. Follow up with an additional input to throw again.
items.obtain: The Claws of Night are dropped by Swordhand of Night Anna upon defeating her in the Finger Ruins of Miyr, located in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Emyr's Great Talons
items.desc: A pair of impractically large claws once wielded by Emyr, assassin of Sulien and scourge of the north. The blades draw blood easily from foes and can only be used by the especially agile.
items.fx:
Emyr's Great Talons are a Claw found in Mt. Gelmir and are a notable weapon for Sellsword and Rogue.

Unique Skill: Evisceration
Lunges forward and deals many slashes.
items.obtain: Found near some Abductor Virgins before the long ladder just past the Bridge of Iniquity grace.

items.name: Hookclaws
items.desc: Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect. Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Hookclaws are found in Stormveil Castle. From the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace, head into the first storeroom. The claws are located on a body in a corner near a flight of stairs.

items.name: Raptor Talons
items.desc: Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds. Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Raptor Talons are found inside the Sage's Cave in the Altus Plateau. Progress through the cave, revealing multiple hidden walls, until you reach a room with two chests to your right and one to your left. The weapon is located in the left chest of the pair.

items.name: Stone Claws
items.desc: Made as a gift to one of the founding members of the Bestial Devout who had found his way, quite by accident, to the ancient city of Farum Azula.
items.fx:
Stone Claws are a Claw found in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree and are a notable weapon for Bestial Devout.

Unique Skill: Bestial Mauling
Swipes many times, ending with a large swipe upward that knocks back enemies. During the attack, absorptions are increased by 45% and the player cannot stagger for 3 seconds.
items.obtain: Found in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, proceed through the area until you get to a Runebear, kill it or run passed it and go down the stairs and into the small room behind them, where the weapon lays on the floor guarded by vulgar militiamen.

items.name: Venomous Fang
items.desc: One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum. The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.
items.fx:
Skill: Quickstep
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.
items.obtain: The Venomous Fang is found inside the Abandoned Cave in Caelid. Head to the large room before the boss and jump up onto the Abductor Virgin corpses located on the left side of the room to reach it.

items.name: Beast Claws (Item)
items.desc: Weapon in the form of a carnivorous beast's vicious claws. Used to perform bestial slashing attacks uncanny to humankind. An imitation of the esoteric technique of the horned warriors. Those who carry this weapon wield it as though they have been possessed by a savage beast.
items.fx:
Skill: Savage Claws
Pounce like a beast to viciously slash into foe with left and right claws.
items.obtain: The Beast Claws are dropped by Logur the Beast Claw upon defeating him in the Gravesite Plains.

items.name: Goras’ Claws
items.desc: Goras was born of dreams, the incorporeal form of a mighty runebear lost to eternal slumber. A chance encounter in the dream realm with the Spiritshaper offered a return to the waking world, albeit now bound in service.
items.fx:
Goras' Claws is a Beast Claw dropped by Goras, Scourge of Dreams and is a notable weapon for Mystic.

Unique Skill: Roar of Goras
Lets out a roar which explodes spirit vapors around the player. A follow up skill leaps forward and slams down more mystic vapor.
items.obtain: Dropped by Goras, Scourge of Dreams just outside of Nokron on the way to Siofra Plateau.

items.name: Red Bear's Claw
items.desc: Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Red Bear Hunt
Slaughters prey with sharp claws in a great swipe of the arm. The attack creates a vacuum which deals continuous damage. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.
items.obtain: The Red Bear’s Claw is dropped by Red Bear upon defeating him in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum, located in the Rauh Base.

items.name: Transcendent Talons
items.desc: While his lust for knowledge yielded powerful results, Daergraf's journey ultimately left him utterly bereft of humanity.
items.fx:
Transcendent Talons are a Beast Claw purchased from Enia and are a notable weapon for Underworld Mage.

Unique Skill: Transcendent Stance
Conjures two swords in a stance position, then activates after using a light or heavy attack.
- Light attack is a three-move combo that swipes two spears in an cross twice, then spins them around left twice, then spins them right once and ends with a cross swipe forward.
- Heavy attack jumps into the air spinning, then plunges a spear into the ground, which then explodes.
items.obtain: Can be purchased from Enia in Roundtable Hold after deafting Daergraf, Underworld Archmage.

items.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
items.desc: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing an icy chill.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Chilling Perfume Bottle is found in the Lamenter's Gaol, located in the Cerulean Coast. It is on a corpse sitting against the rock wall in the lower levels of the gaol.

items.name: Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle
items.desc: Perfume bottle customized by Thiollier. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing deadly poison.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Deadly Poison Spray
Swings the perfume bottle overhead, wafting perfumed powder of deadly poison over a wide area. Poison shall dance upon the air and pour down in quiet calm.
items.obtain: The Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle is sold by Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross Site of Grace for 6,000 Runes.

items.name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
items.desc: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing sparks of fire.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Firespark Perfume Bottle is found in a chest south of the Castle Front Site of Grace in the Gravesite Plains.

items.name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
items.desc: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing frenzied flame.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: Head East from the Sarrulat, Basin Town Site of Grace. Go through the stables and up the ladder on the other side. Head right and turn left to the alley before the couryard. The Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle will be at the altar, in front of the headless corpse.

items.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
items.desc: Perfume bottle remade into a weapon by perfumers of the realm of shadow. Attacks release perfumed powder, producing lightning.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Lightning Perfume Bottle is found on a corpse lying in a pond near the Rauh Reliquary of the Thunder-Bound site of grace, north of the Cerulean Coast.

items.name: Bone Bow
items.desc: A crude shortbow fashioned from sickly bone. A medium for spirit-calling, and a product of the ancient hexing arts of the tower.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Rancor Shot
Imbue arrows with vengeful spirits, before firing off a barrage. Imbued arrows chase down foes as they cut through the air.
items.obtain: The Bone Bow is found in Belurat, Tower Settlement. It is located on a corpse in a circular room guarded by two Monstrous Spider Scorpions.

items.name: Composite Bow
items.desc: Bow composited from a mix of materials. Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.
items.fx:
Skill: Mighty Shot
Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Composite Bow is sold by the Nomadic Merchant in North Liurnia of the Lakes for 3,500 Runes.

items.name: Harp Bow
items.desc: Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows. Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.
items.fx:
Skill: Barrage
Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
items.obtain: The Harp Bow is obtained in the Altus Plateau. You must first acquire the "Champion's Song" Painting from the Shaded Castle, then approach the phantom located west of the Rampartside Path Site of Grace.

items.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
items.desc: Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it. Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.
items.fx:
Skill: Barrage
Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
items.obtain: The Misbegotten Shortbow is found in the Weeping Peninsula. It is located in a basin east of the Church of Pilgrimage, surrounded by Miranda Sprouts.

items.name: Red Branch Shortbow
items.desc: Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages. A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.
items.fx:
Skill: Barrage
Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
items.obtain: The Red Branch Shortbow is found in Liurnia. It is resting inside a basin near the Fingercreepers southwest of Caria Manor.

items.name: Scadu Sapling
items.desc: A gnarled sprig of the Scadu Tree, curved into a light bow and glowing with golden sap. The sap of shadow is covetous of substance, enrobing and dominating at the gentlest touch.
items.fx:
Scadu Sapling is a Lightbow found in the Shaman Village and is a notable weapon for Fundamentalist and Marksman.

Unique Skill: Scadu Shot
Fires a golden projectile forward. Moving side to side or away from the target will leap the player into the air while firing.
- This projectile is always holy and will ignore ammunition type.

Deals 50% more damage to undead enemies.
items.obtain: Obtained in the Shaman Village, on the corpse within the tree behind the small square house up the hill.

items.name: Shortbow
items.desc: Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
items.fx:
Skill: Barrage
Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
items.obtain: The Shortbow can be purchased from the Woodsman Merchant in East Limgrave for 2,000 Runes.

items.name: Albinauric Bow
items.desc: Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers. This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.
items.fx:
Skill: Mighty Shot
Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Albinauric Bow is found in the Consecrated Snowfield. It is located near the Albinauric Rise, positioned between three Graven Masses.

items.name: Ansbach's Longbow
items.desc: Weapon of Sir Ansbach. A longbow consisting of two bow bodies and two strings. Unusually for a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a light bow—provided that the wielder has the extraordinary dexterity demanded.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Fan Shot
This skill uses the bow held horizontally. Readies eight arrows at once, firing them in a fan-shaped arc.
items.obtain: Ansbach’s Longbow is obtained by either defeating or assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Shadow Keep.

items.name: Black Bow
items.desc: Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master. The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.
items.fx:
Skill: Barrage
Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.
items.obtain: The Black Bow is found in Leyndell, Royal Capital. It is located on a corpse on the rooftops north of the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace.

items.name: Devonia's Longbow
items.desc: A bow styled from the age of the eternal crucible, once carried by Devonia, Crucible Knight. This bow reflects the dogma of the hornsent and the crucible knights alike, much as the crucible itself, spiraling to eternity.
items.fx:
Devonia's Longbow is a Longbow found in Temple Town Ruins and is a notable weapon for Bestial Devout and Marksman.

Skill: Spiral Shot
Fires five arrows in quick succession.

Deals 50% more damage to undead enemies.
items.obtain: Obtained from the chest at the top of the Temple Town Ruins in the Rauh Ruins Base.

items.name: Erdtree Bow
items.desc: Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.
items.fx:
Skill: Mighty Shot
Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Erdtree Bow is found on a corpse on the lower floor of the Roundtable Hold, positioned on a carpet between two candelabras.

items.name: Horn Bow
items.desc: Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers. Imbues arrows fired with magic damage. Reveals its true worth when used with magic-infused arrows.
items.fx:
Skill: Enchanted Shot
Archery skill that enlivens the arrow with spiritual essence. The resulting shot will fly faster than regular shots and change its trajectory to follow the target.
items.obtain: The Horn Bow is found on a corpse underneath the bridge leading to the Regal Ancestor Spirit arena in the Siofra River.

items.name: Longbow
items.desc: Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage. To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.
items.fx:
Skill: Mighty Shot
Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Longbow can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,200 Runes.

items.name: Pulley Bow
items.desc: Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.
items.fx:
Skill: Mighty Shot
Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Pulley Bow is found on a corpse on the top of the tower west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Serpent Bow
items.desc: Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows. Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.
items.fx:
Skill: Mighty Shot
Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: The Serpent Bow is found on a corpse in a rot-filled pit inside the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.

items.name: Erdtree Greatbow
items.desc: Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow. Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.
items.fx:
Skill: Titanic Shot
Powerful archery skill using greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies.
items.obtain: The Erdtree Greatbow is found in a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Golem Greatbow
items.desc: Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem. Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not for human use.
items.fx:
Skill: Titanic Shot
Powerful archery skill using greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies.
items.obtain: The Golem Greatbow is obtained by defeating the Golem Archer in a tower at Castle Morne. The tower is accessed by following the wall to the west from the entrance to Castle Morne Town before entering the town.

items.name: Greatbow
items.desc: Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary. A greatbow can only fire Great arrows.
items.fx:
Skill: Titanic Shot
Powerful archery skill using greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies.
items.obtain: The Greatbow can be looted from a chest at the top of the Highway Lookout Tower near the Windmill Village in the Altus Plateau.

items.name: Igon's Greatbow
items.desc: Weapon of Igon, the broken drake warrior. A greatbow fashioned from two dragon bones bound with coarse rope. Covered in gashes left by claws. Imbued with Igon's obsession, enhancing the power of Igon's Harpoon.
items.fx:
Skill: Titanic Shot
Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate the enemy's guard.
items.obtain: Igon’s Greatbow can be obtained by killing Igon near the Pillar Path Waypoint Site of Grace in the Gravesite Plains, or by finding it on his corpse in the Jagged Peak after defeating Bayle the Dread.

items.name: Lion Greatbow
items.desc: Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif. Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with Radahn's Spear, it become a true weapon of a champion.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Radahn's Rain
Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow and fire a sudden flurry of arrows up into the sky. The arrows will pour on foes like rain.
items.obtain: The Lion Greatbow can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia at the Roundtable Hold for 2,000 Runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn at the arena in the desert behind Redmane Castle.

items.name: Arbalest
items.desc: Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt-firing devices. Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even helms forged of steel.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Arbalest is found on a corpse in the main gate path of Stormveil Castle. Progress uphill passed the main gate ballista and go left up the rocky ledges behind it to a ladder guarded by an enemy with an axe. Proceed up the ladder and follow the path around to another ladder to go up. At the top, run passed the Banished Knight to the bridge with a crossbowmen on it, be careful of ballista fire, then drop down from the bridge and go down the stairs. Jump up the rocky ledges across from the ballista and then jump across to the platform its on to find the Arbalest.

items.name: Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow
items.desc: Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has very long range. Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: Crepus’s Black-Key Crossbow is found in a chest on the lower floor of the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Full Moon Crossbow
items.desc: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the house of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy-infused bolts.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Full Moon Crossbow is found in a chest at the top of the highest tower on the Academy Rooftops in Raya Lucaria. From the Academy Rooftops site of grace, drop down on to the next section of roof to the north, then make the difficult jump across to the west on to the higher part of the roof. After making the jump head south and follow the rooftops to the base of the tower, then take the ladder to the top to reach the chest.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.desc: Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt. Commonly employed in the Shattering
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Heavy Crossbow is found on a corpse sitting on the side of a tower in the Castle Storeroom area of Stormveil Castle. The corpse is guarded by an Exile Soldier shooting a ballista.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.desc: Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Light Crossbow can be purchased from the Woodsman Merchant in Limgrave for 2,000 Runes.

items.name: Pulley Crossbow
items.desc: Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism. One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Pulley Crossbow is found on a corpse sitting on an elevated platform at the Craftsman's Shack in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Repeating Crossbow
items.desc: A mechanized crossbow that has been fitted with a fan-shaped contraption. This metallic piece adds a reloading system used in the execution of a unique battle art.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Repeating Fire
This skill readies the weapon's rapid-fire mechanism. Once in ready stance, crank the handle to fire bolts in rapid succession.
items.obtain: Fort of Reprimand, progress through the fort until you cross the bridge with the elevator shortcut. Go through the building on the left after crossing the bridge and then into a tower with a spiral staircase immediately to the right after exiting the building. At the top of the spiral staircase is the chest containing the Repeating Crossbow.

items.name: Spread Crossbow
items.desc: A modified crossbow made by combining two crossbows into one. Capable of loading multiple bolts and firing them simultaneously, enabling a spread of fire.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Spread Crossbow is found on a corpse in a camp in the Gravesite Plains, surrounded by three Messmer Soldiers.

items.name: Soldier's Crossbow
items.desc: A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy. Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Soldier’s Crossbow can be purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave for 750 Runes.

items.name: Hand Ballista
items.desc: An unconventional ballistic device modeled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts. Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle or facing an entire army alone.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Hand Ballista is found in a chest at the top of the tower that overlooks the bridge connecting Limgrave and the Weeping Peninsula.

items.name: Jar Cannon
items.desc: Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload. Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: The Jar Cannon is obtained by defeating Demi-Human Queen Margot inside the Volcano Cave in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Rabbath's Cannon
items.desc: A type of jar cannon used to fire greatbolts. A masterwork of Spellmachinist Rabbath. The power of the glintstones that encircle the barrel imbues bolts with magic damage and guides shots toward their targets.
items.fx:
Skill: Kick
Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.
items.obtain: Rabbath’s Cannon is found in a chest on the upper floor of Rabbath's Rise in Scadu Altus.

items.name: Beast-Repellent Torch
items.desc: A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts. Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.
items.fx:
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
items.obtain: The Beast-Repellent Torch is found on a corpse at the end of the Groveside Cave in Limgrave.

items.name: Ghostflame Torch
items.desc: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity. This torch increases the damage of Death sorceries by 10%.
items.fx:
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
items.obtain: The Ghostflame Torch is obtained after defeating the Death Bird found northeast of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

items.name: Lamenting Visage
items.desc: A stone lantern carved to resemble a lamenting human head, the eyes vacantly beaming out light. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area. The unusual expression somehow imparts a sense of contentment. The languid ease of one who needs not sight.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Blindfold of Happiness
Swing the head while covering the eyes, unleashing a wail of lamentation while temporarily making the user of this skill harder to see. To those who seek happiness, blindness is bliss.
items.obtain: The Lamenting Visage is found on a corpse on the lower levels of the Lamenter's Gaol in the Cerulean Coast, located behind an illusory wall.

items.name: Nanaya's Torch
items.desc: A torch made by attaching a dying flame of frenzy to a small spinal column. In a distant land, in an age long past, was born a man who failed to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. All that remains of him is cradled gently by Nanaya.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Feeble Lord's Frenzied Flame
Hold torch out in front and spit out frenzied flame. Afflicts those caught in its area of effect with madness, along with the user themselves. The skill will continue for as long as the button is held down. Can be used while moving.
items.obtain: Nanaya’s Torch is found on Nanaya's corpse in Midra's Library at Midra's Manse.

items.name: Sentry's Torch
items.desc: Torch given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.
items.fx:
Skill:  Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze.
This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
items.obtain: Leyndell Outskirts - Bought from the Hermit Merchant in the Hermit Merchant's Shack for 7000 runes.

items.name: St. Trina's Torch
items.desc: Candlestand torch that burns with a light-purple flame. The carvings depict St. Trina, but in adult form, somewhat unnervingly. The light-purple flame induces sleep. This torch increases the damage of Mystic incantations by 10%.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Fires of Slumber
Blow into the candlestick's flame, creating a stream of hazy purple fire to cover the ground ahead. The intoxicating flames inflict the sleep ailment upon foes.
items.obtain: St. Trina’s Torch is found in Nokron, Eternal City, northeast of the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace, next to the stag carcass and the singing Ancestral Shaman.

items.name: Steel-Wire Torch
items.desc: Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies. Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament emits great heat.
items.fx:
Skill: Firebreather
Blow into torch flame, spreading flames in a wide frontward arc. The flames on the ground will continue to burn for a short time.
items.obtain: The Steel-Wire Torch is found at the top of the castle-side stairs in Castle Morne, specifically in the area targeted by the Golem archer.

items.name: Torch
items.desc: This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or used to attack enemies. Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand, illuminating more of the surrounding area.
items.fx:
Skill: Torch Attack
Thrust torch forward to set foes ablaze. This skill is especially effective against foes who are weak to fire.
items.obtain: The Torch can be purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave for 200 Runes.

items.name: Smithscript Rosary
items.desc: A weapon that contains the combined conjuration techniques of the entire Smithscript lexicon. Grants the wearer the ability to conjure various Smithscript weapons and perform either single attacks or follow-up attacks with those weapons. Capable of conjuring a straight sword, axe, great hammer, dagger, spear, shield, quarterstaff and throwing knives.
items.fx:
Smithscript Rosary is a Misc Weapon found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past and is a notable weapon for Retainer and Vanguard. It has a very unique moveset, with every attack conjuring a different Smithscript weapon.

Unique Skill: Smithscript Arsenal
While used on its own, temporarily boosts poise. While attacking or guarding, performs a conjured weapon attack based on the current weapon that is summoned.
- Dagger: somersault in the direction of movement which summons a cloud that flies up and then shoots down daggers.
- Sword: charges up the sword and then launches forward.
- Quarterstaff: spins around then throws forward, leaving it dealing lingering damage.
- Shield: spins around and throws the shield forward.
- Greathammer: jumps into the air and throws the greathammer down into the ground.
- Spear: jumps into the air and lunges down into the ground, conjuring spikes on impact.
- Axe: throws the axe forward, then a follow up skill spins around and throws another axe forward.
items.obtain: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past, obtained from the altar at the end of the forge.

items.name: Blue-White Wooden Shield
items.desc: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is adorned with ancient runes meant to conjure the power of storms.
items.fx:
Increases the damage of Storm sorceries by 10%.

Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: The Blue-White Wooden Shield is found in Stormveil Castle. From the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, head southeast to the elevator. Turn left twice; the weapon is located across from the entrance, guarded by a Banished Knight and two Exiled Knights.

items.name: Buckler
items.desc: A small metal roundshield. The bump in the center is designed to parry. A well-timed parry deflects an enemy's attack, breaking their stance and leaving them open to a critical hit. Though risk is inherent, this shield favors aggression.
items.fx:
Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Rogue class. Found on a corpse at the Stormhill Shack.

items.name: Coil Shield
items.desc: Armament designed for gladiatorial combat. Rises above its peers as a particularly showy specimen. The sculpted bronze snake is a poisonous breed, boosting the wielder's resistance to poison.
items.fx:
Raises Immunity by 40.

Unique Skill: Viper Bite
Give the shield a quick shake to temporarily bring the bronze viper to life, inciting it to lash out and bite foes.
items.obtain: Found in the Volcano Cave. Enter the cave and proceed through. At the first fork in your path, take the rightmost path in the dark section of the room. Drop down onto the cliff at the end of this path, then immediately turn around and continue. The Coil Shield will be on the left side of the next room.

items.name: Gilded Iron Shield
items.desc: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. Though the gold leaf is peeling and the effect is slight, it still boosts holy damage negation.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Fundamentalist class. Located at the Church of Pilgrimage on the north side of the Weeping Peninsula. Shield is located on a grave on the west side of the building.

items.name: Hermit's Buckler
items.desc: A small round buckler adorned with leaves
items.fx:
Raises stamina recovery by 3/second.

Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: From the Mausoleum Compound Site of Grace, head west past the starting location for the Mystic. Head down the path to the south and into the forest where the Hermit's Buckler will be on a corpse in a chair in the clearing.

items.name: Ice Crest Shield
items.desc: Small metal roundshield. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation. The ice crest originates from a Carian princess.
items.fx:
This shield increases the damage of Frost sorceries by 10%.

Raises Robustness by 40.

Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: Found deep in Caria Manor. From the Carian Barbican Site of Grace, head southwest down the stairs and then down the elevator. From there head directly across to the stairs, leading to the large crystals and the mostly empty room with some bookcases. There will be a chest on the right side of the room containing the Ice Crest Shield.

items.name: Iron Roundshield
items.desc: An ordinary small roundshield made of metal. Heavier than a wooden shield, but boasts higher damage negation.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Servant of Rot class.

items.name: Man-Serpent's Shield
items.desc: Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir.
items.fx:
Increases the damage of Magma sorceries by 10%.

Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: From the Prison Town Church Site of Grace, head down the street to the right until you can drop down to an area on your left with a large bonfire and an Omenkiller. Across from where you dropped you'll see a small archway to go through. Continue through it until you reach a cliff face and take a right. Head down the stairs and the rocky outcroppings until you reach a large circular section of graves. The Man-Serpent's Shield will be across from the entrance to this grave area guarded by a Living Jar.

items.name: Perfumer's Shield
items.desc: Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service. Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.
items.fx:
Raises Immunity by 40.

Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Perfumer class. Located in the Auriza Side Tomb. Start heading through the tomb, at the first junction you can choose to either jump out the window or take the transporter trap as you'll end up in the same room either way. Head into the large room and take the first left, running through a small corridor before entering a sewer. Turn right and take the transporter trap. The Perfumer's Shield will be right in front of you.

items.name: Pillory Shield
items.desc: Pillory made to punish serious felons, used as a shield. Though made of good, sturdy wood, it is only a makeshift tool and performs as such. Perhaps due to its use as a device with which the guilty were made to endure prolonged suffering, it raises vitality.
items.fx: Raises vitality by 50.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Flame Prophet class. Inside Gaol Cave. After hitting the lever to open all the doors, drop down to the area below and take a left. The Pillory Shield will be in the very back of the first room on your left.

items.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
items.desc: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. Its emblem is an ancient thorn design. Though it isn't much, it boosts fire damage negation.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Blood Initiate class.

items.name: Rickety Shield
items.desc: A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines. There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Frenzied Zealot class.

items.name: Rift Shield
items.desc: Small metal roundshield depicting a sinister rift to the depths of the cosmos.
items.fx:
Increases the damage of Gravity sorceries by 10%.

Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant (North Liurnia), North of Bellum Church.

items.name: Riveted Wooden Shield
items.desc: Small wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a true metal shield. The design reveted to the center represents both sword and tree.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Marksman class.

items.name: Scripture Wooden Shield
items.desc: A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield. An ancient cipher engraving lines the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Starting equipment for the Glint Sorcerer class. In East Limgrave. Starting from the Summonwater Village Site of Grace, head straight east. Upon hitting a cliff, look south to notice a graveyard directly below you. Drop down to the graveyard and the shield will be on one of the coffins.

items.name: Shield of Alacrity
items.desc: A small metal shield in the shape of a wreath of feathers.
items.fx:
Grants 30 additional spell casting speed.

Skill: Bucklers Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.
items.obtain: In the Cliffbottom Catacombs, proceed through the catacombs as normal until you eventually reach a room with a crystal dart trap, a Banished Knight, and two Exile Knights. The Shield of Alacrity will be sitting on the ground between them.

items.name: Shield of the Guilty
items.desc: Shield made to venerate a maiden whose eyes were crushed by Briars of Sin before being reborn in these lands.
items.fx:
This shield increases the damage of Aberrant sorceries by 10%.

Skill: Shield Bash
Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.

Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.
items.obtain: Obtained from a corpse located in the Aberrant Camp in Eastern Liurnia, southeast from the Church of Vows.

items.name: Smithscript Shield
items.desc: Roundshield engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Discus Hurl
Throws the roundshield like a discus using the smithing arts. Once thrown, the shield will remain airborne for a moment before beginning a vertical rotation that cases down its target.
items.obtain: Found in Taylew's Ruined Forge.

items.name: Smoldering Shield
items.desc: Small shield made in the Forge of the Giants, in the uncooling flame of ruin.
items.fx:
This shield increases the damage of Giantsflame incantations by 10%.

Raises Robustness by 30.

Skill: Buckler Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This is faster than a regular parry.

items.name: Spiralhorn Shield
items.desc: Small shield of antlers arranged in an eddy-like pattern. If used to attack a foe, the shield's antlers inflict blood loss. Once given to a Tarnished warrior who cultivated close ties to the ancestral followers. Though the effect is only slight, it boosts immunity, robustness, and focus.
items.fx:
Raises immunity, robustness, and focus by 50

Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: From the Mausoleum Compound Site of Grace, head south across the pond to the small hill next to the Walking Mausoleum. The shield will be on the edge overlooking the path up to the area.

items.name: Aegis of Hadea
items.fx:
Aegis of Hadea
A conjured shield capable of channeling incantations.

Skill
Cast Incantation: Cast your selected spell through this weapon. Raise the shield to conjure an energy barrier. This barrier is capable of blocking attacks and will absorb any incoming spells. While guarding, your FP is slowly consumed but when you block an attack or absorb a spell, some FP will be restored.

Guarded Negation
Physical | Magic | Fire | Lightning | Holy | Guard Boost
90.0 | 55.0 | 55.0 | 55.0 | 65.0 | 55
items.obtain: Hidden Path to the Haligtree – Found in a chest in a small chamber with several Vulgar Militia Men, directly across from the boss chamber.

items.name: Albinauric Shield
items.desc: Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics. The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Banished Knight's Shield
items.desc: A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

items.name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
items.desc: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. Features a beast as its crest, serving to remind warriors not to succumb to the arousal of battle. Fight with passion, but become not its prisoner.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Beastman's Jar-Shield
items.desc: Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it. The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Black Leather Shield
items.desc: Roundshield covered in black leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. From the north, this shield depicts the polar star in rivets of gold. The inside is lined with fur, protecting the carrier from frost.

items.name: Blue-Gold Kite Shield
items.desc: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Highly reputed for its solid build and reliability. The design represents the Erdtree foregrounded against a blue sky.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
items.desc: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest represents a forest and river.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Brass Shield
items.desc: On the larger side for a medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass. This shield became an unofficial crest of the warriors of the golden order.
items.fx:
Reduces the FP cost of incantations by 5%.

Skill: Golden Parry
Perform an Erdtree incantation and swing the shield to deflect enemy attacks and break their stance.

Effective even at a slight distance

items.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
items.desc: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Thought to represent a surreptitious prophecy of cardinal sin, the lit candle-tree design was forbidden.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Carian Knight's Shield
items.desc: A teardrop-shaped, medium-sized shield embedded with blue glintstones. Carried by knights who served the Carian royal family. Excels when facing magic or holy attacks. Just who were these knights preparing to fight?
items.obtain: From the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace, head south and then out the east door of the church. From the doorway you should be able to see some purple crystals jutting out from the cliff forming a makeshift bridge to the other side. On the other side, the shield is on the ground in front of the lone gravestone on the cliff.

items.name: Crest of the Dragon Cult
items.desc: A gravelstone kite shield emblazoned with the golden sigil of the Dragon Cult of Leyndell.
items.fx: Increases the damage of Dragon Cult incantations by 10%.
items.obtain: Dropped by a Leyndell Knight, south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
items.desc: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The sun in eclipse is said to be the symbol of the Wandering Mausoleum where the soulless demigods slumber.
items.obtain: Sitting on a corpse atop a pillar north from of Tombsward Rise, accessed by dropping down from above by heading west from the Weeping Peninsula Minor Erdtree site of grace.

items.name: Flame Crest Wooden Shield
items.desc: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Carried by soldiers of the village that is afflicted by frenzy. The yellow flame is the symbol of the affliction, serving as a warning to those who might approach the village.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Great Turtle Shell
items.desc: Shield fashioned from a great turtle shell. The natural curve helps it contend with foes' attacks. The turtle is a symbol of tirelessness, and this shield boosts stamina recovery speed..
items.fx:
Raises stamina recovery by 3/second.

Skill: Barricade Shield
Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt.
