Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows.
items.obtain: Dropped by the Giant Turtle directly south from the Collector Merchant's Shack site of grace after killing the smaller turtles nearby.

items.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
items.desc: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle. Adorned with a long-forgotten crest of Stormveil, ancient in design.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Found behind (west side) the last building on the left as you ride up through the last section of the Academy Gate Town towards the South Raya Lucaria Gate site of grace, in Liurnia.

items.name: Heater Shield
items.desc: A medium-sized metal shield, comparatively easy to handle. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Horse Crest Wooden Shield
items.desc: A tall, medium-sized wooden shield. Light for its size, and easy to handle The circular horsehead design evokes a swift gallop.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Heater Shield
items.desc: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Kite Shield
items.desc: A standard medium-sized metal shield. Metal shields reliably negate physical damage when guarding, a trait which made them highly trusted on the battlefield.

items.name: Large Leather Shield
items.desc: A roundshield covered in leather. On the larger side for a medium-sized shield. Though its damage negation may be lacking compared to a metal shield, it can handle a wider range of attack affinities
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Marred Leather Shield
items.desc: Leather shield of Stomveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

items.name: Marred Wooden Shield
items.desc: Wooden shield of Stormveil soldiers. Much like the castle, it is marred by mottling and thorns. Some say it is the curse of grafting which causes such affliction, while others talk of its root being something altogether more sinister hidden deep within the castle.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Shield
items.desc: Worn roundshield carried by soldiers loyal to Messmer, the Impaler. The largest of all metal shields in their class.
items.obtain: In a chest underneath the Castle Ensis Checkpoint site of grace.

items.name: Red Crest Heater Shield
items.desc: A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield. The crest symbolizes red wings.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Round Shield
items.desc: A wooden roundshield that has been reinforced with metal. Comparatively light for its size, this shield is easy to handle but lacks a true metal shield's ability to negate damage.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Scorpion Kite Shield
items.desc: Emblazoned with a yellow scorpion, a warning of surprise attacks and sudden strikes.
items.fx:
Increases the damage of Servants of Rot incantations by 10%.

Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Serpent Crest Shield
items.desc: A finely-made "redshield" featuring an engraving of a winged serpent. Excels at guarding against fire. Said to have been made to commemorate the beginnings of the crusade started by Messmer, son of Marika.
items.obtain: Reward for the Incursion Painting just south of the lake with the BlackFlame Dragon in the Gravesite Plains

items.name: Shield of Starlight
items.desc: A kite shield adorned with a large shard of starlight in its center.
items.fx: Grants an additional 1 FP regeneration per second.

items.name: Silver Grooved Shield
items.desc: A silver shield whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight. The elegant grooves render a picturesque scene, recalling the faraway Erdtree's principles. Spread out above shall its many boughs, spread below shall its many roots, till the world entire knows its blessing.
items.obtain: Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant (North Liurnia) behind Bellum Church in Liurnia.

items.name: Silver Mirrorshield
items.desc: Shield of radiant silver, festooned with amber and carried by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The shape is said to imitate that of a sacred drop of dew, which inspired the absurd rumor that Loretta herself was an Albinauric.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.
This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

items.name: Sun Realm Shield
items.desc: Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days. Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.
items.fx:
Skill: Parry
Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance.

This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.
items.obtain: Summonwater Village.

items.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
items.desc: Shield featuring a vividly painted twinbird. The twinbird is said to be the envoy of an outer god, and mother of the Deathbirds.
items.fx: When HP is below 20%, raises attack damage by 5% and damage negation by 10%.

items.name: Wolf Crest Shield
items.desc: A finely-made "blueshield" featuring an engraving of a wolf under the moon. Excels at fending off sorceries. The wolf is the beast of the Carian royal covenant; a symbol of the moon's pride that none can forget, no matter what remote lands they may arrive in.
items.obtain: In Castle Ensis, the northeast corner of the courtyard with Moonrithyll, there is a gap in the wall that leads to a room with the Wolf Crest Shield.

items.name: Ant's Skull Plate
items.desc: Huge head of one of the giant ants which inhabit the two underground rivers, used without modification as a shield. Excels at repelling enemy attacks. Giant ants are venomous creatures, granting a boost to immunity when wielding this shield.
items.fx:
Raises Immunity by 60.

Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Black Steel Greatshield
items.desc: Weighty shields carried by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Made of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold. Symbolic of their iron conviction in their crusade, the Black Knights will never yield. Nor will they ever doubt their purpose.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.
items.obtain: Dropped by Black Knight Garrew in Fog Rift Fort.

items.name: Briar Greatshield
items.desc: Greatshield from a foreign land, used by Elemer of the Briar. Attacks with this armament utilize the iron thorns that have been wound around its frame. Originates from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Crossed-Tree Towershield
items.desc: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Emblazoned with an old, interleaving tree. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Crucible Hornshield
items.desc: Greatshield of red-tinged gold carried by Crucible Knights. Features a great horn An ancient holiness dwells within. The crucible horn skewers foes when performing shield bashes.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Cuckoo Greatshield
items.desc: Metal greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy. Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. "Our enemy is none other than Caria itself."

items.name: Distinguished Greatshield
items.desc: Greatshield featuring sumptuous ornamentation used by the scions of great families. Due to their excessive size, these shields were at times seen as the hallmark of little lordlings who were too timid to earn a few nicks and scratches.

items.name: Dragon Towershield
items.desc: Tower shield engraved with a dragon, symbol of protection. Heavy even amount greatshields, it possess exceptional guarding ability. The ancient dragons, who ruled in the prehistoric era before the Erdtree, would protect their lord as a wall of living rock.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Dragonclaw Shield
items.desc: Greatshield said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree. Imbued with lightning.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.
items.obtain: Progress forward from the Capital Rampart site of grace until you enter a chapel, the shield is sitting on a corpse on the altar.

items.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
items.desc: Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights. The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. it aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay.
items.fx: Raises Immunity, Robustness, and Focus by 50.

items.name: Erdtree Greatshield
items.desc: Weighty greatshield forged of gold carried by the order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights. Blessed by an old incantation of protection. The living rampart of the Erdtree, the Tree Sentinels are the standard to which all defenders of the Erdtree aspire.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Golden Retaliation
Ready the shield to unleash its protective incantation.

This will dispel sorceries and incantations, retaliating with golden power.

items.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
items.desc: A great stone shield with an intricately carved fingerprint design. One of the heaviest of all greatshields. Part of the tomb of an ancient god, the Readerless Fingers relayed their message through these imprints, said to be the very seeds from which frenzy first sprouted.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Gilded Greatshield
items.desc: Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick. The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

items.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
items.desc: Shield of dull gold with a beast engraved as its crest. Lighter than most greatshields, and subsequently easier to wield. The beast depicted is Serosh, aged counselor who guides the golden lineage.

items.name: Golden Greatshield
items.desc: Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell. Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

items.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
items.desc: Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation. Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

items.name: Icon Shield
items.desc: Greatshield painted with a divine scene; the recipience of a blessed tear from the Erdtree. An item that looks back foundly on the age of plenty. The divine scene acts in and of itself as a sacred invocation; gradually restoring the carrier's HP.
items.fx: Grants 3 HP recovery per second.

items.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
items.desc: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Jellyfish Shield
items.desc: The head of a spirit jellyfish, commonly found floating above sacred ground throughout the Lands Between, wielded without modification as a shield. The see-through head is extremely light, but its flesh is supply, providing absolutely no protection from piercing attacks.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Contagious Fury
Incite the jellyfish's wrath and allow its fury to flow through you. Raises attack power for a certain duration.

items.name: Lordsworn Shield
items.desc: Wooden tower shield. Lightweight for a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.

Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Manor Towershield
items.desc: An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Depicts the Roundtable Hold, gathering place of champions. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: One-Eyed Shield
items.desc: Tricksome shield made from white stone depicting a malformed one-eyed god. The barrel of a firearm pokes through the open mouth. Once worshipped by the giants, this evil deity is believed to have been slain by Queen Marika.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Flame Spit
Ready the shield, then launch a fireball from the barrel.

The fireball explodes on impact.

items.name: Redmane Greatshield
items.desc: Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion. Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.
items.obtain: From the Redmane Gatehouse site of grace, head south across the courtyard into the nearby building. Proceed up the stairs, out the door, through the corridor, up the stairs into the next building where the shield will be on a corpse immediately to your right as you enter.

items.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
items.desc: A large wooden shield covered with spikes. Though relatively light, it lacks in damage negation. Designed to perform shield bashes, these attacks riddle the enemy with holes, earning it the nickname of "pard shield."
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Bash
Brace Behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance.
Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

items.name: Verdigris Greatshield
items.desc: Greatshield made of the unusual metal known as verdigris. Boasts greater guard capacity than damage negation. To the extend that the shield will continue to protect its target even if its bearer should die.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Moore's Charge
Ready the shield with both hands, then charge forth while maintaining guard, ending in a shove imbued with verdigris magic. Knocks back nearby enemies, but does not cause significant harm. Hold to extend the length of the charge.
items.obtain: Dropped by Moore when invaded, or by killing him.

items.name: Visage Shield
items.desc: Tricksome bronze shield depicting the face of a Fire Giant. Several tongues leap from its open mount. The dreadful visage and burning flames are designed to remind one of the horror of facing a Fire Giant. In other words, this shield has an instructional function.
items.fx:
Unique Skill: Tongues of Fire
Ready the shield, then spray violent jets of fire from the gonues protruding from its maw.

Hold to continue spraying fire. This skill can be used while walking.

items.name: Wooden Greatshield
items.desc: Wooden greatshield reinforced with a metal ornamentation. Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

items.name: Carian Thrusting Shield
items.desc: Silver thrusting shield embedded with glintstones. Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously. Once wielded by Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, during her sole entry into ritual combat—a demonstration of fidelity to the Erdtree.
items.fx:
Skill: Shield Strike

A conjured shield capable of channeling incantations.

Cast Incantation: Cast your selected spell through this weapon. Raise the shield to conjure an energy barrier. This barrier is capable of blocking attacks and will absorb any incoming spells. While guarding, your FP is slowly consumed but when you block an attack or absorb a spell, some FP will be restored.

Guarded Negation
Physical | Magic | Fire | Lightning | Holy | Guard Boost
90.0 | 55.0 | 55.0 | 55.0 | 65.0 | 55

When deathblight occurs nearby, blighted branches will sprout from the tip and the weaponw ill become capable of casting sorceries. Otherwise the un-activated skill is Spinning Slash.

Unique Skill: Cast Sorcery
Cast your selected spell through this weapon. Has the same scaling as the Prince of Death's Staff

items.name: Knight Set
items.desc: The Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Retainer class. Made of thin iron plate, this metal armor is heavy but provides considerable damage negation alongside stat boosts to Strength, Dexterity, and Endurance.

pieces.desc:
Iron helm worn by foreign knights.

Iron helm of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

pieces.desc:
Iron armor worn by foreign knights.

Iron armor of an unknown knight. It is made of thin iron plate. Such metal armor is heavy, but provides considerable damage negation.

items.name: Godrick Knight Set
items.desc: The Godrick Knight Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Retainer class. Worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted, this set provides balanced physical defenses and boosts to Strength, Dexterity, and Endurance, along with powerful active effects when wielding purely physical weapons.

pieces.name: Godrick Knight Helm
pieces.effect:
Helm used by Stormveil Elite Knights.

Helm worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 2.

Active (Bloodline’s Reckoning): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your wonderous physick, you gain an effect that lasts for 2 minutes that causes a secondary effect each time you block an attack. This secondary effect increases all damage you deal by 3% and can stack with itself up to a total of 30% damage increase. When the duration of the primary effect expires, all stacks will also end.
pieces.obtain: Miquella’s Haligtree – From the “Haligtree Town Plaza” site of grace head southwest across the rooftops and enter the building with Godrick Soldiers standing guard. The helm will be in a barricaded room found in a chest protected by a Godrick Knight.

pieces.name: Godrick Knight Armor / Alt
pieces.effect:
Armor used by Stormveil Elite Knights.

Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Its left breast is emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an emblem of the golden lineage.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 4.

Active (Enduring Legacy): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a crimson flask, you gain an effect that causes 20 stamina recovery and immunity to stagger for 30 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Altus, Golden Lineage Evergaol – Obtained from defeating Banished Knight Oleg.

pieces.name: Godrick Knight Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Gauntlets used by Stormveil Elite Knights.

Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 2.

Active (Knightly Redoubt): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that improves your guard stability and causes you to be healed when you block any attack. This effect lasts for 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Limgrave, Stormfoot Catacombs – Obtained from defeating Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

pieces.name: Godrick Knight Greaves
pieces.effect:
Greaves used by Stormveil Elite Knights.

Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time has yet to dull their luster.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 2.

Active (Golden Bulwark): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a blue flask, you gain an effect that increases your total HP and Stamina by 10% and increases the damage of guard-counter attacks and thrusting attacks while blocking by 15%. This effect lasts for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Stormveil Castle – Obtained from a chest indoors.

items.name: Veteran's Set
items.desc: The Veteran's Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Retainer class. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol, this old armor has seen many battles. It provides substantial defensive bulk and boosts to Strength, Dexterity, Endurance, and Vigor.

pieces.name: Veteran's Helm
pieces.effect:
Veteran General’s old helm.

An old helm that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 1 and also increases END and VIG by 2.

Active (For Glory): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your wonderous physick, you and all allies gain an effect that increases all stats by 5 for 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants, Castle Sol – Obtained after defeating Commander Niall.

pieces.name: Veteran's Armor / Alt
pieces.effect:
Veteran General’s old armor.

Old armor that has seen many battles. Worn by Niall, the veteran general of Sol. Niall was a lone survivor who commanded spirits to defend his long-passed master.

Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 2 and also increases END and VIG by 4.

pieces.name: Veteran's Greaves
pieces.effect:
Veteran General’s old greaves.

Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 1 and also increases END and VIG by 2.

This effect lasts for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Caelid – Obtained after defeating Commander O’neil in the Heart of Aeonia.

items.name: Oathseeker Knight Set
items.desc: The Oathseeker Knight Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Retainer class. Black with gold ornamentation, these knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect devotion.

pieces.name: Oathseeker Knight Helm
pieces.effect:
An Oathseeker Knight helm, black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 1 and increases all weapon damage by 1%.

Active (Unbreakable Will): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your wondrous physick, you gain an effect that causes each successful attack you perform on an enemy to reduce the damage of the next attack you receive by 50% for the next 7 seconds. Additionally, whenever you are struck by an attack, you become less likely to be staggered for the next 7 seconds. This effect lasts for 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Mausoleum Dynasty Midpoint, Mohgwyn Palace – Obtained from the chest behind the Sanguine Noble in front of the Albinaurics before the elevator that leads to Mohg.

Passive: Reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon damage by 4%.

Active (Purge the Unworthy): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that increases your absorption to all damage by 15% and increases the damage of your weapon skills, rolling, running, jumping and backstep attacks by 10%. Lasts for 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Gravesite Plains – Found on a corpse sitting near the edge of a cliff by the Church of Benediction.

pieces.name: Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Oathseeker Knight gauntlets, black with gold ornamentation.

These knights set off on quests of discovery, hoping to find by themselves an oath of their own choosing to serve in perfect, lifelong devotion.

pieces.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes, Stillwater Cave – Obtained from defeating the Cleanrot Knight within the cave.

items.desc: The Page Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Marksman class. Worn by pages who serve the nobility, this traveling wear is tailored with exquisite precision to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

pieces.effect:
Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 2, increases bow range by 7%, and increases the speed of great bows and ballistas by 7%.

Active (Sniper’s Lethality): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your wonderous physick, you gain an effect that greatly increases your bow range, makes you much less likely to stagger, and decreases the stamina cost of your attacks and the FP cost of weapon skills by 50% for 1 minute. Additionally, the next time you hit an enemy with an arrow or bolt, that enemy’s posture will be broken.

pieces.name: Page Trousers

pieces.name: Bull-Goat Helm
pieces.effect:
Great Horned Tragoth’s helm, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provides high poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One’s aid.

Passive: Increases STR, END and VIG by 2.

Active (Juggernaut): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your flask of wonderous physick, you gain 30 HP recovery per second and become immune to stagger for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Farum Azula – From the “Dragon Temple Lift” site of grace head outside and southeast to find the helm on a corpse in a building guarded by beastmen.

pieces.name: Bull-Goat Armor
pieces.effect:
Great Horned Tragoth’s armor. Covers its wearer with a pair of giant horns, providing staunch poise.

Tragoth is a famed knight of assistance. Countless Tarnished, facing adversity in the Lands Between, have survived thanks only to the Great Horned One’s aid.

Passive: Increases STR, END and VIG by 4.

Active (Warrior’s Heart): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a red flask, you gain an effect that increases your total HP by 15% and endurance and strength by 10. Lasts for 20 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Liurnia, Ruin-Strewn Precipice – Obtained by defeating Tragoth in assassination mission.

pieces.name: Bull-Goat Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Great Horned Tragoth’s gauntlets, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provide high poise.

Passive: Increases STR, END and VIG by 2.

Active (Undaunted Combatant): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes your absorption to all damage to increase by 2% every time you take damage. This effect can stack up to a total of 20% absorption. This effect lasts for 2 minutes. When the duration of the primary effect ends, all stacks will also end.
pieces.obtain: Murkwater Cave, Scenic Isle, or Volcano Manor – Sold by Patches.

pieces.name: Bull-Goat Greaves
pieces.effect:
Great Horned Tragoth’s greaves, adorned with a gold bull-goat motif. Provide high poise.

Passive: Increases STR, END and VIG by 2.

Active (Ram Through): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a blue flask, you gain an effect that increases all poise damage you deal by 20% and causes you to sprint when you move your character with no stamina cost for 15 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Dragonbarrow, Fort Faroth – Found on a corpse hanging on the rafters.

items.name: Lionel's Set
items.desc: The Lionel’s Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Dreadnought class. Oddly shaped, rounded iron armor used by foreign knights. When the chivalrous, dauntless knight Lionel the Lionhearted met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.

pieces.name: Lionel’s Helm
pieces.effect:
Round iron helm with a distinctive large brim.

Passive: Increases STR by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon damage by 1%.

Active (Fia’s Champion): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your flask of wonderous physick, you gain an effect that will force enemies to attack you. Also, whenever you take damage, you and your allies gain a buff that increases all damage you deal by 1%, this buff stacks with itself. The primary effect lasts for 2 minutes. The secondary stackable buffs last for 30 seconds each. When the duration of the primary effect expires, all stacks will also end. You also gain a death ward effect that will prevent your death one time.
pieces.obtain: Deeproot Depths – In a chest inside the Blighted Nox Ancestor arena South from Across the Roots.

pieces.name: Lionel’s Armor / Alt
pieces.effect:
Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back.

Passive: Increases STR by 2 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 8% and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Command the Legion): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a red flask, you and your allies gain a buff that causes a 5% increase to damage you deal and you and each ally gain an aura that causes constant deathblight build-up on all nearby enemies. Lasts for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Caelid, War-Dead Catacombs – Obtained after defeating the Putrid Tree Spirit boss.

pieces.name: Lionel’s Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Rounded iron gauntlets. Worn by Lionel the Lionhearted.

Passive: Increases STR by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon damage by 1%.

Active (Friend of Death): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain a buff that removes any negative effects from summoning and causes 5 additional stamina recovery, lasts for 5 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Limgrave, Summonwater Village – Obtained by defeating the Tibia Mariner field boss.

pieces.name: Lionel’s Greaves
pieces.effect:
Rounded iron greaves.

Passive: Increases STR by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon damage by 1%.

Active (Protector of the Fallen): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a blue flask, you and all allies gain a buff that causes 15 HP recovery per second and reduces all incoming damage by 10%, lasts for 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Leyndell – Found on corpse on bed in Lower Capital Church.

items.name: Verdigris Set
items.desc: The Verdigris Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Dreadnought class. Made from an unusual metal known as verdigris, which is said to be the gift of an outer god. Possessed of an enormously hefty yet supple strength thanks to its rusted nature.

pieces.name: Verdigris Helm
pieces.effect:
Helm made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Passive: Increases STR by 2 and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Decay and Rebirth): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your Wonderous Physick, you gain an effect that lasts for 2 minutes that causes your damage to be increased by 2% each time you are healed. This effect stacks up to a total of 20%. When the primary effect ends, all stacks will also end.
pieces.obtain:
Scadu Altus, Church of the Crusade – After Miquella’s Great Rune is shattered, find Moore at Main Gate Cross. When prompted, say “Remain sad forever”. Reload the area and obtain the helm from Moore’s corpse North of Church of the Crusade.

Enir-Ilim, Cleansing Chamber Anteroom – Alternatively, if you tell Moore “Put it behind you”, you can obtain the helm from his corpse after fighting Leda and her allies.

pieces.name: Verdigris Armor
pieces.effect:
Chest armor made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Passive: Increases STR by 4 and increases weapon damage by 4%.

Active (Pest’s Constitution): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that instantly cures and grants immunity to all status effects and grants 15 HP recovery per second for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Mt. Gelmir, Seethewater Cave – Obtained from defeating the Kindred of Rot within the cave.

pieces.name: Verdigris Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Gauntlets made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Passive: Increases STR by 2 and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Rotten Restoration): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes all successful attacks on enemies to restore 10% of total HP for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Weeping Peninsula, Tombsward Cave – Obtained from defeating Miranda the Blighted Bloom.

pieces.name: Verdigris Greaves
pieces.effect:
Greaves made from an unusual metal known as verdigris.

Passive: Increases STR by 2 and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Sealed God’s Kinship): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that increases your STR, VIG and END by 10 for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Caelum Waypoint Ruins – Obtained in an underground chest.

items.name: Sellsword Set
items.desc: The Sellsword Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Sellsword class. These are the attire of a wandering mercenary, crafted for practicality above all else.

pieces.name: Sellsword Helm
pieces.effect:
Attire of a wandering mercenary, made for practicality above fashion.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.
pieces.obtain: Limgrave, Mistwood – Found on a corpse next to the runebear marking a tree near the map fragment stele.

pieces.name: Sellsword Armor
pieces.effect:
Attire of a wandering mercenary, made for practicality above fashion.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4%.

pieces.name: Sellsword Gloves
pieces.effect:
Attire of a wandering mercenary, made for practicality above fashion.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Sellsword Boots
pieces.effect:
Attire of a wandering mercenary, made for practicality above fashion.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

items.name: Kaiden Set
items.desc: The Kaiden Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Sellsword class. Worn by fearless mercenaries from the wintry north, this armor is made with the pelt of a snow-wolf, which protects against the cold.

pieces.name: Kaiden Helm
pieces.effect:
Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords.

Passive: Reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Sublime Technique): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your flask of wonderous physick, you gain an effect that increases your endurance and dexterity by 15 and the damage of your weapon skills and your poise damage is increased by 10%. Lasts for 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree – From the “Drainage Channel” site of grace, drop down to the ground level and head north. The helm is located in a chest within a small room guarded by two Kaiden Sellswords on a cliff below the gate by the chapel.

pieces.name: Kaiden Armor
pieces.effect:
Armor worn by Kaiden sellswords. Made with the pelt of a snow-wolf, which protects against the cold.

Passive: Reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon damage by 4%.

Active (Hindering Barrage): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a red flask, you gain an effect for 1 minute that causes enemies struck by your attacks to deal 3% decreased damage for 20 seconds. This secondary effect stacks with itself.
pieces.obtain: Consecrated Snowfield – Head directly north-east from the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace. The armor is in a chest at the back of a carriage.

pieces.name: Kaiden Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Gauntlets worn by Kaiden sellswords.

Passive: Reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Tactical Efficiency): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes 3% of your FP and stamina to recover every time you hit an enemy with a weapon. Lasts for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Limgrave – Head directly west of the Waypoint Ruins; the armor is in a chest in the carriage.

pieces.name: Kaiden Greaves
pieces.effect:
Trousers worn by Kaiden sellswords.

Passive: Reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Duelist’s Crescendo): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a blue flask, you gain an effect that increases your total damage by 2% every time you hit an enemy with a weapon. Stacks up to 30%. Lasts for 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Shaded Castle – From the Shaded Castle Inner Gate site of grace, head left, up the ladder, through the room to your right, turn left, and cross the bridge. The armor is near some bookshelves in the next room.

items.name: Dancer's Set
items.desc: The Dancer’s Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Sellsword class. These are the bright red garments of the Ranah dancers; a dance of burning passion where the most dedicated dancers never allow their fire to end, losing even their names as they dance on.

pieces.name: Dancer’s Hood
pieces.effect:
Bright-red hood of the Ranah dancers.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1.

Active (Endless Dance): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that makes you much less likely to stagger and eliminates all stamina consumption for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Cerulean Coast – Defeat the Dancer of Ranah inside the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

pieces.name: Dancer’s Dress / Alt
pieces.effect:
Bright-red dress of the Ranah dancers.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 4 and increases stamina recovery by 2.

Active (Bloodbath): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that causes you to be healed whenever you hit an enemy for as long as Dancer’s Grace is active. Healing amount increases with Dancer's Grace tiers (5%, 10%, 15% per hit). Lasts for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Consecrated Snowfield, Sanctum of Eiglay – Obtained in a room to the right of the fog wall prior to the boss within the dungeon.

pieces.name: Dancer’s Bracer
pieces.effect:
Metal bracer of the Ranah dancers.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1.

Active (Dancer’s Grace): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes successive attacks to grant increased absorption (10%, 20%, 30%). Each tier lasts for 4 seconds after your last attack. Lasts for 90 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Caelid, Caelum Ruins – Obtained from one of two chests directly after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head underground.

pieces.name: Dancer’s Trousers
pieces.effect:
Long, black trousers worn underneath the deep crimson dress.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1.

Active (Whirling Blades): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that increases your DEX by 10 and causes all weapon attacks you perform to cause additional bleed build-up on enemies for 90 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Volcano Manor – Located inside a chest within the hallway Volcanist Dist patrols, directly before the Manor Passage Site of Grace.

items.name: Ascetic's Set
items.desc: The Ascetic’s Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Sellsword class. These are the attire of the tower’s ascetics, embodying their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control to ascend from mortal flesh into tutelary deities.

pieces.name: Curseblade’s Helm
pieces.effect:
A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 1 and increases weapon damage by 1.

Active (Curseblade’s Deflection): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your Flask of Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that allows you to utilise spontaneous guard and increases the damage of guard counters after successful spontaneous guards. Lasts for 5 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Bonny Gaol – From the site of grace, reach the first portcullis, jump down the two jars, and enter the room on the right. The mask is on a corpse at the back of the room.

pieces.name: Ascetic’s Loincloth
pieces.effect:
Attire of the tower’s ascetics.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and also increases weapon damage by 2%.

Active (Curseblood Siphon): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that increases all damage you deal by 15% at the cost of gradual HP loss for 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Capital Outskirts – Obtained after defeating the Fell Twins.

pieces.name: Ascetic’s Wrist Guards
pieces.effect:
Wrist guards of the tower’s ascetics.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 1 and increases weapon damage by 1%.

Active (Curseblood Quickening): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that causes all actions you perform to be accelerated by 10% above their normal speed for 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Weeping Peninsula – Found on a corpse atop a tower of the Weeping Harborage on the northwest coastline.

pieces.name: Ascetic’s Ankle Guards
pieces.effect:
Ankle guards of the tower’s ascetics.

Passive: Increases DEX and END by 1 and increases weapon damage by 1%.

Active (Denounce The Erdtree): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that grants you an additional 40 stamina recovery and causes magical projectiles to be deflected away from you for 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Altus Plateau – Obtained after defeating Omenkiller and Miranda, the Blighted Bloom in Perfumer’s Grotto.

items.name: Bandit Set
items.desc: The Bandit Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Rogue class. Favored by bandits for hiding their faces and light for ease of movement, these garments provide minimal damage negation in exchange for stealth and agility.

pieces.name: Bandit Mask
pieces.effect:
Mask of black cloth that covers the mouth.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1 and critical damage by 2%.
pieces.obtain:
Limgrave – Sold by the Nomadic Merchant between Saintsbridge and Summonwater Village for 1,500 runes.

Stormveil Castle – The Manchettes, Boots, and Garb are sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,000 runes each.

pieces.name: Bandit Garb
pieces.effect:
Leather garb worn by bandits.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2 and critical damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Bandit Manchettes
pieces.effect:
Manchettes made by simply wrapping dirty cloth around the arms.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1 and critical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Bandit Boots
pieces.effect:
Leather boots worn by bandits.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1 and critical damage by 2%.

items.name: Leather Set
items.desc: The Leather Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Rogue class. Lightweight and battle-proven gear worn by a savvy soldier, designed for stealth and precision.

pieces.name: Black Hood
pieces.effect:
Hood of lusterless black fabric that conceals its wearer’s identity.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2, critical damage by 2%, and increases stamina recovery speed by 1.

Active (Deadly Acrobat): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your flask of wonderous physick, you gain an effect that will cause all of your dodges and jumps to increase your dexterity and endurance by 1 and your Max HP and FP by 1% each time you dodge or jump. Lasts for 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Moonlight Altar – Located in Chelona’s Rise. Accessed by finding and killing three spirit turtles.

pieces.name: Leather Armor
pieces.effect:
Dirty leather armor worn by bandits.

Passive: Increases DEX by 4, critical damage by 4%, and increases stamina recovery speed by 2.

Active (Run Through): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a red flask, you gain a buff that increases the damage of critical attacks by 10% and causes 100% of your stamina and FP to recover upon a successful critical attack. Lasts for 30 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Gaol Cave, Caelid/Limgrave – Found on the edge of a cliff accessible only after defeating the Frenzied Troll boss.

pieces.name: Leather Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Dirty gloves worn by bandits.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2, critical damage by 2%, and increases stamina recovery speed by 1.

Active (Caustic Coating): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, your weapon gains a buff that applies a draining effect (small amount of enemy HP per second for 3 seconds). Does not stack.
pieces.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes – Found on a small wooden platform at Slumbering Wolf’s Shack, accessible after defeating Battlemage Duncan in Lakeside Crystal Cave.

pieces.name: Leather Boots
pieces.effect:
Dirty boots worn by bandits.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2, critical damage by 2%, and increases stamina recovery speed by 1.

Active (Thief’s Wit): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a blue flask, you gain an effect that increases your endurance by 10, increases dodge effectiveness, and increases rune gain by 15% for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Volcano Manor – Found on a lower portion of the cliff, accessible by jumping over the railing after the Godskin Noble elevator.

items.name: Raptor's Set
items.desc: The Raptor’s Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Rogue class. These robes, crafted with the black feathers of a bird of prey, are worn by followers of the deadly birds who seek to strike with lethal precision.

pieces.name: Skeletal Mask
pieces.effect:
Skeletal mask that tightly grips the face.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2 and critical damage by 4%.

Active (Vanish into Shadows): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your flask of wondrous physick, you become surrounded by a dark cloud of smoke. Enemies hit by the cloud are instantly staggered and disengage from combat for 7 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Mountaintops, Giant’s Mountaintop Catacombs – Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit boss.

pieces.name: Raptor’s Black Feathers
pieces.effect:
Cloak worn by followers of the deadly birds.

Passive: Increases DEX by 4 and critical damage by 8%.

Active (Withering Recovery): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a red flask, you gain 10% total HP. Upon performing a critical attack, gain a shield preventing 90% of damage from the next hit. Stacks from Assassin’s Preparation are preserved if the shield is active. Lasts 45 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Caelid – Dropped by the Death Rite Bird that spawns south-east of the Southern Aeonian Swamp Bank site of grace at night.

pieces.name: Raptor’s Gloves
pieces.effect:
Wraps worn by followers of the deadly birds.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2 and critical damage by 4%.

Active (Wicked Edge): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or consumable, gain 5% increased critical damage for 1 minute. Critical attacks grant a secondary buff increasing all damage dealt by 10% for 30 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Stormveil Castle – Found at the top of the hawk roosting tower near the Rampart Tower site of grace.

pieces.name: Raptor’s Boots
pieces.effect:
Trousers worn by followers of the deadly birds.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2 and critical damage by 4%.

Active (Assassin’s Preparation): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a blue flask, you gain a buff that increases damage dealt by 3% every 5 seconds, stacking up to 12%. Taking damage or ending the duration removes stacks. Primary effect lasts 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Altus Plateau, Sage’s Cave – Through the second waterfall, jump left and break the illusory wall. Located in the rightmost chest.

items.name: Braided Cord Set
items.desc: The Braided Cord Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Rogue class. These are the attire of a vengeance-seeking Hornsent; the braided cords tie the vow of the revenger to the victims’ grudges, and must never come undone.

pieces.name: Caterpillar Mask
pieces.effect:
Grotesque mask constructed from countless solidified caterpillars.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1, increases weapon damage by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

Active (Fuelled By Vengeance): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink your Wondrous Physick, you gain an effect that causes your dodges and jumps to increase all damage and poise damage dealt by 5% (stacks to 15%). Primary effect lasts 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Realm of Shadow – Dropped by the Hornsent after killing him either in the Shadow Keep or Enir-Ilim.

pieces.name: Braided Cord Robe
pieces.effect:
Ragged black cloth overlaid with braided cord.

Passive: Increases DEX by 2, increases weapon damage by 2% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4%.

Active (Vicious Tumbler): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Crimson Flask, you gain an effect that causes dodge rolls to inflict poise damage to nearby enemies for 40 seconds.
pieces.obtain: Leyndell, Queen’s Bedchamber – Found on a corpse to the side of the entrance.

pieces.name: Braided Arm Wraps
pieces.effect:
Ragged black cloth tied with braided cord.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1, increases weapon damage by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

Active (Hornsent’s Agility): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, you gain an effect that increases the effectiveness of dodges/backsteps and lowers stamina cost of attacks by 25% for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Jarburg – Found in a chest on the north side of the village, near the small jar in a shack.

pieces.name: Soiled Loincloth
pieces.effect:
Lightly soiled loincloth of ragged cloth.

Passive: Increases DEX by 1, increases weapon damage by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

Active (Oathbound Onslaught): If you do not have a weapon equipped with INT/FTH scaling, when you drink a Cerulean Flask, you gain an effect that increases the damage of rolling, jumping, backstep, running, and critical attacks for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Auriza Side Tomb – Obtained after defeating the Grave Warden Duelist.

items.name: Glint Sorcerer Set
items.desc: The Glint Sorcerer is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. worn by Raya Lucaria's magic scholars. Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep navy garb after making their vows of virtue and austerity.

pieces.name: Juvenile Scholar Cap
pieces.desc: Cap worn by students of the Raya Lucaria Academy
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2%.

pieces.name: Raya Lucarian Robe
pieces.desc: Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4%.

pieces.name: Raya Lucarian Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2%.

pieces.name: Raya Lucarian Trousers
pieces.desc: Trousers worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4% and increases damage of Glint Sorcery by 2%.

items.obtain: Found within a chest in a rise, right next to the Academy Gate Town site of grace.

items.name: Spellblade Set
items.desc: The Spellblade Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. Rogier spent his entire life behaving with utter detachment. No one noticed the anger, grief, regret, or fear that existed along with it.

pieces.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
pieces.desc: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's pointed hat, a sign of a heretical practitioner.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, END by 1 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Traveling Attire
pieces.desc: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's traveling attire, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, END by 2 and increases all magic damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Gloves
pieces.desc: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's gloves, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, END by 1 and increases all magic damage by 1%

pieces.name: Trousers
pieces.desc: Glintstone sorcerer Rogier's trousers, graced with an intricate, aristocratic decoration.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, END by 1 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

items.obtain: On Sorcerer Rogier after he has died.

items.name: Preceptor's Set
items.desc: The Preceptor's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals. Glintstone sorcerers are the descendants of astrologers, a fact that the Carians remain aware of. Even if their fate has been long severed from the stars.

pieces.name: Preceptor's Big Hat
pieces.desc: Large hat with the movements of the stars drawn on the inside of the brim. Worn by the magic preceptors who served the Carian royals.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4% and increases damage of Glint Sorcery by 2%.

pieces.name: Preceptor's Long Gown
pieces.desc: A long, bright blue gown with the movements of the stars drawn upon it.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 8% and increases damage of Glint Sorcery by 4%.

pieces.name: Preceptor's Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4% and increases damage of Glint Sorcery by 2%.

pieces.name: Preceptor's Trousers
pieces.desc: Trousers of the magic preceptors who serve the Carian royals. Black and perfectly discreet.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4% and increases damage of Glint Sorcery by 2%.

items.obtain: Found guarded by three ghost at the top of the non-inverted Carian Study Hall.

items.name: Carian Knight Set
items.desc: The Carian Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. The enchanted knights, anointed by the Lunar Queen, were all heroes of the highest honors, but fell into disarray with the decline of the royal family.

pieces.name: Carian Knight Helm
pieces.desc: Helm of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Carian Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Armor of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases magic weapon damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Carian Knight Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Carian Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of the enchanted knights that once served the Carian royal family.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

items.name: Queen of the Full Moon Set
items.desc: The Queen of the Full Moon Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. Worn by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. When Rennala, head of both the Academy of Raya Lucaria and the Carian royal family, lost her husband Radagon, her heart went along with him. And then, those at the academy realized. That Rennala was no champion, after all.

pieces.name: Queen's Crescent Crown
pieces.desc: A tall crown depicting the moon.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, Mind and END by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4%.

pieces.name: Queen's Robe
pieces.desc: Robe indicating the highest order of sorcerer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, Mind and END by 2 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 8%.

pieces.name: Queen's Bracelets
pieces.desc: Bracelets indicating the highest order of sorcerer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, Mind and END by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4%.

pieces.name: Queen's Leggings
pieces.desc: Leggings indicating the highest order of sorcerer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, Mind and END by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4%.

items.name: Royal Knight Set
items.desc: The Royal Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. Loretta, once a royal Carian knight, went on a journey in search of a haven for Albinaurics, and determined that the Haligtree was their best chance for eventual salvation.

pieces.name: Royal Knight Helm
pieces.desc: Silver helm of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, increases casting speed by 6 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Royal Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Silver armor of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree. Loretta was once a royal Carian knight, and her lapis-lazuli blue cape is the emblem of the knightly pride that continues to guide her.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, increases casting speed by 12 and increases all magic damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Royal Knight Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Silver gauntlets of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, increases casting speed by 6 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Royal Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Silver greaves of Loretta, a knight who served Miquella's Haligtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, increases casting speed by 6 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

items.name: Rellana's Set
items.desc: The Rellana's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Rennala, head of the royal family of Caria, was said to have given her younger sister, who renounced her lineage to chase after Messmer, a gift of lustrous black hair.

pieces.name: Rellana's Helm
pieces.desc: Ornate helm of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX, INT and Mind by 1 and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

pieces.name: Rellana's Armor
pieces.desc: Ornate armor of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel. Adorned with the lapis-lazuli blue that is symbolic of Caria, its radiance is yet to fully fade.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX, INT and Mind by 2 and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4%.

pieces.name: Rellana's Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from quality leather.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX, INT and Mind by 1 and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

pieces.name: Rellana's Greaves
pieces.desc: Ornate greaves of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight, fashioned from silver steel.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX, INT and Mind by 1 and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

items.obtain: Sold by Enia after defeating Rellana.

items.name: Carian Golem Set
items.desc: The Carian Golem Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Glint Sorcerer class. Crafted from the outermost shell of a guardian golem that was embedded with glintstone and once used at the height of Carian society.

pieces.name: Golem Helm
pieces.desc: A repurposed head of a now destroyed glintstone infused Golem.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 1 and increases the magic damage of weapon skills and two-handed attacks by 3%.

pieces.name: Carian Golem Armor
pieces.desc: A repurposed torso of a now destroyed glintstone infused Golem.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 2 and increases the magic damage of weapon skills and two-handed attacks by 6%.

pieces.name: Carian Golem Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Repurposed hands of a now destroyed glintstone infused Golem.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 1 and increases the magic damage of weapon skills and two-handed attacks by 3%.

pieces.name: Carian Golem Greaves
pieces.desc: Repurposed feet of a now destroyed glintstone infused Golem.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 1 and increases the magic damage of weapon skills and two-handed attacks by 3%.

items.name: Starcaller Set
items.desc: The Starcaller Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Starcaller class. A once desperate rabble that scavenged meteorite craters, these sorcerers have refined the art of gravity magic. After years spent studying gravity laden fragments, Starcallers have reinvented this mysterious discipline. Many of their achievements could now be the envy of the Onyx and Alabaster lords.

pieces.name: Starcaller Hood
pieces.desc: Hood of a self-proclaimed Starcaller.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and INT by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

pieces.name: Starcaller Garb
pieces.desc: Vestments of a self-proclaimed Starcaller.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and INT by 2 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2%.

pieces.name: Starcaller Wraps
pieces.desc: Gloves of a self-proclaimed Starcaller.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and INT by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

pieces.name: Starcaller Boots
pieces.desc: Boots of a self-proclaimed Starcaller.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and INT by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

items.name: General Radahn's Set
items.desc: The General Radahn's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Starcaller class. Armor of Radahn, God of War. The golden lion is said to symbolize Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and his beast regent, Serosh. From his youngest years, Radahn was naturally captivated by the Lord of the Battlefield.

pieces.name: Radahn's Redmane Helm
pieces.desc: Helm of the golden lion, with flowing red hair. Worn by General Radahn. Radahn inherited the furious, flaming red hair of his father Radagon, and is fond of its heroic implications.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1% and weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Radahn's Lion Armor
pieces.desc: Armor depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 2 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Radahn's Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1% and weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Radahn's Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves depicting the golden lion. Worn by General Radahn.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT, Mind and END by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1% and weapon stamina cost by 1%.

items.obtain: Sold by Enia after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

items.name: Redmane Knight Set
items.desc: The Redmane Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Starcaller class. Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. When they were driven to defeat by Malenia's scarlet rot, the Redmane Knights burned the crest on the left breast of their armor to indicate their resolve.

pieces.name: Redmane Knight Helm
pieces.desc: Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. The red plume is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son—the mane of the proud Red Lion.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Redmane Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, END by 2 and increases all physical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Redmane Knight Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Black iron gauntlets worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Redmane Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

items.obtain: On a hidden wooden path on the outer rim of Fort Gael.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Set
items.desc: The Radahn Soldier Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Starcaller class. Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. The surcoat depicts a red-maned lion raising a sword in the image of Radahn. Thus, they were Redmanes, and all proved they were worthy of the name.

pieces.name: Radahn Soldier Helm
pieces.desc: Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT and END by 1.

pieces.name: Redmane Surcoat
pieces.desc: Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT and END by 2.

pieces.name: Radahn Soldier Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT and END by 1.

pieces.name: Radahn Soldier Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, INT and END by 1.

items.name: Gaius's Set
items.desc: The Gaius's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Starcaller class. Part of an armor set patterned after fallen seeds. Gaius was the most senior disciple of the same Alabaster Lord who taught Radahn and Gaea gravitational technique.

pieces.desc: The black iron helm of Commander Gaius.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Gaius's Armor
pieces.desc: The black iron chest armor of Commander Gaius.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 4, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases physical weapon damage by 4%.

pieces.desc: The black iron gauntlets of Commander Gaius.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Gaius's Greaves
pieces.desc: Black iron greaves made for Commander Gaius. A cruel joke, for he could not wear them. Riding atop the boar he called his other half, Gaius was in fact a warrior of albinauric extraction.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.

items.name: High Priest Set
items.desc: The High Priest Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Starcaller class. The hat of Count Ymir, High Priest. Though Count Ymir instructed Rellana in the sorcerous arts, he abandoned his allegiance to the moon.

pieces.name: High Priest Hat
pieces.desc: The circular design at the top represents the Greater Will and its lightless abyss.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 3, Mind by 2 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 2%.

pieces.name: High Priest Robe
pieces.desc: Robe of Count Ymir, High Priest. Conceals the abundance of squirming beneath. Gold embroidery decorates the purple cloth, with a jewelled ruff that sparkles like a flower wet with dew.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 6, Mind by 4 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 4%.

pieces.name: High Priest Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 3, Mind by 2 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 2%.

pieces.name: High Priest Undergarments
pieces.desc: Undergarments of Count Ymir, High Priest. Soft and well-tailored.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 3, Mind by 2 and reduces the FP cost of sorceries by 2%.

items.desc: The Underworld Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Underworld Mage class. Worn by disinherited Numens who owe no allegiance to the Nox, this set reflects their kinship with the artificial creatures of the fallen empire.

Hood of an underworld outcast.

Robe of an underworld outcast.

items.desc: The Volcanist Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Volcanist class. Belonging to Leyndell nobles who swore allegiance to Praetor Rykard, these garments reflect the corruption of those who felt owed more than they were given after the Shattering.

pieces.obtain: Volcano Manor – Facing Tanith from the site of grace, take the hallway on the right and open the first door on the right. Roll into the painting past the corpse and enter the dark hallway. Take a left in the dark room to find the set.

pieces.effect:
A robe belonging to a noble of Leyndell, now sworn to the blasphemous cause of Volcano Manor.

Mask worn by Tanith, in the image of a foreign queen.

pieces.obtain: Volcano Manor – Join the Manor, take a key from Tanith, turn right and take the second door on the left. Take the items and invade at the red summon sign in North Limgrave. Win and return to Tanith for the reward.

Fine robe of white silk worn by Tanith.

Helm worn by one of the self-styled Stormcallers.

Knight’s helm covered in a long cloth of deep red.

pieces.effect:
Knight’s greaves, worn by salt winds and battle.

Greaves of divine beast warriors, made from a golden metal.

Hood used by the Black Knife Assassins.

Silk hood worn by the monks of the Eternal City.

Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached.

Crown worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City.

Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City.

items.name: Set of Night
items.desc: The Set of Night is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Nox Oracle class. Bottomless black pieces cool to the touch, adorned with fingerprint-like patterns and bestowed upon those born deep underground to ordain them as Swordhands of Night.

Bottomless black helm, cool to the touch.

Bottomless black chest armor, cool to the touch.

Bottomless black greaves, cool to the touch.

items.name: Necromancer Set
items.desc: The Necromancer Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Necromancer class. Given to practices considered heretical by the Golden Order, necromancers practice their craft in secret. Champions of Those That Live in Death and students of the ancient funerary rites of the death birds, necromancers see the ascendency of the Erdtree as tyrannical and oppressive.

pieces.name: Necromancer Hood
pieces.desc: A hood worn by a necromancer, maligned by the Erdtree's faithful.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

pieces.name: Necromancer Robe
pieces.desc: A robe worn by a necromancer, maligned by the Erdtree's faithful.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

pieces.desc: Trousers worn by a necromancer, maligned by the Erdtree's faithful.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

items.name: Fia's Set
items.desc: The Fia's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Necromancer class. Worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion, on her journey after being exiled from her home. The fabric itself is soft as silk and thin enough that those embraced can feel every pulse; every bit of her warmth.

pieces.name: Fia's Hood
pieces.desc: Hood of black cloth that covers the whole head.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and increases damage of Death Sorcery by 1%.

pieces.name: Fia's Robe
pieces.desc: Robe of black cloth that covers the entire body.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 4, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4% and increases damage of Death Sorcery by 2%.

pieces.name: Fia's Bracelets
pieces.desc: The bracelets of deathbed companions.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and increases damage of Death Sorcery by 1%.

pieces.name: Fia's Trousers
pieces.desc: Trousers of black cloth worn by traveling deathbed companions.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and increases damage of Death Sorcery by 1%.

items.obtain: Found in Fortified Manor.

items.name: Deathbed Set
items.desc: The Deathbed Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Necromancer class. Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead. The touch of the fabric is exceedingly soft, so as not to harm even the most withered corpse, while still sharing her warmth.

pieces.name: Deathbed Dress
pieces.desc: Extremely thin and sheer white dress worn by the Deathbed Companion as she embraces the dead.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 4, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 4% and increases damage of Death Sorcery by 2%.

pieces.desc: Undergarments worn by Fia, the Deathbed Companion.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and increases damage of Death Sorcery by 1%.

items.name: Royal Remains Set
items.desc: The Royal Remains Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Necromancer class. Worn by the unspeaking adherent of Sir Gideon the All-Knowing. It is said that the bones belong to an ancient lord—the soulless king. The lord of the lost and desperate, who was known as Ensha.

pieces.name: Royal Remains Helm
pieces.desc: Helm graced with gold human bones.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT, FTH and END by 1 and increases all holy damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Royal Remains Armor
pieces.desc: Armor graced with gold human bones.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT, FTH and END by 2 and increases all holy damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Royal Remains Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets graced with gold human bones.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT, FTH and END by 1 and increases all holy damage by 1%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT, FTH and END by 1 and increases all holy damage by 1%.

items.name: Mausoleum Knight Set
items.desc: The Mausoleum Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Necromancer class. Worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. The wing-shaped ornaments on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

pieces.name: Mausoleum Knight Helm
pieces.desc: A helm once worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum before their beheading. Time has yet to dull their luster.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon holy damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Mausoleum Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 4, reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon holy damage by 2%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon holy damage by 1%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon holy damage by 1%.
