items.name: Gravebird Set
items.desc: The Gravebird Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Necromancer class. Gravebirds are ancient golems, created to guard the spiritgraves built where all manners of Death ultimately drift.

pieces.name: Gravebird Helm
pieces.desc: Stone helm with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1, increases all holy damage by 1% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

pieces.name: Gravebird's Blackquill Armor
pieces.desc: Stone armor with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2, increases all holy damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Gravebird Bracelets
pieces.desc: Stone bracelets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1, increases all holy damage by 1% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

pieces.name: Gravebird Anklets
pieces.desc: Stone anklets with a tinge of green. One of a set of armor pieces cast in the image of the Gravebird.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1, increases all holy damage by 1% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

items.obtain: From the Temple Town Ruins site of grace, head northwest up the river until you see some scarlet buds, at this point, turn left towards the gravebird statues and go straight ahead until you encounter the coffin statue with a corpse at the front, where you will find the Gravebird armor set.

items.name: Frost Witch Set
items.desc: The Frost Witch Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Frost Witch class. Furtive and aloof, these sorcerers seem driven to discover new iterations of frost sorcery. Many find a natural ally in the Princess of Caria Manor.

pieces.desc: A hat worn by a former student of the snow witch Renna..
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and ARC by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%..

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and ARC by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and ARC by 1 and reduces FP cost of sorcery by 1%.

items.name: Zamor Set
items.desc: The Zamor Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Frost Witch class. These long-lived warriors, clad in biting, freezing winds, are said to have been the mortal enemies of the Fire Giants since time immemorial.

pieces.desc: Mask worn by knights of Zamor, hailed as heroes in the War against the Giants.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT, ARC and END by 1 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

items.desc: The Snow Witch Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Frost Witch class. Once worn by the snowy crone who the young Ranni encountered deep in the woods. She was a witch, and well versed in cold sorceries. It is said that the doll that houses Ranni's soul was modeled after her. That old witch was Ranni's secret mentor.

pieces.desc: Witch's pointed hat, frigid and frozen through. Of a style associated with practitioners of heretical sorcery.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and ARC by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and increases damage of Frost Sorcery by 1%.

pieces.desc: Witch's robe in the color of snow.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and ARC by 2, reduces FP cost of sorcery by 2% and increases damage of Frost Sorcery by 1%.

items.desc: The Blaidd's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Frost Witch class. Blaidd, who served as Ranni's shadow, was a loyal ally who would defy destiny itself if it would have him turn upon his Lady. The set includes a mask fashioned after the head of a black wolf, a relic of an assassin who assumed the guise of Ranni the Witch's loyal shadow.

pieces.desc: A mask fashioned after the head of a black wolf. The likeness is striking.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and ARC by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon magic damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Blaidd's Armor
pieces.desc: Well-worn black armor of the man-wolf Blaidd. The pelt serves as a cape, protecting from cold. Blaidd was the blade of Ranni, but the cold bothered him anyway.

items.name: Heretic's Set
items.desc: The Heretic’s Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Aberrant Heretic class. Marked by a collar of sharpened branches, this attire is worn by sorcerers driven to unspeakable acts in the pursuit of great power. Their heinous crimes can lead to the corruption of glintstone, turning it a shade of bright crimson.

pieces.name: Heretic’s Collar
pieces.effect:
A hood worn by those accused of greater crimes, indicated by the collar of sharpened branches.

Passive: Increases INT, ARC and END by 1.
pieces.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes – Due north of the Artist’s shack, head into the Fire camp, take a right and in the tent by the prelate there will be a corpse with the set.

pieces.name: Heretic’s Rags
pieces.effect:
Rags of those accused of greater crimes.

items.name: Alberich's Set
items.desc: The Alberich’s Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Aberrant Heretic class. Worn by Mad Tongue Alberich, a heretical sorcerer driven mad by jeering tongues, these pieces are set with red glintstones said to be formed by the blood of sacrifices.

pieces.effect:
Hat of a defected glintstone sorcerer.

Metal helm with a pointed beak.

items.desc: The Briar Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Aberrant Heretic class. Worn by Elemer of the Briar (the Bell Bearing Hunter), this battered iron set is marked by rusted iron briars, a symbol of the guilty and a sentence of death.

pieces.effect:
Battered iron helm from a foreign land.

items.desc: The Prophet Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Flame Prophet class. Exiled prophets foretold misfortune and were persecuted and driven from their homes as a result. "Why hesitate, if the path leading to the future is clear? Just close your eyes, and walk."

pieces.desc: Blindfold of the exiled prophets.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1, reduces FP cost of incantations by 1% and increases casting speed by 2.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all fire damage by 1%.

items.name: Fire Prelate Set
items.desc: The Fire Prelate Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Flame Prophet class. The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master. pieces.desc: Gauntlets of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases the damage of Giantsflame incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Fire Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases the damage of Giantsflame incantations by 2%.

items.obtain: Found on top of the large carcass on the first floor of the storehouse.

items.name: Messmer's Set
items.desc: The Messmer's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Flame Prophet class. On his mother's wishes, Messmer made himself a symbol of fear, undertaking the cleansing crusade she desired. "Direct thy maledictions, thine ire, and thy grief towards me alone."

pieces.name: Messmer's Helm
pieces.desc: Black helm of Messmer the Impaler, crowned with two intertwined winged serpents. The winged snakes were Messmer's constant companions.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 3 and increases all fire damage you deal by 2%.

pieces.name: Messmer's Armor
pieces.desc: Black armor of Messmer the Impaler. Draped with a red cloak bearing his crest embroidered.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 6 and increases all fire damage you deal by 4%.

pieces.name: Messmer's Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Black gauntlets of Messmer the Impaler.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 3 and increases all fire damage you deal by 2%.

pieces.name: Messmer's Greaves
pieces.desc: Black greaves of Messmer the Impaler.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 3 and increases all fire damage you deal by 2%.

items.obtain: Sold by Enia after defeating Messmer.

items.name: Fundamentalist Set
items.desc: The Fundamentalist Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. After their return to the lands between, many members of the Golden Order have yet to decide whether to seek the deeper truths into the nature of their faith or to join the hunters in their dogmatic quest to rid the world of its flaws.

pieces.name: Fundamentalist Crown
pieces.desc: An ornamental crown worn by adherents of the Golden Order.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Fundamentalist Breastplate
pieces.desc: An ornamental breastplate worn by adherents of the Golden Order.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 4%.

pieces.name: Fundamentalist Bracers
pieces.desc: Ornamental gauntlets worn by adherents of the Golden Order.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Fundamentalist Greaves
pieces.desc: Ornamental greaves worn by adherents of the Golden Order.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

items.obtain: Found on the ground north of the Mistwood Ruins.

items.name: Twinned Set
items.desc: The Twinned Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. The two known as D are inseparable twins. They are of two bodies and two minds, but one single soul. Not once do they stand together; not one word do they speak to one another. Perhaps this armor longs to find its way to the other D.

pieces.name: Twinned Helm
pieces.desc: Helm depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all holy damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Twinned Armor
pieces.desc: Armor depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases all holy damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Twinned Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all holy damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Twinned Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves depicting entwined twins of gold and silver.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all holy damage by 1%.

items.obtain: Found next to the Prince of Death's Throne grace after defeating Fortissax.

items.name: Tree Sentinel Set
items.desc: The Tree Sentinel Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. Worn by the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree. Imposingly sturdy and nigh unbreakable, the grace of old yet lingers.

pieces.name: Tree Sentinel Helm
pieces.desc: Golden helm of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree. Very few are permitted to wear a golden wood crest of such size as seen on this helm.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH, Mind and END by 1, reduces FP cost of incantations by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Tree Sentinel Armor
pieces.desc: Golden armor of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree. Adorned with a cape featuring the mark of the sacred tree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH, Mind and END by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 2% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Golden gauntlets of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH, Mind and END by 1, reduces FP cost of incantations by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Tree Sentinel Greaves
pieces.desc: Golden greaves of the heavy cavalry Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH, Mind and END by 1, reduces FP cost of incantations by 1% and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

items.obtain: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel Duo

items.name: Goldmask's Set
items.desc: The Goldmask's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. Created and left behind by Lord Goldmask, a staunch pursuer of Golden Order fundamentalism. Lord Goldmask felt no draw to the vain excesses of clothing; what use is finery to one who seeks greater brilliance? His disciples, who made his minimal adornments, have long since left him.

pieces.name: Radiant Gold Mask
pieces.desc: A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo. Its striking design represents both the brilliant inspiration that once shone upon him, and the vision of a ring that he will surely find at the end of his pursuit.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Golden Order incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Goldmask's Rags
pieces.desc: Worn rags that just barely cover the body.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, reduces FP cost of incantations by 8% and increases damage of Golden Order incantations by 4%.

pieces.name: Gold Bracelets
pieces.desc: Bracelets made in the image of Erdtree branches. Minimal adornments made by Lord Goldmask's disciples.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Golden Order incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Gold Waistwrap
pieces.desc: Waistwrap made in the image of Erdtree branches. A minimal adornment made by Lord Goldmask's disciples.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Golden Order incantations by 2%.

items.obtain: Found on Goldmask's corpse.

items.name: Haligtree Knight Set
items.desc: The Haligtree Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. Worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

pieces.name: Haligtree Knight Helm
pieces.desc: Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon holy damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Haligtree Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Armor worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Its left breast is emblazoned with the crest of the Haligtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon holy damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Haligtree Knight Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon holy damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Haligtree Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon holy damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Found up the ladder on a corpse by the Elphael Inner Wall Site of Grace.

items.name: Young Lion's Set
items.desc: The Young Lion's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. The golden armor worn by Radahn in his younger years. Proudly displaying his heroic red hair, it is fitting attire for a lion. When Malenia, Blade of Miquella, let the rotflower blossom in Aeonia, Radahn heard a murmur in his ear—"Miquella awaits thee, O promised consort."

pieces.name: Young Lion's Helm
pieces.desc: The golden helm worn by Radahn in his younger years. Proudly displaying his heroic red hair, it is fitting attire for a lion.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 1% and increases holy weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Young Lion's Armor
pieces.desc: The golden armor worn by Radahn in his younger years. Proudly adorned with heroic red accents, it is fitting attire for a lion.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Young Lion's Gauntlets
pieces.desc: The golden gauntlets worn by Radahn in his younger years.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 1% and increases holy weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Young Lion's Greaves
pieces.desc: The golden greaves worn by Radahn in his younger years. Worn by a fierce lion.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 1, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 1% and increases holy weapon damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Sold by Enia after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

items.name: Dryleaf Set
items.desc: The Dryleaf Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Fundamentalist class. Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. This sect rejects dependence on others in all matters of faith, seeking self-discipline and self-sufficiency above all else.

pieces.name: Dane's Hat
pieces.desc: The sun-faded and lightly soiled hat of Dryleaf Dane. Worn low over the eyes, it obscures the wearer's vision. Meeting the gaze of another can overcome the senses, often leading to the downfall of those who would walk the noble and solitary seekers' path.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Dryleaf Robe
pieces.desc: Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. The gold necklace found under the breast belongs to a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4% and increases holy weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Dryleaf Arm Wraps
pieces.desc: Sun-faded and lightly soiled arm wraps. Wound tightly around the arms as if it might prevent them from being broken.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Dryleaf Cuissardes
pieces.desc: Sun-faded and lightly soiled travel attire worn by clergymen. Boots made of sturdy leather.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2% and increases holy weapon damage by 1%.

items.obtain: Found under a waterfall south of the Ruins of Unte.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Set
items.desc: The Vulgar Militia Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

pieces.name: Vulgar Militia Helm
pieces.desc: Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen. The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 1%.

pieces.name: Vulgar Militia Armor
pieces.desc: Armor worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 2 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Vulgar Militia Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 1%.

items.obtain: Found in a gazebo past the Tempest-Facing Balcony grace.

items.name: Beast Clergy Set
items.desc: The Beast Clergy Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. Although he makes great efforts to remain hidden, Gurranq has become an inspiration for the militiamen that guard the sanctum. This attire acts as a tribute to his might.

pieces.name: Beast Clergy Hood
pieces.desc: A hood made in imitation of the reclusive Gurranq.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increase FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Bestial Incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Beast Clergy Robe
pieces.desc: A robe made in imitation of the reclusive Gurranq.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increase FTH by 4, reduces FP cost of incantations by 8% and increases damage of Bestial Incantations by 4%.

pieces.name: Beast Clergy Bracers
pieces.desc: Bracers made in imitation of the reclusive Gurranq.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increase FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Bestial Incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Beast Clergy Boots
pieces.desc: Boots made in imitation of the reclusive Gurranq.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increase FTH by 2, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Bestial Incantations by 2%.

items.obtain: Dropped by Black Blade Kindred.

items.name: Crucible Axe Set
items.desc: The Crucible Axe Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. Worn by the knight Ordovis and his men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

pieces.name: Crucible Axe Helm
pieces.desc: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The axe ornamentation is the knight Ordovis's mark, displayed also by his men.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Crucible Axe Armor
pieces.desc: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, END by 2 and increases all physical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Crucible Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Crucible Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

items.obtain: Found in the building past Bernahl's invasion.

items.name: Crucible Tree Set
items.desc: The Crucible Tree Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. Worn by the knight Siluria and her men. Holds the power of the crucible of life, the primordial form of the Erdtree. In time, the strength shown by these knights, and even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

pieces.name: Crucible Tree Helm
pieces.desc: Helm of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. The great tree ornamentation is the knight Siluria's mark, displayed also by her men.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Crucible Tree Armor
pieces.desc: Armor of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. Worn by the knight Siluria and her men.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, END by 2 and increases all physical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Crucible Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Crucible Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of the Crucible Knights who served Godfrey, the first Elden Lord.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all physical damage by 1%.

items.obtain: Obtained after defeating Crucible Knight Siluria inside the giant rotten tree stump in the northwest corner of the depths.

items.name: Beast Champion Set
items.desc: The Beast Champion Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. Beasts are drawn to champions, and to lords. And this armor befits a champion worthy of becoming a lord. And that is what Bernahl was. Until his maiden threw herself into the fire.

pieces.name: Beast Champion Helm
pieces.desc: Silver helm engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant. The beasts, their eyes and ears covered, represent an oath: "See nothing, hear nothing, doubt nothing, and carry on, along the path set in stone."
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 1, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon physical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Beast Champion Armor
pieces.desc: Silver armor engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon physical damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Beast Champion Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Silver gauntlets engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 1, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon physical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Beast Champion Greaves
pieces.desc: Silver greaves engraved with tiny beasts. Worn by Bernahl the Recusant.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and STR by 1, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon physical damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Dropped by Knight Bernahl

items.name: Iron Rivet Set
items.desc: The Iron Rivet Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

pieces.name: Pelt of Ralva
pieces.desc: The pelt of Ralva the Great Red Bear, worn upon the head without modification. This untreated hide, won at the end of a bloody bout, is just the thing to make a wild bear out of a warrior.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH, END and VIG by 3.

pieces.name: Iron Rivet Armor
pieces.desc: Chest armor of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. A vest reinforced with iron rivets.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 2 and increases physical weapon damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Iron Rivet Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 1 and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Iron Rivet Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness. Reinforced with iron rivets.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, FTH and END by 1 and increases physical weapon damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Dropped by Rugalea the Great Red Bear

items.name: Divine Bird Set
items.desc: The Divine Bird Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Bestial Devout class. The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

pieces.name: Divine Bird Helm
pieces.desc: A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine bird mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine bird warriors; the very first of all horned warriors.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 1%, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all physical damage you deal by 1%.

pieces.name: Divine Bird Warrior Armor
pieces.desc: Armor of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases all physical damage you deal by 2%.

pieces.name: Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 1%, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all physical damage you deal by 1%.

pieces.name: Divine Bird Warrior Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 1%, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 2% and increases all physical damage you deal by 1%.

items.obtain: Found in a gazebo in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

items.name: Dragon Cult Set
items.desc: The Dragon Cult Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Dragon Cultist class. Some knights of Leyndell have turned their attention away from the service to the Erdtree and toward the power of lightning. Devout to the memory of Godwyn in life and fascinated with the doings of the ancients, these knights formed a new orthodoxy, the first major schism in the Dragon Cult.

pieces.name: Dragon Cult Helm
pieces.desc: A Helm worn by a former knight of the capital.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and increases casting speed by 4.

pieces.name: Dragon Cult Armor
pieces.desc: Armor worn by a former knight of the capital.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2 and increases casting speed by 8.

pieces.name: Dragon Cult Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets worn by a former knight of the capital.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and increases casting speed by 4.

pieces.name: Dragon Cult Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves worn by a former knight of the capital.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and increases casting speed by 4.

items.obtain: Found on a corpse near a gate lever and two giant crabs waiting in ambush in the depths of Wyndham Catacombs.

items.name: Leyndell Knight Set
items.desc: The Leyndell Knight Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Dragon Cultist class. Worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

pieces.name: Leyndell Knight Helm
pieces.desc: Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. The golden canopy represents the honor of standing among the tree's defenders.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, increases casting speed by 6 and increases all lightning damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Leyndell Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship, said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, increases casting speed by 12 and increases all lightning damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Leyndell Knight Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, increases casting speed by 6 and increases all lightning damage by 1%.

pieces.name: Leyndell Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, increases casting speed by 6 and increases all lightning damage by 1%.

items.obtain: Obtained by defeating the invisible scarab, identifiable by its glowing footprints, down the lift from the Erdtree Sanctuary, past the page, perfumer, and Crucible Knight

items.name: Malformed Dragon Set
items.desc: The Malformed Dragon Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Dragon Cultist class. Adorned with various dragon imagery and worn by the misshapen Tree Sentinels. After the great ancient dragon Gransax attacked, the sentinels had an epiphany. The only way to truly protect the Erdtree was to become dragons themselves.

pieces.name: Malformed Dragon Helm
pieces.desc: A malformed golden helm.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon lightning damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
pieces.desc: Malformed golden armor.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, reduces weapon stamina cost by 4% and increases weapon lightning damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Malformed golden gauntlets.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon lightning damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Malformed Dragon Greaves
pieces.desc: Malformed golden greaves.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, reduces weapon stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon lightning damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel in Farum Azula.

items.name: Death Knight Set
items.desc: The Death Knight Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Dragon Cultist class. These knights, once Godwyn's personal guard, quested to find their transfigured master's cadaver surrogate—for the coming age of the Duskborn

pieces.name: Death Knight Helm
pieces.desc: Golden helm of the Death Knights, whose own death masks served as the visards of their armor. The decayed golden wheel that adorns it represents their unbroken loyalty to Godwyn, he who became Prince of Death.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all lightning damage you deal by 1%.

pieces.name: Death Knight Armor
pieces.desc: Golden armor of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 4, END by 2 and increases all lightning damage you deal by 2%.

pieces.name: Death Knight Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Golden gauntlets of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all lightning damage you deal by 1%.

pieces.name: Death Knight Greaves
pieces.desc: Golden greaves of the Death Knights, adorned with an antiquated depiction of the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, END by 1 and increases all lightning damage you deal by 1%.

items.obtain: Obtained by defeating Death Knight Lenny behind some large tombstones near the Blight Nox Ancestor arena entrance.

items.name: Festive Set
items.desc: The Festive Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Godskin Celebrant class. These garments, decorated with many-colored flowers, are worn by the dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

pieces.name: Festive Hood / Alt
pieces.effect:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula.

Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 1%.
pieces.obtain: Altus Plateau – Found on a corpse on the north side of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge on its broken edge.

pieces.name: Festive Garb / Alt
pieces.effect:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula.

Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 2 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Festive Gloves
pieces.effect:
Ceremonial gloves worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula.

Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 1%.

pieces.name: Festive Trousers
pieces.effect:
Ceremonial trousers worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula.

Passive: Increases INT and FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 1%.

items.name: Blue Festive Set
items.desc: The Blue Festive Set is a rare Tier 1 armor variant associated with the Godskin Celebrant class. Dyed in a stunning blue, this attire is permitted only for the young maids who play the central role in the Dominula festival.

pieces.name: Blue Festive Hood
pieces.effect:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula.

Passive: Increases INT, FTH and Mind by 1.

pieces.name: Blue Festive Garb
pieces.effect:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula.

Passive: Increases INT, FTH and Mind by 2.

items.name: Godskin Apostle Set
items.desc: The Godskin Apostle Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Godskin Celebrant class. Made by sewing together patches of smooth skin, this set is worn by the Godskin Apostles who wield the god-slaying black flame.

pieces.name: Godskin Apostle Hood

items.name: War Surgeon Set
items.desc: The War Surgeon Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Blood Initiate class. Of the surgeons that were abducted by the Lord of Blood, none were able to tame the accursed blood. None but Varré, that is; though he was an exception.

items.name: House Marais Set
items.desc: The House Marais Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Blood Initiate class. The Marais family has a dual history spanning generations, serving as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle. The sons of House Marais are all sickly born. Little wonder that Maleigh Marais would be so beguiled by the restoration promised by the new dynasty of blood.

pieces.name: Marais Mask
pieces.desc: Mask in the image of a white-haired young noble. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais. This mask bears the likeness of the first of their line.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 1, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases the damage of Bloodflame Incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Marais Robe
pieces.desc: Robe with a black mantle across the shoulders. Customarily worn by the head of House Marais.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 2, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 8% and increases the damage of Bloodflame Incantations by 4%.

pieces.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
pieces.desc: Manchettes formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Any protection is welcome for the festering arms beneath.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 1, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases the damage of Bloodflame Incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Bloodsoaked Wraps
pieces.desc: Legwraps formed from tightly-wound bandages soaked through with blood. Any protection is welcome for the festering legs beneath.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 1, reduces the FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases the damage of Bloodflame Incantations by 2%.

items.name: Sanguine Noble Set
items.desc: The Sanguine Noble Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Blood Initiate class. Worn by the nobles who serve the Lord of Blood. Known to strike from pools of blood, these assassins are missionaries come to share the gospel of accursed blood.

pieces.name: Sanguine Noble Hood
pieces.desc: Hood of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 1, recovers 1 HP per second and increases all fire damage by 1%.

pieces.desc: Robe of dyed black cloth featuring gold embroidery. The grand metallic pattern on the shoulder is a signifier of the noble rank they intend to claim upon the advent of the new dynasty they are working to install.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 2, recovers 2 HP per second and increases all fire damage by 2%.

items.name: White Reed Set
items.desc: The White Reed Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Blood Initiate class. Worn by the Inaba, head disciples of the great swordsman Okina. The Inaba traveled in pursuit of not only the master who abandoned them, but also proper deaths, won honorably through hard-fought combat. To be a White Reed is to seek death; fitting for the Inaba, who desired nothing more than to die by the sword.

pieces.name: Okina Mask
pieces.desc: A wooden mask that depicts an old man baring his teeth. The source of the sobriquet of the great swordsman of the Land of Reeds. Before long, Okina became a demon of a swordsman.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 1, reduces weapons stamina cost by 2% and increases weapon fire damage by 2%.

pieces.name: White Reed Armor

Once down, continue onwards pass the spirit snail and wolf. You will eventually find yourself in another large section of the cave, with several wolfs, near the middle of this room, behind a resting wolf, you will see a a corpse with a drop on top of them, this will grant you the White Reed Set.

items.name: Ansbach's Set
items.desc: The Ansbach's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Blood Initiate class. Ansbach understood that keeping his oath to his old master was not an act of logic, nor would it bear any justice, but it was for these very reasons he was unable to let go.

pieces.name: Wise Man's Mask
pieces.desc: The iron mask of Sir Ansbach, giving the appearance of a quiet, wise, old bearded man. But an old fear lurks beneath, together with the cold, unflinching discipline that once honed his blade.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1 and increases all fire damage you deal by 1%.

pieces.name: Ansbach's Attire
pieces.desc: Attire of Sir Ansbach. The embroidered crest of the Pureblood Knights has now all but faded away.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 2 and increases all fire damage you deal by 2%.

items.desc: The Dreamer's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Mystic class. After enough time devoted to the study of dreams, many mystics begin to forego social conventions, allowing their clothing to wear to almost nothing.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH and ARC by 1, reduces FP cost of incantations by 4% and increases damage of Mystic Incantations by 2%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and END by 1 and increases all magic damage by 1%.

pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 1 and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Thiollier's Garb
pieces.desc: The dark attire of those who wield poison in secret. The silver hair is arranged in the same style as St. Trina's. Additionally, countless needles are sewn onto the exterior, apparently for talismanic effect.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 2 and increases magic weapon damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Thiollier's Gloves
pieces.desc: The dark gloves of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 1 and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Thiollier's Trousers
pieces.desc: The dark trousers of those who wield poison in secret, ever scorned and loathed.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and MIND by 1 and increases magic weapon damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Dropped by Thiollier.

items.name: Caimar's Set
items.desc: The Caimar's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Mystic class. While never directly under the sway of Miquella, Caimar was a great ally of St. Trina, finding her compassion for the downtrodden not dissimilar to his own calling as protector of the now marginalized ancestral followers.

pieces.name: Spiritshaper's Antlers
pieces.desc: Acting as steward of the ancestral followers, these antlers marked him out as the foremost among mystics in his mastery over the spirit realm.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1, increases all magic damage by 1% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

pieces.name: Spiritshaper's Cloak
pieces.desc: A cloak of furs and leather, both practical and ornamental.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 2, increases all magic damage by 2% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 4%.

pieces.name: Spiritshaper's Wraps
pieces.desc: Minimal leather straps wound around the wrist and forearm.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1, increases all magic damage by 1% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

pieces.name: Spiritshaper's Trousers
pieces.desc: Simple woven trousers. An overtly humble adornment for one as revered as Caimar.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH, ARC and Mind by 1, increases all magic damage by 1% and reduces the stamina cost of attacks by 2%.

items.obtain: Sold by Enia after defeating Caimar.

items.name: Traveling Perfumer's Set
items.desc: The Traveling Perfumer's Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Perfumer class. An associate of a healer, he is said to be in search of new aromatics and flower gardens, in hopes of treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure.

pieces.name: Traveler's Hat
pieces.desc: Hat of a traveling perfumer of no renown.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 1 and increases item discovery by 2%.

pieces.name: Perfumer's Traveling Garb
pieces.desc: Garb of a traveling perfumer of no renown.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 2 and increases item discovery by 4%.

pieces.name: Traveler's Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves of a traveling perfumer of no renown.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 1 and increases item discovery by 2%.

pieces.name: Traveler's Slops
pieces.desc: Slops of a traveling perfumer of no renown.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 1 and increases item discovery by 2%.

items.obtain: Found on a corpse lying in the corner of one of the ruined buildings.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Set
items.desc: The Depraved Perfumer Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Perfumer class. These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

pieces.name: Depraved Perfumer Headscarf
pieces.desc: Hood of a depraved perfumer gripped by madness.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC and END by 2, increases damage of throwing pots by 2% and increases item discovery by 4%.

pieces.name: Depraved Perfumer Robe
pieces.desc: Robe of a depraved perfumer gripped by madness. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC and END by 4, increases damage of throwing pots by 4% and increases item discovery by 8%.

pieces.name: Depraved Perfumer Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves of a depraved perfumer gripped by madness.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC and END by 2, increases damage of throwing pots by 2% and increases item discovery by 4%.

pieces.name: Depraved Perfumer Trousers
pieces.desc: Boots of a depraved perfumer gripped by madness.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC and END by 2, increases damage of throwing pots by 2% and increases item discovery by 4%.

items.obtain: Found on a corpse hanging off a rock cliff inside the south courtyard.

items.name: Omenkiller Set
items.desc: The Omenkiller Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Perfumer class. Its thick apron is worn in remembrance of Rollo, the progenitor of the Omenkillers and a perfumer of antiquity. This visage is carved in the image of the evil spirits that haunt the Omen in their nightmares.

pieces.name: Omensmirk Mask
pieces.desc: Mask with long, hideously twisted horns worn by the Omenkillers. Bears the smirking face of an elder, twisted in wicked delight.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC by 3, END by 2 and VIG by 1 and increases item discovery by 2%.

pieces.name: Omenkiller Robe
pieces.desc: Robe worn by the Omenkillers, butchers of twisted conscience.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC by 6, END by 4 and VIG by 2 and increases item discovery by 4%.

pieces.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
pieces.desc: Long, stiff leather gloves worn by the Omenkillers.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC by 3, END by 2 and VIG by 1 and increases item discovery by 2%.

pieces.name: Omenkiller Boots
pieces.desc: Stiff leather boots worn by the Omenkillers.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC by 3, END by 2 and VIG by 1 and increases item discovery by 2%.

items.obtain: Obtained by killing the Omenkiller at the Perfumer's Ruins.

items.name: Perfumer Set
items.desc: The Perfumer Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Perfumer class. In times past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

pieces.name: Perfumer Hood
pieces.desc: Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 2, increases damage of perfumes by 2% and increases item discovery by 2%.

pieces.name: Perfumer Robe
pieces.desc: Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 4, increases damage of perfumes by 4% and increases item discovery by 4%.

pieces.name: Perfumer Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 2, increases damage of perfumes by 2% and increases item discovery by 2%.

pieces.name: Perfumer Sarong
pieces.desc: Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC, END and VIG by 2, increases damage of perfumes by 2% and increases item discovery by 2%.

items.obtain: Found on a corpse lying in a puddle next to a Miranda Flower.

items.name: Prisoner Set
items.desc: The Prisoner Set is a Tier 1 armor set associated with the Prisoner class. Forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. A foul creation designed to torment the wearer, either slowly fermenting hatred within their heart, or a spiritual fervor that is near indistinguishable from it. Never once washed, every fiber is filthy. The smell is beyond belief.

pieces.name: Prisoner Iron Mask
pieces.desc: Iron mask forced on a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime. Thick, heavy, and utterly stifling.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases VIG and END by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Prisoner Clothing
pieces.desc: Tattered clothing. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases VIG and END by 2 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Prisoner Chains
pieces.desc: A prisoner's shackles. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases VIG and END by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Prisoner Trousers
pieces.desc: Tattered trousers. Worn by a prisoner convicted of an appalling crime.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases VIG and END by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

items.obtain: Sold by the Hermit Merchant in Ainsel River.

items.name: Horned Warrior Set
items.desc: The Horned Warrior Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Prisoner class. These keepers of the tower wear armor draped in ochre fabric, shaped to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

pieces.name: Horned Warrior Helm
pieces.effect:
Helm featuring a crown of sturdy tangled horns.

Passive: Increases all stats by 1. (If Rune Level 1: Grants additional 1 Vig, 1 End, 1 Mind.)

Active (Master of All): If RL1, when you drink your Wondrous Physick, gain an effect that increases all damage, poise damage dealt, reduces stamina cost, and decreases FP costs of spells/skills by 1% per attack/cast (stacks to 25%, lasts 2 mins). Additionally, 5% of total HP, FP and stamina are recovered per attack/cast.
pieces.obtain: Belurat Tower Settlement – Found at the bottom of a set of spiral stairs in the tower directly before the Stagefront Site of Grace.

pieces.name: Horned Warrior Armor
pieces.effect:
The ochre fabric is draped over a chest-piece made to resemble the unclothed form of a hero.

Passive: Increases all stats by 2. (If RL1: Grants additional 1 Vig, 1 End, 1 Mind.)

Active (Drake’s Dynamism): If RL1, when you drink a crimson flask, the resource cost of your next 3 attacks or spells is reduced by 100%. Additionally, you gain 25% increased absorption and become less likely to be staggered until the third attack/spell.
pieces.obtain: Subterranean Shunning Grounds – Obtained at a statue behind a gate to the left of the Underground Roadside Site of Grace.

pieces.name: Horned Warrior Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Gauntlets of the horned warriors, made from a thick metal.

Passive: Increases all stats by 1. (If RL1: Grants additional 1 Vig, 1 End, 1 Mind.)

Active (Rhythm of War): If RL1, non-spell attacks/jumps buff spell damage by 10% (recovering 5% HP on cast, lasts 7s). Casting a spell buffs non-spell damage by 10% (recovering 5% FP on attack, lasts 7s).
pieces.obtain: Stormveil Castle – To the right of the Main Gate, drop to wooden planks hanging off the wall, pass through an opening, and loot the corpse at the end.

pieces.name: Horned Warrior Greaves
pieces.effect:
Greaves shaped to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

Passive: Increases all stats by 1. (If RL1: Grants additional 1 Vig, 1 End, 1 Mind.)

Active (Dimensional Shift): If RL1, when you drink a cerulean flask, you become invulnerable for 10 seconds or until your next attack, spell, or jump.
pieces.obtain: Mt. Gelmir, Hermit Village – Obtained on top of the roof on one of the houses in the village.

items.name: Eccentric's Set
items.desc: The Eccentric’s Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Prisoner class. Worn by the knight Jerren, who preferred a nomadic existence before being bound by an honorable oath to General Radahn.

pieces.name: Eccentric’s Hood / Alt
pieces.effect:
A pointy, ragged hood hiding an aged, bearded mask.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX, VIG by 1 and END by 3. (If RL1: +1 STR, DEX, VIG).

Active (Thrill of Battle): If RL1, when you drink your physick, gain a buff that grants +1 to STR, DEX, END, VIG, and MIND every time you dodge, jump, hit with melee, hit with arrow/bolt, or block (stacks unlimited, lasts 90 seconds).
pieces.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants – Found in the first-floor room of Heretical Rise on a corpse.

pieces.name: Eccentric’s Armor
pieces.effect:
Unusually colorful armor worn by the knight Jerren.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX, VIG by 2 and END by 4. (If RL1: +1 STR, DEX, VIG).

Active (Esoteric Rancor): If RL1, when you drink a crimson flask, gain a buff increasing weapon damage by 15% and reducing FP cost of weapon skills by 100% for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Redmane Castle – Found on a corpse before Dakk’s arena.

pieces.name: Eccentric’s Manchettes
pieces.effect:
The knight Jerren’s manchettes.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX, VIG by 1 and END by 3. (If RL1: +1 STR, DEX, VIG).

Active (Outcast’s Abandon): If RL1, when you use a grease or a consumable that you eat, gain an effect that reduces stamina cost of attacks by 50% and increases total absorption by 15% for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Weeping Peninsula – Found in a chest in the Witchbane Ruins.

pieces.name: Eccentric’s Breeches
pieces.effect:
The knight Jerren’s breeches.

Passive: Increases STR, DEX, VIG by 1 and END by 3. (If RL1: +1 STR, DEX, VIG).

Active (Witchbane Conversion): If RL1, when you drink a blue flask, gain a buff that increases poise damage by 15% and grants 3% HP recovery per second for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Caria Manor – Before the Manor Upper Level lift, go down the left ladder, jump to the separate building with a hatch and ladder leading down. Found in a chest.

items.name: All-Knowing Set
items.desc: The All-Knowing Set is a Tier 2 armor set associated with the Prisoner class. Set with countless eyes and ears, this armor belonged to Gideon Ofnir, who shuddered in fear when he glimpsed the will of Queen Marika.

pieces.name: All-Knowing Helm
pieces.effect:
Helm set with countless eyes and ears.

Passive: Increases INT, FTH, ARC by 1 and Mind by 3. (If RL1: +1 INT, FTH, ARC).

Active (Enlightenment): If RL1, when you drink your physick, gain +7 to INT, FTH, ARC, END, VIG, and Mind for 2 minutes.
pieces.obtain: Roundtable Hold – Given to the player by Sir Gideon Ofnir upon informing him of the whereabouts of Mohgwyn Palace.

pieces.name: All-Knowing Armor / Alt
pieces.effect:
Armor set with countless eyes and ears.

Passive: Increases INT, FTH, ARC by 2 and Mind by 4. (If RL1: +1 INT, FTH, ARC).

Active (Kinetic Enervation): If RL1, when you drink a crimson flask, dodge/jump attacks recover 5% total stamina. Additionally, dodging/jumping buffs all spell damage by 2% (stacks to 40%). Lasts for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital – Found on a corpse sitting on the railing of the second story of the Erdtree Sanctuary.

pieces.name: All-Knowing Gauntlets
pieces.effect:
Gauntlets set with countless eyes and ears.

Passive: Increases INT, FTH, ARC by 1 and Mind by 3. (If RL1: +1 INT, FTH, ARC).

Active (Cantrip Proficiency): If RL1, casting a spell recovers 3 FP and 5% total HP.
pieces.obtain: Limgrave, Fort Haight – Found on a corpse sitting in the corner of the storeroom, guarded by Commoners and Rats.

pieces.name: All-Knowing Greaves
pieces.effect:
Greaves set with countless eyes and ears.

Passive: Increases INT, FTH, ARC by 1 and Mind by 3. (If RL1: +1 INT, FTH, ARC).

Active (Apt Pupil): If RL1, when you drink a cerulean flask, gain 40 casting speed and 10 stamina recovery for 1 minute.
pieces.obtain: Liurnia, Academy Crystal Cave – Found in a chest past an illusory wall to the left shortly before reaching the Boss Room.

items.name: Albinauric Set
items.desc: The Albinauric Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Albinauric Mask
pieces.desc: Mask made from the largely unaltered hide of a young Albinauric. A far cry from godskin, this Albinauric hide mask is the product of malicious mockery.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC and END by 2.

pieces.name: Dirty Chainmail
pieces.desc: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefits worthy of note.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases ARC and END by 4.

items.obtain: Found in Volcano Town near the Guest Hall grace.

items.name: Aristocrat Set
items.desc: The Aristocrat Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Aristocrat Headband
pieces.desc: Headband featuring fine goldwork, or a leather hat decorated with a withered feather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases Mind and END by 1.

pieces.name: Aristocrat Garb
pieces.desc: High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases Mind and END by 2.

pieces.name: Aristocrat Boots
pieces.desc: Boots made from tanned leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases Mind and END by 1.

items.obtain: From Laskyar Ruins site of grace: Directly north on the exact same platform as the grace, the set will be found on a corpse sitting in the corner.

items.name: Astrologer Set
items.desc: The Astrologer Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Astrologer Hood
pieces.desc: Hood fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 1 and increases casting speed by 2.

pieces.name: Astrologer Robe
pieces.desc: Robe fashioned from supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 2 and increases casting speed by 4.

pieces.name: Astrologer Gloves
pieces.desc: Gloves fashioned from fine, supple cloth. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 1 and increases casting speed by 2.

pieces.name: Astrologer Trousers
pieces.desc: Trousers worn inside a robe. Worn by those who look to the cosmos above. They read fate in the stars, and are said to be heirs of the glintstone sorcerers. But alas, the night sky no longer cradles fate.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT by 1 and increases casting speed by 2.

items.obtain: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia.

items.name: Battlemage Set
items.desc: The Battlemage Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Haima Glintstone Crown
pieces.desc: One of the glintstone crowns bestowed upon Raya Lucaria scholars whose pursuits were deemed worthy. Scholars of the Haima Conspectus sought the power to quell conflict, and to this end studied the sorceries of cannon fire and the gavel.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and STR by 3.

pieces.name: Battlemage Robe
pieces.desc: Robe worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield. Whenever war broke out and the academy sealed its gates, only Haima's scholars dared venture outside. Seclusion is no way to foster discovery; it is only a convenient form of escape.
pieces.effect: Passive: None.

pieces.name: Battlemage Manchettes
pieces.desc: Manchettes worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and STR by 1.

pieces.name: Battlemage Legwraps
pieces.desc: Legwraps worn by scholars of the Raya Lucaria Academy, tattered from being worn on the battlefield.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases INT and STR by 1.

items.obtain: Dropped by the Battlemage north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path overlooking the plateau.

items.name: Blue Cloth Set
items.desc: The Blue Cloth Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Blue Cloth Cowl
pieces.desc: Cowl of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1.

pieces.name: Blue Cloth Vest
pieces.desc: Vest of a nomadic warrior. The blue color of its fabric symbolizes brisk waters, as fluid and flowing as the sword in the hand of its wearer. Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases DEX and END by 4 and increases stamina recovery by 2.

pieces.name: Warrior Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1.

pieces.name: Warrior Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of a nomadic warrior. Crafted from sturdy leather.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases DEX and END by 2 and increases stamina recovery by 1.

items.obtain: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Liurnia.

items.name: Chain Set
items.desc: The Chain Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Chain Coif
pieces.desc: Coif made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Chain Armor
pieces.desc: Armor made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, it offers dependable protection.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 2 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Chain Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets worn by ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

pieces.name: Chain Leggings
pieces.desc: Leggings made of woven chain. Standard issue for ordinary soldiers. Though plain in appearance, they offer dependable protection.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR and DEX by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 1%.

items.obtain: Sold by Kale in Limgrave.

items.name: Champion Set
items.desc: The Champion Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Champion Headband
pieces.desc: Headband reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases END by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Champion Pauldron
pieces.desc: Pauldron reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases END by 2 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 4%.

pieces.name: Champion Bracers
pieces.desc: Bracers reserved for the badlands' bravest. Proof that the wearer has slaughtered countless foes. Following the example of their chieftain Hoarah Loux, the brave warriors of the badlands shun excess adornment.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases END by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

pieces.name: Champion Gaiters
pieces.desc: Gaiters formed only with leather straps. Common wear in the badlands.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases END by 1 and reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.

items.obtain: Bottom of Fort Gael in a small room past the man throwing fire bombs.

items.name: Commoner Soldier's Set
items.desc: The Commoner Soldier Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Common Soldier Helm
pieces.desc: Helm of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 1.

pieces.name: Cloth Armor
pieces.desc: Cloth armor of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 2.

pieces.name: Common Soldier Gauntlets
pieces.desc: Gauntlets of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 1.

pieces.name: Common Soldier Greaves
pieces.desc: Greaves of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army. A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases STR, DEX and END by 1.

items.obtain: TBD

items.name: Commoner's Set
items.desc: The Commoner's Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Commoner's Headband
pieces.desc: A headband that holds cloth in place. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

pieces.name: Commoner's Garb
pieces.desc: Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 4%.

pieces.name: Commoner's Shoes
pieces.desc: Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between. Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1 and reduces FP cost of incantations by 2%.

items.obtain: TBD

items.name: Confessor Set
items.desc: The Confessor Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Confessor Hood
pieces.desc: Black hood for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1, increases casting speed by 2 and increases critical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Confessor Armor
pieces.desc: Black leather armor for blending in with the darkness. Worn by church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 2, increases casting speed by 4 and increases critical damage by 4%.

pieces.name: Confessor Gloves
pieces.desc: Black leather gloves of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1, increases casting speed by 2 and increases critical damage by 2%.

pieces.name: Confessor Boots
pieces.desc: Leather boots of the church confessors. The churches outside the Lands Between, dedicated to the teachings of the Two Fingers, send confessors out to follow the guidance of grace. The confessors are loyal servants to the Two Fingers, ready to hunt down and quietly dispose of their enemies.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases FTH by 1, increases casting speed by 2 and increases critical damage by 2%.

items.obtain: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant in Mt. Gelmir.

items.name: Duelist Set
items.desc: The Duelist Set is a Tier 1 armor set.

pieces.name: Duelist Helm
pieces.desc: Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes. The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases END and VIG by 1.

pieces.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
pieces.desc: Thick, bristly cloak that is the symbol of an underground gravekeeper. Those who once fought for a living were driven from the colosseum, and becoming guardians of Erdtree Burial.
pieces.effect: Passive: Increases END and VIG by 2.

pieces.name: Duelist Greaves
