items.name: Clayman Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two claymen.
items.fx: Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.
items.obtain: Ainsel River, Ainsel River Minor Erdtree – Found on a corpse sitting close to the edge of the waterfall.

items.name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer.
items.fx: Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown. A scholar of the Olivinus Conspectus, who has mastered the use of the Glintstone Stars sorcery.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Road's End Catacombs – Obtained by defeating the Spiritcaller Snail at the end of the catacombs.

items.name: Land Squirt Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.
items.fx:
These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings.

Notes
Despite limited mobility, this Spirit Summon can draw aggro off the player and inflict poison buildup upon the enemy.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Gate Town Bridge – Found on a corpse slumped against a gravestone and surrounded by numerous Land Squirts, north of the Site of Grace. -300x300

items.name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts.
items.fx:
Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire—do take care of the little darlings.

Notes
Despite limited mobility, this Spirit Summon can draw aggro off the player and inflict poison buildup upon the enemy.
items.obtain: Weeping Peninsula, Tombsward Cave – Obtained by defeating Miranda the Blighted Bloom at the end of the cave.

items.name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a noble sorcerer.
items.fx:
Spirit of a nobleman who once asked to be given a place at Raya Lucaria to learn glintstone sorceries. His talents were insufficient to be worthy of donning the stone crown, however, and he is only capable of using the most rudimentary sorcery.

Notes
This spirit summon is capable of ranged combat is best used in a supporting role.
items.obtain: Limgrave, Stormfoot Catacombs – Obtained by defeating the Erdtree Burial Watchdog at the end of the catacombs.

items.name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a skeletal bandit.
items.fx:
This is the spirit of a bandit who lives in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off. After the night of the plot, Deathroot appeared in the Lands Between, and Those Who Live in Death soon followed.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is quite aggressive and can revive itself upon being defeated.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Artist's Shack – Obtained by defeating the Tibia Mariner south of the Artist's Shack.

items.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit jellyfish.
items.fx:
A floating spirit that illuminates its surroundings. Prone to tears, the jellyfish girl searches for her distant home. Will bravely spew poison at foes on her summoner's behalf. It seems her name is Aurelia.

Notes
This Spirit summon is able to attack from a greater range and is able to inflict poison buildup upon the enemy.
items.obtain: Limgrave, Stormhill Shack – Given to the Player by Roderika upon talking to her. Alternatively, if the Player has a site of grace in Liurnia unlocked, Roderika will move to the Roundtable Hold.

items.name: Wandering Noble Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles.
items.fx:
The spirits of nobles who, after death, now wander the Lands Between. Surely they were in search of something once—but whatever it was has long been forgotten.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is great at drawing aggro off the player, as it summons five spirits. They are capable of swarming a singular enemy but cannot take much damage.
items.obtain: Limgrave, Stormfoot Catacombs – Found on a corpse sitting against a coffin in the upper levels of the catacombs.

items.name: Page Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a page.
items.fx:
Spirit of a page who traveled at the side of the noble he served. Uses a piercing sword and crossbow to defend his master. One becomes a page merely by accident of being born into obscurity; nothing is asked of ability, talent, or volition.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very mobile and capable of both close and ranged combat.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Cliffbottom Catacombs – Found on an altar, guarded by a Banished Knight.

items.name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses.
items.fx:
These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. Though their movements are dull and confused, their low moans make them effective at drawing the attention of enemies. True death does not come easily for them.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is great at drawing aggro off the player. The Four Spirits summoned are also capable of taking a substantial amount of damage before dying.
items.obtain: Caelid, Gaol Cave – Obtained by defeating the Frenzied Troll at the end of the cave.

items.name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars.
items.fx:
These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire. "Tell the others—tell them how brightly a fire jar burns."

Notes
This Spirit Summon is great in a supporting role; upon reaching low health, the jars will detonate and cause a great amount of damage. With the ability to resummon, this spirit is quite useful.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Auriza Side Tomb – Obtained by defeating the Grave Warden Duelist.

items.name: Spider Scorpion Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two spider scorpion spirits.
items.fx:
These scorpions are larger than a human, and attack with pincers and a poisonous tail. Appear some distance from the summoner. This breed of scorpions was native to the realm of shadow, but was far smaller in size. Recent giant scorpions are said to trace back to the Church of the Bud.

Notes
Unlike vanilla, two spider scorpions are summoned upon use.
items.obtain: Rauh Ruins – From the Viaduct Minor Tower Site of Grace, progress until you reach a closed door. Open it, head down two sets of stairs, and enter a bolthole leading to a sand-filled room. Take two lefts, follow the left wall while dodging spiders, and find the ashes on a corpse below a large spider scorpion.

items.name: Ancestral Follower Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of an ancestral follower.
items.fx:
A spirit of the horned folk who eschew letters and metalworking. Brawny, and versed in distinctive spiritual arts, this particular tribesman wields a heavy bow.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very aggressive in close combat but will most likely stick to precise ranged attacks.
items.obtain: Siofra River – Sold by the Siofra River Abandoned Merchant for 1,000 Runes.

items.name: Archer Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon three archer spirits.
items.fx:
Spirits of archers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City. Their arrows are imbued with cold ghostflame. They work well as a squadron, firing a hail of arrows in unison at the sound of a war cry.

Notes
Capable of inflicting Frostbite buildup upon an enemy with ranged attacks.
items.obtain: Nokstella, Eternal City – Found on a corpse hidden in the corner behind a building.

items.name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Godrick's soldiers.
items.fx:
A duo of spirits, consisting of a wielder of devastating charged hammer attacks in the vanguard and a crossbowman bringing up the rear.

Notes
Capable of both close and ranged combat, with each soldier likely sticking to one of the two combat styles.
items.obtain: Limgrave, Stormhill – Found on a corpse resting against a tombstone in the graveyard south of Stormveil Castle.

items.name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers.
items.fx:
Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield. The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively.

Notes
Specializes in defense. Both Soldiers are equipped with greatshields and spears.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Sainted Hero's Grave – Found on a corpse close to a collapsing floor trap.

items.name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two marionette soldiers.
items.fx:
Spirits of marionette soldiers created to serve a sorcerer. These marionettes are archers, each equipped with a pair of bows.

Notes
Capable of ranged attacks; best used as support.
items.obtain: Raya Lucaria, Church of the Cuckoo – Found on a corpse guarded by a Twinsage Sorcerer. Cross the hanging bridge and jump to a lower platform to access.

items.name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three Raya Lucaria soldiers.
items.fx:
A trio of spirits, consisting of two disposable foot soldiers and their superior. They were known as the Cuckoos, infamous for their rapacious ways.

Notes
Capable of both close and ranged combat. The Foot Soldiers attack in close quarters while the Cuckoo Soldier assists with a crossbow.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Road's End Catacombs – Found in a chest behind an illusory wall on the third level.

items.name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen.
items.fx:
These are the spirits of militiamen who live in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off.

Notes
Aggressive in close combat; both militiamen are capable of reviving themselves.
items.obtain: Limgrave, Summonwater Village – Obtained from defeating the Tibia Mariner.

items.name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer.
items.fx:
Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown. Those who study the Twinsage Conspectus are the academy's elite, capable of mastering the Glintstone Cometshard and Crystal Burst sorceries.

Notes
Capable of ranged attacks and will use sorceries to damage enemies. Best used as ranged support, but can do serious damage up close with Crystal Burst.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Black-Knife Catacombs – Obtained by defeating the Cemetary Shade.

items.name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen.
items.fx:
Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss.

Notes
Very aggressive in close combat and can inflict blood loss buildup upon the enemy.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Auriza Hero's Grave – Found on a corpse guarded by several Basilisks.

items.name: Rootmen Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Rootmen.
items.fx:
Notes
Rootmen compensate their lack of agility with durability and a good stagger potential, especially against humanoid enemies.
items.obtain: Lower Siofra River – Found on a corpse south from the Dragonkin Soldier.

items.name: Battlemage Hugues
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Battlemage Hugues.
items.fx:
Hugues came from Sellia to study the Haima Conspectus at the academy, where he became a battlemage. Haima scholars seek to quell conflict with cannon fire and the gavel, but Hugues developed a longing for it.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very aggressive in close combat and has access to a long-range attack.
items.obtain: Caelid, Sellia Evergaol – Obtained by defeating Battlemage Hugues.

items.name: Fire Monk Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fire Monk.
items.fx:
Spirit of a stout monk who monitored the Giants' Flame. Versed in fire incantations, and himself steeled against fire. Though he was charged with keeping watch over the Flame, after many years of solemn duty, he has succumbed to its allure.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very aggressive in close combat.
items.obtain: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs – After descending the first elevator, activate it and jump off to lift up the secret elevator. The ashes are in a chest at the end of the sub-area, guarded by a Watchdog.

items.name: Kindred of Rot Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot.
items.fx:
This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads. The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is capable of both close and ranged combat.
items.obtain: Seethewater Cave – Obtained by defeating the Kindred of Rot.

items.name: Stone Cluster Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Stone Clusters.
items.fx:
Notes
Stone Clusters are immobile and explode once, dealing massive damage to enemies. Better used against large and low-mobility targets.
items.obtain: Caelid Ravine – From the Inner Aeonia Site of Grace, head north until you find stone clusters. The ashes are at the end of the crevice.

items.name: Red Bear Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of two red bears.
items.fx:
Notes
A good summon for crowd control, especially against humanoid enemies.
items.obtain: Rauh Base – Found on a mound of rock, near Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

items.name: Mystic Pigmen Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of four mystic pigmen.
items.fx:
Notes
Pigmen act as jack-of-all-trades summons, with various armaments. Can also inflict sleep buildup.
items.obtain: Upper Siofra River – Found on a corpse near Hallowhorn Grounds, guarded by a mix of pigmen and rootmen.

items.name: Man-Fly Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three man-flies.
items.fx:
Two of the man-flies attack foes from the air, while the third spits poison from the rear. Afflicted hornsent eventually metamorphosed into a fly-like form. It was believed that the moment the transformation took place, they were relieved from their suffering.

Notes
The Man-Flies are good at disrupting foes, even staggering humanoid ones. Can inflict poison buildup.
items.obtain: Village of Flies – From the Recluses River Downstream site of grace, progress down the path until you find an intersection. Go right, then up. The ashes are on a pile of corpses, guarded by several enemies.

items.name: Giant Rat Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats.
items.fx:
Spirits that do not require FP to summon. The rat spirits appear at a distance from the summoner, swarming upon their victim to start the fight. Even as spirits, these vermin seem to multiply endlessly.

Notes
Summons more rats with reinforcement level. At +5, the ashes will summon 4 giant rats. At +10, 5 rats will be summoned.
items.obtain: Altus, Windmill Pasture – Obtained in a stable filled with rats.

items.name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Haligtree soldiers.
items.fx:
Spirits of common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack. May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.

Notes
- Can throw poison pots.
- Will use a last-ditch kamikaze attack when below half-health.
items.obtain: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree – Found under a large chalice in the northern part of the city, north of the "Elphael Inner Wall" site of grace.

items.name: Jarwright Puppet
items.desc: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of a jarwight.
items.fx:
Spirit of a man who wished to become the innards of a living jar. A jar-hurling specialist who throws all manner of pots and jars.

Notes
Ranged summon that throws a variety of pots, including ones with useful effects like freezing and poison pots.
items.obtain: Three Sisters – Bought from Seluvis's body after the end of Ranni's questline, or an option for the free puppet provided after discovering his secret room.

items.name: Mad Pumpkinhead Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head.
items.fx:
Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.

Notes
Very tanky against enemies that don't move around much.
items.obtain: Minor Erdtree Catacombs – Dropped by the Burial Watchdog Duo.

items.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon three winged misbegotten spirits.
items.fx:
Spirits with the aspect of wings which take flight to loose arrows from their bows. The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible.

Notes
Three flying ranged ash summons. Can distract enemies for short periods of time.
items.obtain: Unsightly Catacombs – Found in a pit of corpses near the end of the dungeon.

items.name: Starcaller Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of two Starcallers.
items.fx:
Notes
Starcallers are quite weak but possess a wide array of gravity attacks and magic.
items.obtain: Sellia Crystal Tunnel – After defeating the boss, progress through the newly opened passage until you find a room with teleporting Starcallers. The ashes are on a corpse behind the palisade.

items.name: Bloodthorn Exile Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of three bloodthorn exiles.
items.fx:
Notes
Bloodthorn Exiles excel at launching attacks from a distance. Can also cause blood loss buildup.
items.obtain: Mountaintop of the Giants, Guardian's Garrison – Found on a corpse between the second flights of stairs.

items.name: Gravebird Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Gravebird.
items.fx:
The spirit of an old golem and spiritgrave keeper, who flies with stone wings and spouts ghostflame. According to legend, the Gravebirds were crafted to be kindred to the Deathbirds.

Notes
The Gravebird is a relentless melee and ranged attacker, yet quite susceptible to stagger. Can inflict frostbite buildup.
items.obtain: Charro's Hidden Grave – Found on a corpse sitting next to a pile of graves, on the westernmost side of the area, past the spiritspring.

items.name: Fingercreeper Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Fingercreeper.
items.fx:
Devoted to its summoner, this young, diminutive Fingercreeper eagerly restores HP. They are ever so fond of their mothers at this tender age.

Notes
The Fingercreeper is a somewhat weak melee attacker. Their strength resides in their ability to restore one's HP.
items.obtain: Finger Ruins of Dheo – From the Fingerstone Hill site of grace, progress east until you find a large group of Fingercreepers, then seek an opening in the ground. The ashes are on a corpse in the cave, guarded by a Colossal Fingercreeper.

items.name: Albinauric Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Albinaurics.
items.fx:
A strapping duo of cartwheeling spirits who wield ripple swords and spew freezing breath. Both are second-generation Albinaurics, with dumpy heads that resemble those of frogs.

Notes
Can proc frost with their breath attacks.
items.obtain: Caria Manor – Found on a corpse in a graveyard east of the manor.

items.name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers.
items.fx:
Spirits of marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer. Equipped with long-hafted scythes, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged.

Notes
- Throws fire pots occasionally.
- Malfunctions after taking sufficient damage, very quickly building bleed on enemies nearby with rapid attacks.
items.obtain: Raya Lucaria Academy, Great Water Wheel – Located on a corpse in a graveyard reached by dropping down near the waterwheel.

items.name: Demi-Human Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans.
items.fx:
Spirits of demi-humans that are small in stature, but have a violent, brutish disposition. Though they seem somewhat intelligent, when night falls, their blood boils and they become feral.

Notes
They turn feral at night, becoming stronger.
items.obtain: Weeping Peninsula, Tombsward Catacombs – Obtained from the Cemetery Shade after defeating it.

items.name: Fanged Imp Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.
items.fx:
These spirits are well suited to causing a disturbance, moving nimbly like pests and hurling magic pots. The two imps seem fond of each other's company.

Notes
Can build bleed with their attacks and throw magic pots at range.
items.obtain: * Liurnia – Purchased from the Isolated Merchant for 2,000 runes. * Can be chosen as a starting keepsake.

items.name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword.
items.fx:
Spirit of a mercenary belonging to a horse-riding folk. Skillfully uses a massive blade made for dismounting other riders, and enhances his already considerable strength with war cries.

Notes
Aggressive melee summon with high damage, but is easily overwhelmed by enemy pressure.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Cliffbottom Catacombs – Dropped by Stormcaller Taran.

items.name: Lone Wolf Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves.
items.fx:
Spirits of wolves chased from their pack. They later encountered a nameless Tarnished, who welcomed them as hunting companions. The wolf spirits overwhelm enemies with their agility.

Notes
Deals good damage when they can survive for a decent amount of time.
items.obtain: * Limgrave, Church of Elleh – Given by "Renna" during her encounter. * Roundtable Hold – Bought from Twin Maiden Husks if the "Renna" encounter is missed.

items.name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Radahn's soldiers.
items.fx:
Both spirits wield fiery weapons to perform powerful skills. Such is their valor that they will immediately attack after being summoned.

Notes
The greatsword soldier deals very high poise damage with his weapon art, creating plenty of openings on lighter bosses especially.
items.obtain: Caelid, War-Dead Catacombs – In a room near the boss gate lever, guarded by a spectral cleanrot knight.

items.name: Redmane Knight Ogha
items.desc: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Ogha, the Redmane Knight.
items.fx:
Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned. Ogha studied gravity techniques alongside Radahn.

Notes
- Does great damage from long range with his greatbow.
- Will use a war cry to buff self-damage in response to any roar skill (War Cry, Barbaric Roar, etc.).
- Will use a rain of arrows weapon skill once per summon in response to the same.
items.obtain: Caelid, War-Dead Catacombs – Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit.

items.name: Warhawk Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk.
items.fx:
Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place.

Notes
A flying summon that is decent at drawing enemy aggro. Its three-dimensional movement axis makes it surprisingly hard to hit for most enemies.
items.obtain: Weeping Peninsula, Church of Pilgrimage – Reward for finding the artist of the "Prophecy" painting, located north of the Church of Pilgrimage at the northern tip of the peninsula.

items.name: Fire Knight Hilde
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Hilde.
items.fx:
A spirit who belonged to the Fire Knights; an order which answers directly to Messmer. Hilde swings a slender greatsword and casts fire incantations.

Notes
Fire Knight Hilde is a mostly melee attacker, with some fire spells at their disposal.
items.obtain: Shadow Keep, Specimen Storehouse – From the Storehouse, Loft site of grace, take the elevator to the rooftops and progress until you find a fire knight. Bring down the elevator, do the same for the one that went up, drop on top of the first elevator, then jump onto the ledge to find the ashes.

items.name: Crystalian Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian.
items.fx:
Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is great at defense, as it takes very low damage until its poise is broken.
items.obtain: Caelid, Sellia Hideaway – Found in a chest guarded by three Mages. Access by jumping on three consecutive crystals after the Stake of Marika to reach a hole in the wall.

items.name: Man-Serpent Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent.
items.fx:
Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma. It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is good at crowd-control, as it leaves puddles of magma when attacking with its whip.
items.obtain: Volcano Manor, Prison Town Church – Found on a corpse sitting in a dark cell, just up ahead from the burning pile of corpses.

items.name: Nomad Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a nomad.
items.fx:
A member of a tribe that was entombed in the earth so as to bury the maddening disease that followed them. Able to emit the terrible flame of frenzy from his eyes, but has low HP and is frail, unable to take much in the way of punishment.

Notes
This Spirit Summon provides a source of madness buildup through the use of the tendrils it releases from range.
items.obtain: Weeping Peninsula, Impaler's Catacombs – Dropped by the Frenzied Burial Watchdog.

items.name: Rotten Stray Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray.
items.fx:
Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot. Though it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is great at inflicting Scarlet Rot upon an enemy, as it is very aggressive and every attack will inflict buildup.
items.obtain: Caelid, Sellia Under-Stair – Found on a corpse slumped against a collapsed wall, north of the site of grace.

items.name: Erdtree Guardian Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of two Erdtree Guardians.
items.fx:
Notes
- Erdtree Guardians are very aggressive at close range and can inflict poison buildup.
- At 50% health, they fully heal and change moveset, sacrificing swiftness for an enormous stagger potential.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Minor Erdtree Church – Obtained after defeating the Erdtree Sentry.

items.name: Black Knight Captain Huw
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Huw, Knight-Captain of the Black Knights.
items.fx:
Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned. The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Second to their first Knight-Commander was Huw, a man with agile command of both twinblade techniques and the powers of the Crucible.

Notes
- Black Knight Captain Huw is a swift melee attacker with low susceptibility to stagger.
- Can also use some Crucible incantations.
items.obtain: Scorpion River Catacombs – Progress through the dungeon until finding a room with roof traps. Head right to find the ashes guarded by a Black Knight.

items.name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Floh, the Bloodhound Knight.
items.fx:
Spirit of a Bloodhound Knight they called the Rabid Stray. Will attack without pause immediately after being summoned. Floh vowed that there was only one lord he would serve: a true king. And so, the Rabid Stray never found a master.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very agile, but fragile and can inflict bleed buildup upon the enemy.
items.obtain: Limgrave, Cave of Knowledge – Obtained by defeating Bloodhound Knight Gethin at the end of the cave.

items.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay
items.desc: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of the Cleanrot Knight Finlay.
items.fx:
Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable act of heroism carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree. She managed the feat alone, fending off all manner of foes along the way.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is quite aggressive and capable of inflicting poison and scarlet rot buildup.
items.obtain: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree – Found in a chest near a covered coffin across a bridge, southeast of the "Drainage Channel" site of grace.

items.name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer.
items.fx:
Depraved perfumers practice their art for themselves alone. Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is aggressive and can inflict poison buildup upon an enemy. It is also capable of healing itself.
items.obtain: Volcano Manor – Found on a corpse in the hidden section. Walk through the illusory wall inside the drawing-room, keep left on the hidden walkway, and open the final illusory wall to access the item.

items.name: Omenkiller Rollo
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Omenkiller Rollo.
items.fx:
Spirit of Rollo, known as the first Omenkiller. Once a famous perfumer, Rollo imbibed a physick to rid himself of emotion, thus enabling him to enact his nightmarish labor, hunting the Omen.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is incredibly aggressive and capable of inflicting bleed buildup.
items.obtain: Leyndell, Royal Capital, Divine Tower of East Altus – Obtained by defeating the Fell Twins.

items.name: Bigmouth Imp Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a large-mouthed imp.
items.fx:
The spirit of this old imp, said to be fashioned after a dragon, has a big mouth that serves as a cannon and allows it to fire shells from the rear of the battlefield.

Notes
A great ranged attacker with slow but devastating attacks. Has huge stagger potential if left undisturbed.
items.obtain: Darklight Catacombs – Progress to the second lower floor. In the room with the giant imp, head left to find a lever. Return to the lowered platform and head straight to the room below containing a chest.

items.name: Curseblade Meera
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Curseblade Meera. Attacks immediately after being summoned.
items.fx:
Curseblades appear to dance when they spin their shimmering circular blades. It was during her confinement that Meera met Labirith, and upon her death, Labirith was plunged into a devastating darkness.

Notes
- A relentless melee attacker.
- Can inflict blood loss buildup.
items.obtain: Bonny Gaol – Obtained by defeating Curseblade Labirith.

items.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán.
items.fx:
Spirit of a swordhand granted light by the Iris of Grace. Wields a sword of bottomless black that penetrates the enemy's guard.

Notes
A fast but frail melee attacker. Can inflict blood loss buildup.
items.obtain: Cathedral of Manus Metyr – After completing Count Ymir's questline, find Jolán slouched at the foot of the pillar. Use an Iris of Grace on her to receive the ashes.

items.name: Fire Knight Queelign
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Queelign. Attacks immediately after being summoned.
items.fx:
Spirit of a knight granted relief by the Iris of Grace. Wields a spear-like greatsword that impales foes upon fire, keeping the taint of impurity away from fair mother Marika.

Notes
A very aggressive summon which uses melee and Messmerfire spells alike.
items.obtain: Shadow Keep, Church District – After defeating him as an invader twice, find his body in the Prayer Room. Use the Prayer Room Key on the locked door (found in the Church District roofs), then use an Iris of Grace on his body.

items.name: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff
items.desc: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Kristoff, the Ancient Dragon Knight.
items.fx:
Spirit of Kristoff, an honorable knight of Leyndell who was also a devout worshipper of the ancient dragons. His skills strike down foes with thunderbolts, the dragons' weapon of choice. After the First Defense of Leyndell, Kristoff earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial for the feat of capturing Godefroy the Grafted.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is a good all-rounder, and can utilize close range attacks, long range attacks, and guard with a greatshield.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Sainted Hero's Grave – Dropped from the Ancient Hero of Zamor.

items.name: Azula Beastman Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two Azula beastmen.
items.fx:
Spirits of beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.

Notes
These Spirit Ashes are a duo and are aggressive at close range.
items.obtain: Crumbling Farum Azula – Found on a sarcophagus guarded by beastmen west of the "Dragon Temple Transept" site of grace.

items.name: Blackflame Monk Amon
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Amon, the Blackflame Monk.
items.fx:
Amon swore fealty to the god-slaying black flame, and so became the first fire monk to turn traitor. Or perhaps it is better said that he fled from the Giants' Flame—out of cowardice.

Notes
This Spirit Ash is very aggressive and inflicts soul burn with his black flame attacks.
items.obtain: Consecrated Snowfields, Hidden Path to the Haligtree – Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear.

items.name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
items.desc: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux.
items.fx:
Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very aggressive.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Caria Manor – Obtained from Pidia after he is killed by his puppets, provided Nepheli has drunk Seluvis's Potion. You must progress Nepheli’s quest to the Roundtable, talk to Gideon about her despair, then progress Ranni's quest to kill Pidia.

items.name: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets
items.desc: An old puppet crafted in the Eternal City. Use to summon the spirits of a nightmaiden and a swordstress.
items.fx:
These sisters, members of a cold-blooded race who wield flowing weapons, became puppets of their own volition.

Notes
Aggressive, but stagger easily. The swordstress can attack from range with the Nox Flowing Sword and the Nightmaiden can cast life-sapping silver mist.
items.obtain: Nokstella, Eternal City – Found in a chest on the upper floors. After reaching the greatbridge, wrap around the back of the building and enter through the doorway.

items.name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of four Oracle Envoys.
items.fx:
Spirits of a monstrous band of musicians who employ sacred arts. It is said that when Oracle Envoys appear, playing their pipes, they do so to herald the arrival of a new god, or a new age.

Notes
These Spirit Ashes are useful as long-range attackers.
items.obtain: Miquella's Haligtree – Found on a corpse where a branch meets the trunk of the Haligtree, guarded by a Giant and Large Oracle Envoy.

items.name: Winged Dame Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Winged Dame.
items.fx:
Notes
An aggressive ranged attacker, using primarily glintstone and rancor attacks, as well as grabs. Can inflict frostbite buildup through rancor spells.
items.obtain: Liurnia, Ruin-Strewn Precipice – Found on a corpse left from the ladder guarded by a winged dame.

items.name: Stone Sentry Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Stone Sentry.
items.fx:
Notes
Provides heavy ranged support. However, it is immobile, so plan your positioning accordingly.
items.obtain: Stone Coffin Fissure – Found on a stone coffin, right after the Leonine Misbegotten.

items.name: Messmer Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two of Messmer's soldiers.
items.fx:
One soldier wields an axe, while the other wields a spear. Both of them are adept at charge attacks. These soldiers belonged to the ignoble penal battalion, and were buried hidden from the Scadutree's sight.

Notes
Powerful melee attackers. The axe-wielding soldier can buff himself, unlocking a new moveset.
items.obtain: Fort of Reprimand – Head left of the gallows to find a chute. Continue down that path to find the ashes against a grave, outside of the fort.

items.name: Black Knight Commander Andreas
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Andreas, Knight-Commander of the Black Knights.
items.fx:
The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Their first leader was Andreas, a man endowed with great strength and command over the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells.

Notes
A durable melee attacker, who can also use holy-infused and Crucible moves.
items.obtain: Fog Rift Catacombs – Progress through the dungeon until the room with the falling spike trap. Go on top of the spike trap and across to the other side, then through the hallway on the left. Continue on through the next room, cross the walkway and proceed up the stairs and into the room with the Headless Marika Statue and chest containing Nia's Passot. Behind the statue to the right is an interactable tablet that reads "Have mercy. For the spirited-away shamans." Use the O Mother gesture obtained in Bonny Village and a ladder will appear. Go up the ladder and into the room on the left to find Black Knight Commander Andreas.

items.name: Horned Warrior Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a horned warrior.
items.fx:
This heavily-armored guardian spirit of the tower attained inhuman strength through divine invocation, and wields a curved greatsword that brings horns to bear on its foes.

Notes
Strong melee attacker. They excel at staggering enemies, while having low to no stagger susceptibility themselves.
items.obtain: Enir-Ilim, Spiral Rise – Found on a corpse inside a dimly lit room. To access, continue upwards from the site of grace until ambushed by Gravebirds, then jump off the staircase onto a second staircase below.

items.name: Banished Knight Oleg (Spirit)
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Oleg, the Banished Knight.
items.fx:
Banished Knight Oleg
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Oleg, the Banished Knight.

One of the two knights known as the Wings of the Storm. After his banishment, he attracted the notice of the Grace-Given Lord and later, having slain a hundred traitors as the Lord's hand, Oleg earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very aggressive in close combat, and can quickly close distance with his stormcalling attacks.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Golden Lineage Evergaol – Obtained by defeating Banished Knight Oleg.

items.name: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
items.desc: One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow.
items.fx:
Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow. Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold and was a friend to Gideon. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.

Notes
This Spirit Ash is effective at applying the sleep status effect.
items.obtain: Three Sisters, Seluvis's Rise – Bought from Preceptor Seluvis for Starlight Shards, or given free after giving "Seluvis's Potion" to Nepheli Loux (following specific quest progression).

items.name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits.
items.fx:
Spirits of greatshield soldiers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City. Stout defenders with a steady guard. They work well as a squadron, and will attract the attention of enemies or lob ghostflame from the rearguard.

Notes
This Spirit Ash has extraordinary survival power and aggro capability, as well as the ability to apply frostbite.
items.obtain: Nokron, Siofra River Well Depths – Found on a corpse inside a gated garden, reached by heading east from the Nokron transporter grace and bearing right before the first set of stairs.

items.name: Cemetery Shade Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Cemetery Shade.
items.fx:
Notes
The Cemetery Shade is an overly aggressive and elusive melee attacker. Can inflict blood loss buildup.
items.obtain: Caelid Catacombs – Obtained after defeating the Cemetery Shade.

items.name: Catacomb Sorcerer Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Catacomb Sorcerer.
items.fx:
Notes
The Catacomb Sorcerer is a frail but aggressive ranged caster.
items.obtain: Scorpion River Catacombs – From the second floor, progress until you find a bridge with wandering death eyes. Drop down, climb the ladder, and find the ashes on a corpse after a tight corridor, guarded by an imp and a sorcerer.

items.name: Wormface Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Wormface.
items.fx:
Notes
The Wormface is an aggressive melee attacker. Can cause deathblight buildup.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau – Obtained by defeating the Wormface guarding the Central Altus Minor Erdtree teleporter.

items.name: Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a bloodfiend hexer.
items.fx:
This spirit conducts bloodboon rituals with a sacred spear, casts bloodflame hexes, and takes a singular pleasure in letting the blood of foes. Long ago, a subjugated tribe discovered a twisted deity and were transformed into bloodfiends.

Notes
A somewhat frail caster which uses Bloodflame incantations. Can inflict blood loss buildup.
items.obtain: Rivermouth Cave – Obtained by defeating the Chief Bloodfiend.

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ornis the divine bird warrior.
items.fx:
Spirit of the divine bird warrior from whom the horned warriors claim descent. Clad in golden armor, and granted wings and feathers by divine invocation. Ornis succeeded in taming the divine bird and made its wings his own.

Notes
Relentless melee attacker, who can also use some Crucible incantations.
items.obtain: Temple Town Ruins – From the site of grace, head north and up the hill to find a spiritspring. Use it to reach the ledge in the mountain wall facing the ruins; the ashes are in a chest in a small building ahead.

items.name: Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Yosh, the demi-human swordsman.
items.fx:
Yosh was an apprentice who absorbed the technique of master Onze. He stubbornly refused to heed his master's words and spent his entire life at his side, in defiance of his master's self-imposed seclusion.

Notes
Incredibly swift melee attacker, capable of dodging most attacks. Can also use glintstone melee attacks.
items.obtain: Belurat Gaol – Obtained by defeating Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze.

items.name: Banished Knight Engvall
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Engvall, the Banished Knight.
items.fx:
One of the two knights dubbed the Wings of the Storm. Despite his banishment, he rejected the invitation of the Grace-Given Lord, instead keeping watch over a masterless castle for many years, gaining renown as a hero of the fringes.

Notes
This Spirit Summon is very aggressive in close combat, and can quickly close distance with his stormcalling attacks. Additionally, his Storm Assault can clear most ground attacks.
items.obtain: Stormveil Castle – Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit after defeating it in the secret passage under the castle, on the way to Godwyn's visage.

items.name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of five mausoleum soldiers.
items.fx:
Spirits of five headless soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will. The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.

Notes
This Spirit Ash has good survivability due to the number of summons and their ability to teleport.
items.obtain: Deeproot Depths – Found by a tree stump at the edge of a cliff, north of the walking mausoleum.

items.name: Perfumer Tricia
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Tricia, the perfumer.
items.fx:
Tricia was once known as a healer who dedicated her efforts to treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure. When her efforts failed, she was their companion as they died, watching over them to ensure that they could pass peacefully, free of pain.

Notes
This Spirit Ash has access to Uplifting Aromatics, which reduce incoming damage once and boosts attack. This effect applies to both the player and the summon.
items.obtain: Altus Plateau, Unsightly Catacombs – Dropped from the duo fight Perfumer Tricia and Misbegotten Warrior.

items.name: Rotten Duelist Verus
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Verus, Rotten Duelist.
items.fx:
Once a gladiator in the fighting pits of Caelid, Verus was admired by the Lord of Redmane, who had many times offered his patronage.

Notes
Verus is a sturdy melee attacker. Can inflict Rot buildup.
items.obtain: Fort Faroth – Obtained by defeating the Rotten Duelist at the top of the fort.

items.name: Spiritcaller Snail Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of a Spiritcaller Snail.
items.fx:
Notes
The Spiritcaller Snail calls forth three different snails to their aid, which can provide a bit of diversion.
items.obtain: Spiritcaller Cave – Obtained by defeating the Spiritcaller Snail boss.

items.name: Ancient Dragon Florissax
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax. Florissax assumed this spirit form to offer her service to a new lord.
items.fx:
Uses her own dragonbolt to increase all damage negation for herself and nearby allies. Strikes foes with the Flowerstone Gavel's dragonbolt to reduce enemy lightning damage negation.

Notes
Ancient Dragon Florissax is a powerful caster, capable of dealing tons of damage while buffing allies and debuffing foes alike.
items.obtain: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion – Obtained after completing the Dragon Communion Priestess questline (defeating Bayle the Dread).

items.name: Inquisitor Ashes
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two hornsent inquisitors.
items.fx:
The inquisitor hags wield barbed candlesticks. One of the inquisitors casts a tower hex to heal HP, while the hex of the other boosts her own attack power.

Notes
Inquisitor Ashes are more on the support side, providing healing and damage buffing.
items.obtain: Enir-Ilim, Spiral Rise – Found on a corpse in a room below the great staircase. Take the hidden stairs north of the Horned Shaman to access.

items.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
items.desc: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Finger Maiden Therolina.
items.fx:
Spirit of a Finger Maiden who never met the Tarnished she was meant to guide. Uses healing incantations and Holy Water Pots, but she is not a fighter by nature and is ill-suited to battle. A Maiden without a Tarnished. A Tarnished without a Maiden.

Notes
This Spirit Summon excels in a support role and uses healing incantations frequently.
items.obtain: Three Sisters, Seluvis's Rise – Bought from Preceptor Seluvis for starlight shards or given free as a choice after giving "Seluvis's Potion" to Nepheli Loux or Gideon. Requires discovering his secret room between Ranni and Renna's Rise.

items.name: Lhutel the Headless
items.desc: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless.
items.fx:
Spirit of a headless knight who leads the mausoleum soldiers. Wields a lance enrobed in Death and hurls spectral lances at foes. Lhutel sacrificed her life so that in Death she could continue to protect a soulless demigod, earning her the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.

Notes
This Spirit Summon has very good survivability and health, as well as the ability to teleport.
items.obtain: Deeproot Depths – Found by a tree stump at the edge of a cliff, north of the walking mausoleum.

items.name: Stormhawk Deenh
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk.
items.fx:
Spirit of a fierce hawk that faithfully rendered lifelong service to the old king of Stormveil long ago. Its cries embolden its fellows in battle, and the tempestuous winds that encircle it shred through foes.

Notes
Has great survivability due to its verticality. Additionally, it can boost attack with its warcry.
items.obtain: Chapel of Anticipation – Found in a chest accessed through the side door of the chapel, only accessible on a return visit via the Four Belfries.

items.name: Horned Omen Khata
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Khata, Horned Omen.
items.fx:
Friend of the royal brothers and born of nobility, Khata sought to unify the subterranean Omen as one people and one day ascend to the surface in rebellion.

Notes
Very aggressive summon, using a variety of melee and ranged attacks for a strong stagger potential against any foe.
items.obtain: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds – Obtained by defeating the Horned Omen right after the pipes filled with basilisks.

items.name: Zamor Knight Siddi
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Siddi, Knight of Zamor.
items.fx:
A great hero in the war against the giants, Siddi was sainted posthumously and honored with a grave at the foot of Leyndell.

Notes
Provides a large array of melee and ranged attacks, and can cause frostbite buildup.
items.obtain: Sainted Hero's Grave – Obtained by defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor.

items.name: Taylew the Golem Smith
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Taylew the golem smith.
items.fx:
The spirit of the stalwart stone golem who launches his own fists as projectiles. Taylew was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.

Notes
A formidable tank, sacrificing speed for durability and stagger potential.
items.obtain: Taylew's Ruined Forge – Obtained by interacting with the furnace at the end of the dungeon.

items.name: Black Knife Tiche
items.desc: Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Black Knife Tiche.
items.fx:
Tiche was one of the assassins who, on the night of the plot, imbued her black knife with the Rune of Death and slew Godwyn the Golden. She was the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader, Alecto, and was killed protecting her mother during their flight from the royal capital.

Notes
Very mobile, aggressive, and can reduce the enemy's maximum HP with her Black Knife.
items.obtain: Moonlight Altar, Ringleader's Evergaol – Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader after defeating her.

items.name: Dung Eater Puppet
items.desc: One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater.
items.fx:
Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses. The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end.

Notes
Very aggressive; can use the "Shriek of Milos" skill to decrease enemy defenses.
items.obtain: Three Sisters, Seluvis's Rise – Bought from Preceptor Seluvis for starlight shards after giving "Seluvis's Potion" to the Dung Eater (must be tied to a chair). Requires discovering his secret room in-between Ranni and Renna's Rise.

items.name: Latenna the Albinauric
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric.
items.fx:
A rare case of one who chose to become a spirit voluntarily. Latenna was renowned as a deft magic archer. Having lost her beloved wolf companion, Lobo, she cannot move from the place where she was summoned.

Notes
Excels in long-range support; unable to move once summoned.
items.obtain: Liurnia of the Lakes, Slumbering Wolf's Shack – Given by Latenna after exhausting Albus's dialogue in the Village of the Albinaurics.

items.name: Nox Ancestor Lasko
items.desc: Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Nox Ancestor Lasko.
items.fx:
Once a scholar of great renown at the height of the old empire, Lasko was among those who watched as the great black moon was shattered and all hope was lost for his people.

Notes

While the old masters' efforts ultimately fell short, such a technique would never be possible without their sacrifice
items.fx:
Anima Magica is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that increases Glint sorcery damage, and provides additional buffs after casting glint sorceries. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Glintstone Rune.

Each Glint sorcery cast increases the damage of Glint sorceries by 1%, stacking up to nine times.
On the tenth Glint sorcery cast, the previous effects are removed and you gain:
- 15% increased damage to Glint sorceries.
- 20% reduced FP cost of all sorceries.
- 10 FP regeneration per second.
- Additional poise.
- Lasts for 30 seconds.
- While this effect is active, you cannot gain the initial stacks.
This effect never expires, and can be toggled by recasting the spell.
Receives additioal effects when the Jewel of the Primeval is equipped:
- 25% reduced attack/spell stamina cost.
- 25% increased maximum equip load.
- On the tenth Glint sorcery cast, instantly restores 50% max FP, 50% max stamina, and increases casting speed by 20% for 30 seconds.
