items.name: Frozen Lightning Stake
items.fx:
Frozen Lightning Stake is a Sorcery that stabs with an ice lightning spear from above. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Dragonkin.

Direct hits deal 240 lightning damage, 90 stamina damage, 5 poise damage, and 90 frost buildup.
- Shockwave hits deal 307 lightning damage, 70 stamina damage, 5 poise damage, and 90 frost buildup.

items.name: Frozen Lightning Storm
items.fx:
Frozen Lightning Storm is a Sorcery that summons a number of frozen lightning bolts that strike from above and spread outwards. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of the Dragonkin.

- Uses 25 stamina.

items.name: Galvanic Barrier
items.fx: Galvanic Barrier is a Sorcery that conjures a barrier of sharp icicles and then shatter them. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Dragonkin.

items.name: Galvanic Icefang
items.fx: Galvanic Icefang is a Sorcery that launches a trail of frozen lightning along the ground that causes a spike to impale foes. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Dragonkin.

items.name: Great Bubble Volley
items.fx:
Great Bubble Volley is a Sorcery that produces several large frozen bubbles containing lightning. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Dragonkin.

- Uses 18 stamina.
- Each bubble deaths 185 lightning damage, 150 stamina damage, 10.175 poise damage, and 100 frost buildup.
- Charged attacks deal 185 lightning damage, 150 stamina damage, 18 poise damage, and 120 frost buildup.

items.name: Great Dragonkin Bubble
items.fx:
Great Dragonkin Bubble is a Sorcery that produces a gigantic bubble containing frozen lightning. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of the Dragonkin.

Deals 205 lightning damage, 150 stamina damage, 10.175 poise damage and 100 frost buildup.
- Charged attacks deal 220 lightning damage, 160 stamina damage, 18 poise damage and 120 frost buildup.

items.name: Maker's Lament
items.fx: Maker's Lament is a Sorcery that calls a massive bolt of frozen lightning and plunges it into the ground below. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Dragonkin.

items.name: Strength of the Underworld
items.fx:
Strength of the Underworld is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that increases weapon damage, reduces stamina consumption, and increases all absorptions, but reduces total FP and spell damage. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of the Dragonkin.

- Uses 20 stamina.
- Increases all weapon damage by 10%.
- Reduces weapon stamina consumption by 20%.
- Increases all absorptions by 20%.
- Reduces the FP cost of weapon skills by 50%.
- Reduces total FP by 50%.
- Reduces all spell damage by 20%.
- The effect never expires, recast the spell to toggle the effect.

items.name: Underworld Bubbleshield
items.fx:
Underworld Bubbleshield is a Sorcery and Signature Enchantment that covers your body with a single, large bubble containing frozen lightning. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Dragonkin.

- Uses 27 stamina.
- Increases all absorption by 75%
- Increases all lightning damage dealt by 5%.
- The effect ends after 1 minute or after being hit 1 time.
- When the effect ends, the bubble will burst against nearby enemies.
  - Deals 220 lightning damage, 160 stamina damage, 18 poise damage, and 120 frost buildup.

items.name: Wisdom of the Makers
items.fx:
Wisdom of the Makers is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that increases FP, adds additional FP regeneration, and increases spell damage, but reduces total HP and decreases weapon damage. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of the Dragonkin.

- Uses 20 stamina.
- Increases total FP by 20%.
- Adds 2 FP regeneration per second.
- Increases spell damage by 10%.
- Reduces total HP by 30%.
- Decreases all weapon damage by 50%.
- The effect never expires, recast the spell to toggle the effect.

items.name: Annealed Slag
items.fx: Annealed Slag is a Sorcery that hurls molten metal at an enemy which sticks to them and drips lava at their feet. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Magma.

items.name: Blasphemer's Outrage
items.fx:
Blasphemer's Outrage is a Sorcery and Offensive Enchantment that increases weapon damage and reduces weapon stamina cost, but lowers defenses. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Magma.

- Uses 15 stamina.
- Increases all weapon damage by 10%.
- Reduces weapon stamina cost by 2%.
- Lowers all defenses by 20%.
- Effect lasts for 2 minutes.

items.name: Burning Rancor
items.fx:
Burning Rancor is a Sorcery that summons a swarm of burning spirits that seek out foes and explode on impact. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Magma.

- Uses 12 stamina.

items.name: Embrace the Devourer
items.fx:
Embrace the Devourer is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that adds additional HP, FP, SP, and damage each time an enemy dies, up to 10 times. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Magma.

- Uses 30 stamina.
- Each time an enemy is killed
- Adds 1% HP.
- Adds 1% FP.
- Adds 1% SP.
- Adds 1% damage
- This stacks up to 10 times.
- The effect never expires, recast the spell to toggle the effect.

items.name: Familial Consumption
items.fx:
Familial Consumption is a Sorcery and Defensive Enchantment that restores HP, FP, and SP upon defeating enemies, and grants a boost in power. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Magma.

- Uses 12 stamina.

items.name: Furnace Maul
items.fx: Furnace Maul is a Sorcery that conjures a large molten hammer and slams it downward in front of you. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Magma.

items.name: Gelmir's Fury
items.fx:
Gelmir's Fury is a Sorcery that covers the area with a surge of magma from the earth. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Magma.

- Uses 17 stamina.

items.name: Inferno
items.fx:
Inferno is a Sorcery that conjures a volcanic eruption at your feet, causing chaos and destruction all around you. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Magma.

- Uses 28 stamina.

items.name: Lava Blast
items.fx:
Lava Blast us a Sorcery that fires a continuous spray of lava at enemies. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Magma.

- Uses 26 stamina.

items.name: Lava Bomb
items.fx:
Lava Bomb is a Sorcery that launches a large lump of magma upwards that then falls on foes and explodes on impact. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Magma.

- Uses 16 stamina.

items.name: Lava Dart
items.fx:
Lava Dart is a Sorcery that fires a small lump of lava that bursts on impact. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Magma.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Lava Pool
items.fx:
Lava Pool is a Sorcery that conjures a large pool of lava at your feet, causing damage to any enemy is touches. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Magma.

- Uses 24 stamina.

items.name: Lava Spray
items.fx:
Lava Spray is a Sorcery that fires a volley of magma at foes that burst upon impact. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Magma.

- Uses 21 stamina.

items.name: Living Forge
items.fx:
Living Forge is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is of the Forges of the Land of Shadow. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Magma.

- Increases absorptions by 10%.
- Increases hyperarmor and causes some attacks to rebound off your body.
- When a magma sorcery is casted or a magma weapon skill is used, gain a heat charge.
  - A charge increases fire damage by 3%.
  - Maximum of 5 charges.
- When staggered at 5 heat charges, a burst of molten metal will erupt, dealing damage to all enemies nearby and clearing heat charges.

items.name: Magma Missile
items.fx:
Magma Missile is a Sorcery that fires a seething mass of lava at enemies that explodes on impact. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Magma.

- Uses 23 stamina.

items.name: Magma Shot
items.fx:
Magma Shot is a Sorcery that fires a lump of magma that explodes on contact. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Magma.

- Uses 14 stamina.

items.name: Molten Spikes
items.fx: Molten Spikes is a Sorcery that causes a field of burning spikes to erupt from the ground in front of you. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Magma.

items.name: Molten Stride
items.fx:
Molten Stride is a Sorcery that causes the caster to conjure pools of lava underneath their feet. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Magma.

- Uses 11 stamina.

items.name: Pyroclasm
items.fx:
Pyroclasm is a Sorcery that conjures a large pool of lava at your feet, causing damage to any enemy is touches. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Magma.

- Uses 30 stamina.

items.name: Roiling Magma
items.fx:
Roiling Magma is a Sorcery that fires a lump of magma that explodes after a delay. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Magma.

- Uses 19 stamina.

items.name: Rykard's Rancor
items.fx:
Unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Magma.

- Uses 28 stamina.

items.name: Slag Spears
items.fx: Slag Spears is a Sorcery that conjures molten spears that launch toward foes. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Magma.

items.name: Superheat
items.fx:
Superheat is a Sorcery and Signature Enchantment that causes all lava pools to lower enemy fire absorption. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Magma.

- All lava pools created by the player or allies will lower enemy fire absorption by 1.5% for 20 seconds.
- This effect stacks with itself.

items.name: Vortex of Eiglay
items.fx:
Vortex of Eiglay is a Sorcery that opens a portal in the sky that calls down a massive swarm of burning vengeful spirits. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Magma.

- Uses 32 stamina.

items.name: Air Tax
items.fx:
Air Tax is a Sorcery that launches a projectile of air at foes, and upon impact, the enemy will be affected by a curse that slightly inhibits their breathing. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 6 stamina.

items.name: Cloud Form
items.fx:
Cloud Form is a Sorcery and Signature Enchantment that infuses your body with the essence of air. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Cyclone
items.fx:
Cyclone is a Sorcery that calls down a large funnel of wind centered around your body that moves with you. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 15 stamina.

items.name: Dematerialize
items.fx:
Dematerialize is a Sorcery and Defensive Enchantment that alters the essence of your physical form into vapors. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Gale Blast
items.fx:
Gale Blast is a Sorcery that conjures a continuous cylinder of air in front of you. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 24 stamina.

items.name: Gathering Storm
items.fx:
Gathering Storm is a Sorcery and Offensive Enchantment that surrounds your body with the power of wind. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Lion's Breath
items.fx: Lion's Breath is a Sorcery that releases a powerful gust of wind from your mouth. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Storm.

items.name: Rebuff
items.fx:
Rebuff is a Sorcery that calls a sudden blast of wind around your body, knocking nearby smaller enemies away. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 6 stamina.

items.name: Storm Arc
items.fx:
Storm Arc is a Sorcery that slashes horizontally into the air with your staff, generating a slender blade of air that flies forward, slicing through enemies. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 18 stamina.

items.name: Storm Arc Volley
items.fx: Storm Arc Volley is a Sorcery that releases a quick volley of arcs toward your foes. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Storm.

items.name: Storm Armament
items.fx:
Storm Armament is a Sorcery that enchants weapons with effects of storm. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 8 stamina.
- Adds 95 physical damage to weapon attacks, without scaling.
- Increases the physical damage of critical attacks by 15%.
- Increases the stance damage of enchanted weapon attacks by 15%.
- Lasts for 90 seconds.
  - Lasts for 120 seconds with the Jewel of the Storm.

items.name: Storm Call
items.fx:
Storm Call is a Sorcery that calls down a small torrent of air upon foes, dealing damage. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 17 stamina.

items.name: Storm Gust
items.fx:
Storm Gust is a Sorcery that launches a small projectile of air at foes, dealing damage. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 6 stamina.

items.name: Storm Shatter
items.fx:
Storm Shatter is a Sorcery that fires a projectile of air at foes that causes moderate damage but massive damage to their posture. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 20 stamina.

items.name: Storm Strike
items.fx:
Storm Strike is a Sorcery that fires a sharpened projectile of air at foes, dealing damage. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 18 stamina.

items.name: Stormcaller's Sublimity
items.fx:
Stormcaller's Sublimity is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is an advanced sorcery used by the Knights of ancient Stormveil. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 20 stamina.

items.name: Suffocate
items.fx:
Suffocate is a Sorcery that launches a projectile of air at foes, and upon impact, the enemy will be affected by a curse that greatly inhibits their breathing. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 14 stamina.

items.name: Tempest Embrace
items.fx:
Tempest Embrace is a Sorcery and Signature Enchantment that lowers weight and accelerates the caster. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Storm.

- Accelerates all actions you take by 5%.
- Weight is lowered by one tier, and if already at light load, dodges gain additional distance and the player gains the ability to double jump.
- Effect lasts for 1 minute.

items.name: Tempest Form
items.fx:
Tempest Form is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is an advanced sorcery used by the Tempestcallers of ancient Stormveil. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 20 stamina.

items.name: Tempest Lance
items.fx: Tempest Lance is a Sorcery that impales foes with a conjured spear of storms. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of the Storm. - aInformation from method ExecDamageExLarge in c9997.hks as of version 3.0.0.1

items.name: Tornado
items.fx:
Tornado is a Sorcery that conjures a large funnel of wind that moves toward foes and brings destruction to all it touches. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 25 stamina.

items.name: Twister
items.fx:
Twister is a Sorcery that conjures a small tornado that travels along the ground toward foes, dealing damage. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 14 stamina.

items.name: Whirlwind
items.fx:
Whirlwind is a Sorcery that calls a whirlwind of air around your body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of the Storm.

- Uses 27 stamina.

items.name: Windborne Vault
items.fx: Windborne Vault is a Sorcery that leaps a great distance backwards. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Storm.

items.name: Zephyr Strike
items.fx: Zephyr Strike is a Sorcery that flies forward and impale enemies with a bursting lance of wind. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of the Storm. - aInformation from method ExecDamageExLarge in c9997.hks as of version 3.0.0.1

items.name: Ambush Shard
items.fx:
Ambush Shard is a Sorcery that strikes from behind with projectile fired from distance. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Night.

- Uses 15 stamina.

items.name: Assassin's Approach
items.fx:
Assassin's Approach is a Sorcery that silences footsteps, and reduces fall damage and sound. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Night.

- Uses 13 stamina.

items.name: Attune to the Black Moon
items.fx: Attune to the Black Moon is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is a sorcery of the oracles of the nameless eternal city. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Night.

items.name: Black Moon Eulogy
items.fx: Black Moon Eulogy is a Sorcery that conjures a large moon above you that shatters and rains down destruction upon your foes. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Night.

items.name: Curse of Midnight
items.fx:
Curse of Midnight is a Sorcery that fires a projectile that causes a curse on impact. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Night.

- Uses 28 stamina.

items.name: Curse of Shadow
items.fx: Curse of Shadow is a Sorcery that fires a projectile that causes a curse on impact, can be used on poise-broken enemies. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Night. - aInformation from method ExecDamageExLarge in c9997.hks as of version 3.0.0.1

items.name: Darkness
items.fx:
Darkness  is a Sorcery that creates an area of darkness that conceals caster. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Night.

- Uses 11 stamina.

items.name: Eternal Darkness
items.fx:
Eternal Darkness is a Sorcery that creates dark space that draws in spells. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Night.

- Uses 15 stamina.

items.name: Founding Rain of Stars
items.fx:
Founding Rain of Stars is a Sorcery that releases a downpour of star rain for a while. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Night.

- Uses 25 stamina.

items.name: Fulminated Quicksilver
items.fx: Fulminated Quicksilver is a Sorcery that fires a wisp that detonates quicksilver that is already present on an enemy. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Night.

items.name: Night Comet
items.fx:
Night Comet is a Sorcery that fires a semi-invisible magic comet. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Night.

- Uses 30 stamina.

items.name: Night Maiden's Fog
items.fx:
Night Maiden's Fog is a Sorcery that releases a life-sapping silver mist all around the caster. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Night.

- Uses 24 stamina.

items.name: Night Maiden's Mist
items.fx:
Night Maiden's Mist is a Sorcery that releases life-sapping silver mist before caster. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Night.

- Uses 12 stamina.

items.name: Night Shard
items.fx:
Night Shard is a Sorcery that swiftly fires a semi-invisible magic projectile. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Night.

- Uses 9 stamina.

items.name: Night Stars
items.fx: Night Stars is a Sorcery that fires three shooting stars that pursue foes. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Night.

items.name: Oath of Darkness
items.fx:
Oath of Darkness is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is a sorcery of the ancient world. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Night.

- Uses 15 stamina.

items.name: Pure Darkness
items.fx: Pure Darkness is a Sorcery that plunges the world around you into total darkness, granting many benefits. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Night.

items.name: Quicksilver Affliction
items.fx:
Quicksilver Affliction is a Sorcery that fires a projectile that applies a poison of life-sapping silver. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Night.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Quicksilver Comet
items.fx:
Quicksilver Comet is a Sorcery that fires a dark magic comet applying a poison of life-sapping silver. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Night.

- Uses 32 stamina.

items.name: Quicksilver Shard
items.fx:
Quicksilver Shard is a Sorcery that launches a projectile striking the enemy from behind. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Night.

- Uses 17 stamina.

items.name: Shadow Arc
items.fx: Shadow Arc is a Sorcery that fires a horizontally-widening magic arc. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Night.

items.name: Shadow Bait
items.fx:
Shadow Bait is a Sorcery that creates a shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Night.

- Uses 9 stamina.

items.name: Star Swarm
items.fx: Star Swarm is a Sorcery that fires six shooting stars that pursue foes. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Night.

items.name: Stars of Ruin
items.fx:
Stars of Ruin is a Sorcery that fires twelve dark shooting stars that pursue foes. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Night.

- Uses 33 stamina.

items.name: Unseen Blade
items.fx:
Unseen Blade is a Sorcery that enchants weapons with effects of night. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Night.

- Uses 20 stamina.
- Adds 85 additional magic damage to weapon attacks, without scaling.
- Enemies struck will receive a 5% reduction to magic absorptions for 10 seconds, which doesn't stack.
- Enemies struck will receive a 10% reduction to their total stance for 10 seconds, which doesn't stack.
- Lasts for 90 seconds.
- Turns your weapon invisible.

items.name: Unseen Form
items.fx:
Unseen Form is a Sorcery and Defensive Enchantment that makes the caster semi-invisible. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Night.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Accursed Binding
items.fx:
Accursed Binding is a Sorcery that makes the caster immune to spirit summon debuffs and adds stamina recovery. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Ancient Death Rancor
items.fx:
Ancient Death Rancor is a Sorcery that summons a horde of vengeful spirits that chase down foes. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 16 stamina.

items.name: Blighted Armament
items.fx:
Blighted Armament is a Sorcery that coasts the weapon in a miasma of Death Blight. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 8 stamina.
- Adds 85 holy damage to weapon attacks, without scaling.
- Adds 45 death buildup to weapon attacks, without scaling.
- Enemies struck will be raised priority of attack for nearby Spirit Summons.
- Striking an enemy will provide a 5% increase to all absorptions for yourself and nearby allies for 10 seconds, which doesn't stack.
- Lasts for 60 seconds.

items.name: Curse of Putrefaction
items.fx:
Curse of Putrefaction is a Sorcery that sends out a project toward foes which, upon impact, curse the enemy. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 10 stamina.

items.name: Fia's Mist
items.fx:
Fia's Mist is a Sorcery that releases a mist of death before the caster. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 13 stamina.

items.name: Ghostflame Cannon
items.fx:
Ghostflame Cannon is a Sorcery that launches a projectile in an arc toward enemies causing an explosion of ghostflame. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 1 stamina.

items.name: Ghostflame Embrace
items.fx:
Ghostflame Embrace is a Sorcery that envelops the caster, all allies, and summons in ghostflame. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 15 stamina.

items.name: Godwyn's Vengeance
items.fx:
Godwyn's Vengeance is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is a sorcery discovered by Fia in a dream, an act of great empathy for the soulless dead. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 40 stamina.

items.name: Lingering Blight
items.fx:
Lingering Blight is a Sorcery that sends out a blighted projectile toward foes which curses the enemy upon impact. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 9 stamina.

items.name: Mass of Putrescence
items.fx:
Unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 17 stamina.

items.name: Phoenix of Death
items.fx:
Phoenix of Death is a Sorcery and Legendary Enchantment that is a sorcery wrought by the Great Phoenix, harbringer of souls and source of the power of ghostflame. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 25 stamina.

items.name: Putrid Salvo
items.fx: Putrid Salvo is a Sorcery that fires a multitude of putrid projectiles that fly forward and rebound. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Necromancy.

items.name: Putrid Shardstorm
items.fx: Putrid Shardstorm is a Sorcery that launches a putrid projectile that fires numerous shards in all directions that rebound. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Necromancy.

items.name: Rally the Legion
items.fx:
Rally the Legion is a Sorcery that increases the damage and defenses of all summons and allies. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 12 stamina.

items.name: Rancor Bolt
items.fx:
Rancor Bolt is a Sorcery that summons a single vengeful spirit that quickly seeks out an enemy. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 11 stamina.

items.name: Rancorcall
items.fx:
Rancorcall is a Sorcery that summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes. It is unlocked by using the Shimmering Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 15 stamina.

items.name: Rancorstorm
items.fx:
Rancorstorm is a Sorcery that summons a legion of vengeful spirits that chase down foes, dealing holy damage. It is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 20 stamina.

items.name: Reassemble
items.fx: Reassemble is a Sorcery that restores the health of all allies in your vicinity. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Necromancy.

items.name: Rings of Spectral Light
items.fx:
Unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 16 stamina.

items.name: Ritual of Ghostflame
items.fx:
Ritual of Ghostflame is a Sorcery that strikes your staff into the ground to conjure a series of ghostflame explosions around you. It is unlocked by using the Radiant Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 25 stamina.

items.name: Sacrifice
items.fx:
Sacrifice is a Sorcery that instantly kills your summoned minions, and when they die, you recovery resources and gain a buff that increases damage and defense. It is unlocked by using the Glowing Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 20 stamina.

items.name: Scadu Rebirth
items.fx: Scady Rebirth is a Sorcery that causes allies to recovery health over time and provides recovery to you if a summon is affected. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Necromancy.

items.name: Shadow of Death
items.fx:
Shadow of Death is a Sorcery and Signature Enchantment that provides damage but takes defense when you have a summon, and the opposite when you do not have a summon. It is unlocked by using the Shadow Rune of Necromancy.

- With an active summon.
  - Increases holy damage by 15%.
  - Decreases absorptions by 25%.
- Without an active summon.
  - Increases absorptions by 15%.
  - Decreases holy damage by 25%.

items.name: Soul Steal
items.fx:
Soul Steal is a Sorcery that is a sorcery of the servants of Death. IT is unlocked by using the Shining Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 30 stamina.

items.name: Tibia's Conversion
items.fx:
Tibia's Conversion is a Sorcery that summons Those Lost in Death. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 27 stamina.

items.name: Tibia's Summons
items.fx:
Tibia's Summons is a Sorcery that turns an undead enemy to your side. It is unlocked by using the Faint Rune of Necromancy.

- Uses 8 stamina.

items.name: Vortex of Putrescence
items.fx: Vortex of Putrescence is a Sorcery launches a whirl of putrescent jets. It can be purchased from Enia after defeating Putrescent Knight.

items.name: Wave of Corruption
